qe: What is the general formula for the 'Alkane' series?
qh: एल्केन (Alkane) श्रेणी का सामान्य रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
e: Alkane series ke sabhi members ka samanya sutra CnH2n+2 hota hai, jahan n carbon atomon ki sankhya batata hai - isliye methane mein 1 carbon par 2x1+2 = 4 hydrogen, ethane mein 2 carbon par 2x2+2 = 6 hydrogen milte hain. Iska matlab yahi hai ki alkane 'santript' (saturated) hydrocarbon hain, jinke har carbon atom ke saare chaar bandhan hydrogen ya carbon se bhar chuke hote hain, isliye unmein koi double ya triple bandhan nahi hota. Isi karan alkane keval substitution kriya dete hain, addition nahi. Isliye CnH2n+2 hi sahi jod hai - CnH2n (alkene) tatha CnH2n-2 (alkyne) ke sutra kramashah double tatha triple bandhan wale hydrocarbon ke hote hain. Exam point: alkane ka samanya sutra CnH2n+2 hota hai; isme sabhi bandhan bhar jaate hain, isliye ye santript hydrocarbon kehlate hain.

qe: Which gas is primarily known as 'Marsh Gas' because it is found in swampy areas?
qh: दलदली क्षेत्रों में पाए जाने के कारण किस गैस को 'मार्श गैस' कहा जाता है?
e: Methane (CH4) ko 'marsh gas' (dal-dal ki gas) kehte hain, kyunki ye daldal, talab tatha geele sthalon ki mitti mein anaerobik (bina hawa ke) gale-pake kachre tatha paudhon ke avshesh se badi matara mein paida hota hai. Ye sukche (methanogenic) jeevon ki kriya se banta hai tatha paani ke upar bulbuti ke roop mein upar aata hai; isi liye purwa taur par aise sthalon mein jalan ki gas ke roop mein iska pata chala. Kisi khuley sthal mein bhi 'marsh gas' ka sahi jod methane hi hai - hydrogen, carbon dioxide ya ethane nahi, kyunki wo daldal ki gandagi se itni matara mein nahi nikalte. Exam point: methane (CH4) ko marsh gas kehte hain, kyunki ye daldal tatha geele sthalon mein jaivik gale-pake se paida hota hai (isi liye daldal mein bulbuti dikhti hai).

qe: Which property of Carbon allows it to form long chains and rings?
qh: कार्बन का कौन सा गुण उसे लंबी श्रृंखलाएं और वलय बनाने की क्षमता देता है?
e: Catenation carbon ka wo khaas gun hai jis se wo apne hi atomon ke saath mil kar lambi-jambhi shrankhla (chain) tatha chakrakar (ring) dhancha bana leta hai - isi karan carbon ke lakhon compounds bante hain tatha kaarbo-rasiye (organic chemistry) itni badi hai. Carbon ke chhote aakaar tatha chaar bandhan banane ki kshamata ke kaaran ye jude rehkar sthir dhancha banate hain, tatha unmein double tatha triple bandhan bhi aa sakta hai (isi se alkene tatha alkyne bante hain). Silicon bhi chhote gun dikhata hai par uski shrankhla utni lambi tatha sthir nahi hoti, isliye carbon jaisa vaicitra nahi ban paata. Exam point: catenation carbon ka apne hi atomon se lambi chain tatha ring banane ka gun hai - isi karan carbon ke sabse zyada compounds hote hain.

qe: What is the bond angle in a 'Methane' molecule ($CH_4$)?
qh: मीथेन ($CH_4$) अणु में बंध कोण (Bond Angle) कितना होता है?
e: Methane (CH4) mein carbon atom chaar hydrogen ke saath judta hai tatha koi unt-mukt (lone) electron jodi nahi hoti, isliye ye ek regulat chaturfalk (tetrahedral) dhancha banata hai jismein har H-C-H bandhan ka kon lagbhag 109.5 degree hota hai. Chaturfalk dhancha lene ka karan yahi hai ki chaar bandhanon ko aapas mein sabse door rakhne par yahi kon milta hai (VSEPR ka siddhant), isliye 90 ya 120 degree jaise kon nahi bante. Isi karan methane ek asaman (non-polar) molecule hota hai, kyunki chaaron bandhanon ka prabhav barabar taur par mitr jaata hai. Exam point: methane mein bandhan-kon lagbhag 109.5 degree (chaturfalk) hota hai - yahi VSEPR ke hisaab se chaar bandhanon ke liye sabse door wali vyavastha hai.

qe: Which of the following is an 'Unsaturated' hydrocarbon?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक 'असंतृप्त' हाइड्रोकार्बन है?
e: Ethene (CH2=CH2) ko asantript (unsaturated) hydrocarbon kehte hain, kyunki uske do carbon atomon ke beech ek double bandhan hota hai tatha wahan hydrogen aur jud sakti hai - isi khuli jagah ke karan wo addition kriya deta hai. Alkene ka samanya sutra CnH2n hota hai tatha unmein kam se kam ek C=C bandhan zaroori hai; agar unmein chhota hydrogen na jude to bhi unhe asantript hi kaha jaata hai. Iske ulat, ethane (CH3-CH3) saar bandhan se bhara hua hai, isliye wo santript hai tatha addition kriya nahi de sakta. Isliye is prashn mein ethene hi sahi jod hai, ethane ya propane nahi. Exam point: ethene (CH2=CH2) ek asantript hydrocarbon hai, kyunki usmein double bandhan ke karan hydrogen judne ki jagah bachi rehti hai (isliye wo addition kriya deta hai).

qe: What is the IUPAC name of 'Acetylene' gas?
qh: एसिटिलीन गैस का IUPAC नाम क्या है?
e: Acetylene gas ka IUPAC naam ethyne hai; HC=CH ke do carbon atom hone se iska 'eth' bhaag ethane/ethene se juda hota hai tatha alkyne hone ke karan 'yne' pratyay lagta hai - isliye naam 'ethyne' banta hai. Iska samanya sutra CnH2n-2 hai tatha ismein triple bandhan (C triple bond C) hota hai, isliye ye amon mein sabse zyada asantript hydrocarbon hai. Vyavhar mein ise welding tatha cutting ke liye istemal karte hain, kyunki iski jyoti bahut garam (lagbhag 3300 degree C) hoti hai. Isliye 'Ethyne' hi sahi IUPAC naam hai - acetylene purana vyavharik naam hai, tatha ethene/ethane ke bandhan alag hain. Exam point: acetylene ka IUPAC naam ethyne hai (sutra CnH2n-2 tatha ek triple bandhan ke saath).

qe: Compounds with the same molecular formula but different 'Structures' are called:
qh: समान आणविक सूत्र लेकिन भिन्न संरचना वाले यौगिक क्या कहलाते हैं?
e: Isomer wo compounds hote hain jinka anu-sutra (molecular formula) ek hi hota hai, par unke atomon ki sajaavat (structure) alag hoti hai - isliye unke gun tatha bhautik tatha rasayanik byavhaar bhi alag hote hain. Jaise butane tatha isobutane ka sutra C4H10 ek hi hai, par ek seedhi shrankhla tatha doosra shakha wala hai. Iska mahatva yahi hai ki ek hi sutra se kai compounds ban sakte hain, isliye organic compounds ki sankhya itni badi hai tatha IUPAC naam-karan (naming) aavashyak ho jaata hai. Isliye 'isomers' hi sahi jod hai - ek hi compound ke alag-alag roop ya alloy ke liye ye shabd nahi hota. Exam point: ek hi anu-sutra par alag sajaavat wale compounds ko isomers kehte hain (jaise butane tatha isobutane), isliye unke gun bhi alag hote hain.

qe: Which gas is used for the 'Artificial Ripening' of green fruits?
qh: कच्चे फलों को कृत्रिम रूप से पकाने के लिए किस गैस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Ethylene (ethene) gas plant-harmone ki tarah kaam karti hai tatha fal ki padaav ki jaldi badhati hai, isliye kacche kela, aam, tamatar tatha papita jaisi fasalon ko bazar tak pahunchane se pehle iske halke ghul se saaf kar ke pila (ripe) kiya jaata hai. Aise kacche fal ko ek bandh kamre mein rakhte hain tatha ethylene ki thodi matara daal dete hain - kuch hi ghanton ya dinon mein wo rang tatha mithash pakad lete hain. Iske ulat methane, CO2 ya nitrogen ki aisi kriya nahi hoti, isliye aam taur par ye vikalp peda hote hain. Isi karan hawa mein apne aap paleele fal (jaise kela) paas rakhe fal ko bhi jaldi pila kar dete hain. Exam point: kacche falon ko kala-baazaar ke liye pila karne mein ethylene (ethene) gas ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ye fal ke pakan ki kriya ko tez kar deti hai.

qe: What is the 'Main Constituent' of Natural Gas?
qh: प्राकृतिक गैस का मुख्य घटक क्या है?
e: Prakritik gas (natural gas) mein methane ki matara lagbhag 95 pratishat tak hoti hai, isliye ushe methane hi kaha jaata hai; baaki hisse mein ethane, propane, butane tatha chhoti matara mein carbon dioxide, nitrogen tatha hydrogen sulphide hote hain. Isi karan prakritik gas ki ikai bahut adhik ushma deti hai tatha ye swachh jalan wala indhan maana jaata hai (jalne par CO2 tatha paani bantey hain, dhuan tatha SO2 nahi). Ghar mein laga piped gas (PNG) tatha kitni jagah CNG bhi isi ka mila-jula roop hai, jismein methane mukhya hota hai. Isliye methane (~95%) hi sahi jod hai - LPG mein butane-propane tatha biogas mein bhi methane hota hai, par 'natural gas' ka bada hissa methane hi hai. Exam point: prakritik gas ka mukhya tatva methane (lagbhag 95%) hota hai; baaki hisse mein ethane, propane tatha butane hote hain.

qe: Which type of 'Isomerism' is shown by Butane and Isobutane?
qh: ब्यूटेन और आइसोब्यूटेन किस प्रकार की समावयवता प्रदर्शित करते हैं?
e: Butane tatha isobutane ka anu-sutra ek (C4H10) hota hai, par butane ki sajaavat seedhi shrankhla (n-butane) wali hoti hai jabki isobutane mein ek shakha (branch) hoti hai - isi tarah ke antar ko shrankhla samropan (chain isomerism) kehte hain. Ye samropan tab dikhta hai jahan carbon atomon ki sankhya chaar ya usse adhik hoti hai, kyunki kam atomon par alag sajaavat banti hi nahi (methane, ethane, propane ke ek hi roop hote hain). Isi karan sutra CnH2n+2 wale hydrocarbon ke isomers ki sankhya carbon badhne ke saath tezi se badhti jaati hai. Isliye butane-isobutane ka sambandh chain isomerism ka udaharan hai, anya samropan (position, functional) ka nahi. Exam point: butane tatha isobutane shrankhla samropan (chain isomerism) ka udaharan hain - same sutra, par ek seedhi shrankhla tatha ek shakha wali sajaavat.

qe: What is the general formula for the 'Alkyne' series?
qh: एल्काइन श्रेणी का सामान्य सूत्र क्या है?
e: Alkyne gharane ka samikaran CnH2n-2 hota hai - alkane se chaar hydrogen ghatane par yahi banta hai, kyunki ek triple bandhan bharne ke liye chaar bandhan ke sthan chahiye hote hain (alkane 2n+2, alkene 2n, alkyne 2n-2). Isi kaaran alkyne sabse adhik asantript hydrocarbon hote hain tatha addition kriya mein do ya chaar hydrogen jud sakti hain (pehle alkene, phir alkane banta hai). Sabse chhota member ethyne (C2H2) hota hai, isliye ye gharana methane ya ethene se aarambh nahi hota. Isliye CnH2n-2 hi sahi jod hai - CnH2n+2 tatha CnH2n kramashah alkane tatha alkene ke sutra hain. Exam point: alkyne gharane ka samikaran CnH2n-2 hota hai; triple bandhan ke kaaran alkane ki tulna mein chaar hydrogen kam hoti hain.

qe: Which hydrocarbon is used as fuel in 'LPG' cylinders for cooking?
qh: रसोई गैस (LPG) में मुख्य रूप से कौन सा हाइड्रोकार्बन प्रयुक्त होता है?
e: LPG (liquefied petroleum gas) cylinder mein mukhya roop se butane tatha propane ki gas hoti hai, jinhe thande tatha dabav mein drav kar ke silindar mein bhara jaata hai. In dono gases ka kvathank thoda adhik hone se ye saadharan tapman par asaani se drav hote hain, isliye kam jagah mein bahut urja bhar kar rakhi ja sakti hai; isi karan silindar halka hone par bhi itni lambi jalan deta hai. Silindar se nikalti gas mein halki gandh (ethyl mercaptan) milai jaati hai taaki gas chupke se riste hue turant pata chal jaaye. Iske ulat methane (natural gas) ka kvathank itna kam hota hai ki ushe drav karna mushkil hota hai - isliye CNG dabav mein rakhi jaati hai. Exam point: LPG cylinder mein butane tatha propane (drav roop mein) hoti hain; methane nahi, kyunki wo aasaani se drav nahi hoti.

qe: How many 'Covalent Bonds' are present in a molecule of Ethane ($C_2H_6$)?
qh: एथेन ($C_2H_6$) के एक अणु में कुल कितने सहसंयोजक बंध होते हैं?
e: Ethane (C2H6) mein do carbon atomon ke beech ek C-C bandhan hota hai tatha har carbon par teen-tee hydrogen judi hoti hain (kul 6 C-H bandhan) - isliye kul saaton (7) sahayogi (covalent) bandhan hote hain: 1 carbon-carbon tatha 6 carbon-hydrogen. Yahi gun ethane ko santript banata hai, kyunki saare bandhan bhar chuke hain tatha hydrogen jodne ki koi khaali jagah nahi bachti. Isliye ethane addition kriya nahi deta, sirf substitution deta hai; isi karan uska byavhaar alag hota hai. Isliye 7 hi sahi jod hai - 6 bandhan tab hote jab sirf C-H ginein tatha C-C chhod dein. Exam point: ethane (C2H6) mein kul 7 covalent bandhan hote hain (1 C-C tatha 6 C-H), isliye ye santript hydrocarbon hai tatha addition kriya nahi deta.

qe: Which of the following is the 'First Member' of the Alkyne series?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एल्काइन श्रृंखला का प्रथम सदस्य है?
e: Alkyne series ka pehla sadasya (first member) ethyne (C2H2) hota hai, kyunki triple bandhan ke liye kam se kam do carbon atom chahiye - ek hi carbon par triple bandhan sambhav nahi, kyunki carbon ke sirf chaar bandhan hote hain tatha usme do carbon ke saath bandhan chahiye. Isi karan alkyne gharane ka pehla sadasya ethyne hi hota hai (ek carbon wali koi alkyne nahi banti), tatha usi tarah alkene bhi ethene se aarambh hoti hai kyunki double bandhan bhi kam se kam do carbon maangta hai. Ethyne ka sutra C2H2 hota hai tatha ismein H-C triple bond C-H sajaavat hoti hai, yani seedhi line wala anu. Exam point: alkyne series ka pehla member ethyne (C2H2) hota hai - triple bandhan ke liye kam se kam do carbon atomon ki zaroorat hoti hai, isliye ek carbon wali alkyne nahi banti.

qe: What is the 'Homologous Series'?
qh: सजातीय श्रेणी (Homologous Series) क्या है?
o: Group of organic compounds with same functional group and formula pattern
e: Homologous series un compounds ka samooh hota hai jinka ek hi samanya sutra (jaise CnH2n+2) tatha ek hi kriya-sheel samooh (functional group) hota hai, aur lagataar sadasya ek CH2 ikai ke antar se alag-alag hote hain (aise sadasya ke gun ek jaisi samvedansheelata dikhate hain). Jaise alkane ki series mein methane, ethane, propane, butane kram se CH2 ke antar se badhte hain tatha sabhi santript hain. Isi karan ek hi samooh ke sadasya ke bhautik gun (kvathank, galank) kram-agat badalte hain par rasayanik gun lagbhag ek jaise rehte hain. Isliye 'same functional group wale compounds ka samooh' hi sahi jod hai, kyunki ismein sutra ka patn tatha sama gun dono zaroori hain. Exam point: homologous series ek hi samanya sutra tatha ek hi kriya-sheel samooh wale compounds ka samooh hai, jisme lagataar sadasya CH2 ke antar se alag hote hain.

qe: Which gas is released during the 'Incomplete Combustion' of fuels and is highly poisonous?
qh: ईंधन के अपूर्ण दहन से कौन सी अत्यधिक जहरीली गैस निकलती है?
e: Kisi bhi indhan ke jalan mein agar oxygen poori matara mein na mile (ajar jalan) to carbon poori tarah CO2 mein nahi badalta - isliye carbon monoxide (CO) banta hai, jo ek rangheen, gandhheen par atyant jaharila (poisonous) gas hai. Ye gas hawa se halki hone ke karan aasaani se chhat se niche utar kar aati hai tatha khoon ke haemoglobin se jud kar oxygen dhaaran karne ki kshamata kam kar deti hai - isliye bandh kamre mein angithi/tandur jalane se mrityu tak ho sakti hai. Iske ulat pooree jalan mein CO2 banta hai (jo jaharila nahi hota), isliye dhuan tatha CO ke liye satark rehna zaroori hai. Exam point: ajar jalan se carbon monoxide (CO) banti hai, jo atyant jaharila hai - isse haemoglobin oxygen nahi le paata, isliye bandh kamre mein angithi nahi jalani chahiye.

qe: Which hydrocarbon is used in 'Oxy-acetylene' torches for welding?
qh: वेल्डिंग में प्रयुक्त होने वाली ऑक्सी-एसिटिलीन ज्वाला में कौन सा हाइड्रोकार्बन उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Oxy-acetylene torch mein ethyne (acetylene) ko suddh oxygen ke saath jalaya jaata hai, jisse bahut uchch tapman (lagbhag 3300 degree C) wali neeli safed jyoti banti hai - isi liye ye loha kaatne tatha jodne (welding) ke liye sabse upyukt maana jaata hai. Iski jyoti itni garam hoti hai ki dhaatu pighal kar jaldi jud jaati hai; iske ulat aam (kam tapman wali) jalan mein sirf peela dhuan nikalta hai tatha dhaatu jaldi jud nahi paati. Isi karan gas cylinder se acetylene ko ek mushkil se bache hue drav (acetone mein ghuli) roop mein rakha jaata hai, kyunki dabav mein wo phat jati hai. Exam point: oxy-acetylene torch mein ethyne ka istemal hota hai, kyunki oxygen ke saath jalne par ye sabse garam (lagbhag 3300 degree C) jyoti deti hai jo welding tatha cutting ke liye chahiye.

qe: What is 'Geometrical Isomerism' (Cis-Trans) primarily found in?
qh: ज्यामितीय समावयवता (Cis-Trans) मुख्य रूप से किसमें पाई जाती है?
e: Samavi (geometrical) samropan, jise cis-trans samropan bhi kehte hain, mukhya roop se alkenes (aur bahukentriya halo-alkene) mein dikhta hai, kyunki double bandhan ke karan carbon atom aapas mein mud nahi sakte - isliye alag-alag samooh yadi ek hi taraf hono (cis) ya viroodh taraf hon (trans) to do alag compounds bante hain. Aise samropan ke liye zaroori hai ki dono carbon par do alag-alag samooh hon, isliye ethene (jisme chaaron samooh hydrogen) mein ye samropan nahi dikhti. Ye samropan santript hydrocarbon (alkane) mein nahi dikhti, kyunki wahan C-C bandhan akela hota hai tatha carbon ghoom sakta hai (single bandhan ke around rotation hoti hai). Exam point: geometrical (cis-trans) samropan mukhya roop se alkenes mein dikhti hai, kyunki usmein ghoom na sakan wala double bandhan hota hai.

qe: Which of the following has 'Triple' bond?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किस अणु में त्रिबंध उपस्थित है?
e: C2H2 (ethyne) mein do carbon atomon ke beech triple bandhan hota hai, isliye uski sajaavat H-C triple bond C-H hoti hai tatha wo hydrocarbon-amron mein sabse adhik asantript hota hai. Iska matlab ye hai ki usmein do carbon ke beech teen bandhan hone ke karan hydrogen ki sankhya alkene se bhi kam (sirf do) reh jaati hai. Iske ulat C2H4 (ethene) mein double tatha C2H6 (ethane) mein keval akela bandhan hota hai, isliye wo triple bandhan wale nahi hain. Isi karan ethyne ke sabse zyada asantript bandhan ke karan addition kriya mein do baar hydrogen jud sakti hai. Exam point: C2H2 (ethyne) mein triple bandhan hota hai - isi karan ye sabse adhik asantript hydrocarbon tatha bahut uchch tapman wali jyoti deta hai.

qe: What is the IUPAC name for 'Isopropyl Alcohol'?
qh: आइसोप्रोपिल अल्कोहल का IUPAC नाम क्या है?
e: Propan-2-ol ek teen carbon wali alcohol hai jismein -OH samooh beech wale (2nd) carbon par hota hai, isliye IUPAC naam 'propan' (teen carbon) + '2-ol' (doosre karbon par OH) banta hai. Isi ko vyavhar mein isopropyl alcohol kehte hain tatha iska istemal sanitizer, kitanu-nashak (disinfectant) tatha 'rubbing alcohol' ke roop mein hota hai; ye mrityu-rakhne wali niyam (70% ghol) mein sabse aam hai. Yadi OH pehle carbon par hota to naam propan-1-ol ban jaata, tatha dono ke gun alag hote; isliye sthiti (position) ka sankhya likhna zaroori hai. Isliye propan-2-ol hi sahi IUPAC naam hai - propanone (acetone) tatha propanal alag kriya-sheel samooh wale compounds hain. Exam point: isopropyl alcohol ka IUPAC naam propan-2-ol hota hai, kyunki usmein -OH samooh beech wale (doosre) carbon par laga hota hai.

qe: Which 'Allotrope' of Carbon is the hardest known natural substance?
qh: कार्बन का कौन सा अपरूप सबसे कठोर ज्ञात प्राकृतिक पदार्थ है?
e: Carbon ke saare pratyaroopon (allotropes) mein heere (diamond) ki sajaavat chaturfalk (tetrahedral) hoti hai, jismein har carbon atom chaar doosre carbon ke saath mazboot sahayogi (covalent) bandhan se jud kar atyant mazboot thir aayam (3D) jala banata hai - isliye ye prithvi ka sabse kathor prakritik padarth hai. Iski kathorta saare bandhanon ko todne ke liye bahut adhik urja lagne se aati hai, isliye heera kaat-tarash (cut) karne, drill tatha glass-cutter mein istemal hota hai. Graphite mein paratein (layers) hoti hain jo ek doosre par sarak jaati hain, isliye wo naram tatha chikna hota hai, jabki fullerene lagbhag 60 carbon ka gola hota hai. Exam point: heera (diamond) sabse kathor prakritik padarth hai, kyunki uske carbon atom chaar-chaar sahayogi bandhanon se jud kar mazboot thir-aayam jala banate hain.

qe: Which gas is evolved when 'Calcium Carbide' reacts with water?
qh: कैल्शियम कार्बाइड की जल के साथ अभिक्रिया कराने पर कौन सी गैस निकलती है?
e: Calcium carbide (CaC2) par paani daalne se rasayanik kriya hoti hai jismein calcium hydroxide tatha ethyne (acetylene) gas banti hai, isliye yahi kriya purane taur par acetylene banane ke liye istemal hoti hai. Isi karan calcium carbide ko purane zamane mein 'carbide ka lamp' tatha fruit ripening ke liye bhi istemal karte the - par aaj ise khadya tatha fasal ke liye varjit kiya gaya hai, kyunki ismein arsin (arsenic ki gas) tatha anya ashudhiyaan mil sakti hain. Iska samikaran CaC2 + 2H2O se Ca(OH)2 + C2H2 hota hai; iske ulat carbides se methane ya CO2 nahi banti. Exam point: calcium carbide aur paani ki kriya se ethyne (acetylene) gas banti hai - isi liye carbide ko purane lampe tatha fal pilaane mein istemal karte the.

qe: What is the 'Tetravalency' of carbon?
qh: कार्बन की 'चतुःसंयोजकता' (Tetravalency) क्या है?
e: Tetravalency ka matlab ye hai ki carbon ke bahari kosh mein chaar electron hote hain tatha wo chaar sahayogi (covalent) bandhan bana kar apna oktet pura karta hai - yani carbon ek saath chaar atomon se jud sakta hai. Yahi gun carbon ko anya tatvon ke saath lakhon sthir compounds banane deta hai (hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, halogens tatha khud carbon ke saath). Iska seedha parinaam yahi hai ki carbon ki valency 4 hoti hai, isliye aise compounds ka sutra CH4, CO2 jaise bante hain; isi karan wo chaaron bandhan bhar jaane par santript ho jaata hai. Isliye 'carbon chaar bandhan banata hai' hi sahi jod hai - teen ya do bandhan wale jod iski asli valency batate hi nahi. Exam point: tetravalency ka arth hai carbon ka chaar sahayogi bandhan banane ka gun (isliye uski valency 4 hai) - yahi uske lakhon compounds ka aadhaar hai.

qe: Which 'Allotrope' of Carbon is a good conductor of electricity?
qh: कार्बन का कौन सा अपरूप विद्युत का सुचालक है?
e: Graphite carbon ka wo pratyaroop hai jismein har carbon atom teen doosre carbon ke saath jud kar parat (layer) wali chhat (hexagon) jala banata hai tatha har atom ka chautha electron mukta reh jaata hai - isi mukta electron ke karan graphite vidyut ka achha chaalak hota hai (heera tatha fullerene chaalak nahi hote). Inhi paraton ke beech kamjor bandhan hone se wo aapas mein sarak jaati hain, isliye graphite naram, chikna tatha kaala hote hue bhi bijli ka achha suchaalak ban jaata hai. Isi karan graphite se bijli ke electrode, dry cell ka rod tatha pencil ki lead banti hai. Exam point: graphite vidyut ka achha chaalak hota hai, kyunki uske har carbon atom ka ek electron mukta reh jaata hai (free electron ke karan bijli bahti hai).

qe: What is the general formula of 'Alkenes'?
qh: एल्कीन श्रेणी का सामान्य सूत्र क्या है?
e: Alkene gharane ke sadasyon ke liye CnH2n likha jaata hai - inmein ek double bandhan (C=C) hone ke kaaran alkane ke muqable do hydrogen kam rehti hain. Aise compound asantript kehlate hain tatha addition kriya dete hain (jaise ethene se ethane banta hai jab hydrogen judti hai). Sabse chhota member ethene (C2H4) hota hai, kyunki double bandhan ke liye kam se kam do carbon chahiye; yahi ethylene gas fal pilaane mein bhi kaam aati hai. Isliye CnH2n hi sahi jod hai - CnH2n+2 alkane tatha CnH2n-2 alkyne ke sutra hote hain. Exam point: alkene gharane ke sadasyon ka samikaran CnH2n hota hai (alkane se do hydrogen kam); isi karan ye addition kriya dete hain.

qe: Which is the 'Simplest' Organic Compound?
qh: सबसे सरल कार्बनिक यौगिक कौन सा है?
e: Methane (CH4) sabse saral tatha pehla kaarbo-sanyojak (organic compound) maana jaata hai, kyunki ismein keval ek carbon atom hota hai tatha uske saare chaar bandhan sabse chhote - hydrogen ke saath bhare hote hain. Isi karan kisi bhi kaarbo-shreni (jaise alkane) ka pehla sadasya methane hota hai tatha ye dal-dal ki gas, biogas, natural gas tatha gobar gas ka mukhya tatva bhi hai. Isse aage ethane, propane tatha butane jaise compound carbon atomon ki sankhya badhne se bante hain, isliye methane ke baad hi bhaari hydrocarbon aate hain. Isliye 'methane' hi sahi jod hai - ethane tatha propane do-diye se adhik carbon wale hote hain. Exam point: methane (CH4) sabse saral organic compound hai, kyunki usmein ek hi carbon atom tatha chaar hydrogen hote hain (isi liye alkane series ka pehla sadasya yahi hai).

qe: What is 'Buckminsterfullerene'?
qh: बकमिनिस्टरफुलरीन (Buckminsterfullerene) क्या है?
e: Buckminsterfullerene carbon ka ek pratyaroop (allotrope) hai jiska sutra C60 hota hai tatha uski sajaavat football (soccer ball) jaisi lagbhag golij hai, jise 1985 mein Kroto, Smalley tatha Curl ne khoja tatha isi khoj par 1996 mein rasayan ka nobel mila. Iske andar 60 carbon atom 12 panj-bhuj tatha 20 shat-bhuj ke roop mein mil kar ek khaali kotar (cage) banate hain, isliye ise 'buckyball' bhi kehte hain - isi class (fullerene) se carbon nanotubes tatha anya nano-aakaar bante hain. Isliye Buckminsterfullerene ka sahi jod 'carbon ka ek pratyaroop (C60)' hai - ye graphite ya heere ka alag roop nahi balki teesra sabse prachlit allotrope hai. Exam point: Buckminsterfullerene carbon ka ek allotrope hai jiska sutra C60 hota hai tatha sajaavat football jaisi golij hoti hai (nano-technology mein bahut upyogi).

qe: Which hydrocarbon is liquid at room temperature?
qh: कमरे के तापमान पर कौन सा हाइड्रोकार्बन द्रव अवस्था में होता है?
e: Pentane (C5H12) mein paanch carbon atom hote hain, isliye uske anuon ke beech bandhan kamjor hone se uske kvathank (lagbhag 36 degree C) kadrak-kamre ke tapman se thoda adhik hote hain - isi karan ye saadharan tapman par drav (liquid) rehta hai. Iske ulat methane, ethane, propane tatha butane saadharan tapman par gas hote hain, kyunki unke anu chhote tatha halke hote hain tatha aakarshan bal itna mazboot nahi hota. Isi karan LPG cylinder mein butane-propane ka mishran hota hai (dabav se drav), tatha petrol-diesel jaise bhaari hydrocarbon saadharan tapman par drav roop mein hi hote hain. Exam point: pentane (C5H12) saadharan tapman par drav hota hai, kyunki uske anu bhaari hone se aakarshan bal zyada tatha kvathank 36 degree C hota hai.

qe: What is 'Substitution Reaction' typical for?
qh: प्रतिस्थापन अभिक्रिया (Substitution Reaction) मुख्य रूप से किनकी विशेषता है?
e: Alkane (santript hydrocarbon) ke saare bandhan bhar chuke hote hain, isliye unmein hydrogen jodne ya bandhan kholne ki jagah nahi bachti - isliye aise compounds mein hydrogen/atom ka sthan badalne wali samaveshi kriya (substitution reaction) hoti hai (jaise methane se chloromethane). Iske ulat addition kriya asantript hydrocarbon (alkene/alkyne) mein hoti hai, kyunki wahan double ya triple bandhan khula hota hai. Ye kriya aam taur par suraj ki roshni tatha beram (chlorine) jaisi abhikarmak ke saath hoti hai tatha alag-alag pratisthaapan (chloro, bromo) ke product banti jaati hai. Isliye substitution kriya santript hydrocarbon ki pehchaan hai. Exam point: substitution reaction alkane ke liye upyukt hai, kyunki uske saare bandhan bhar chuke hote hain - isliye ek atom ko doosre atom se badalna padta hai.

qe: Which of the following is used as a 'Dry Lubricant'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किसे 'शुष्क स्नेहक' के रूप में उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Graphite ke paraton ke beech ka bandhan kamjor hota hai, isliye wo parat asaani se ek doosre par sarak jaati hain tatha khud chikni (slippery) bana deti hai - isi karan graphite ko sukhe snigdhak (dry lubricant) ke roop mein istemal karte hain, jahan tel ya grise jaise drapadarth ka istemal sambhav na ho. Yahi gun pencil ki lead tatha chabi (lock) mein bhi kaam aata hai, kyunki graphite ke parat talab par patli parat chhod kar chikahat deti hai. Iske ulat heera tatha fullerene mein hard-guddi (3D/dome) sajaavat hoti hai, isliye wo chikne nahi hote; isliye doosre allotrope is kaam ke liye sahi nahi. Exam point: graphite ka istemal sukhe snigdhak (dry lubricant) ke roop mein hota hai, kyunki uski paratein aapas mein aasaani se sarak jaati hain (isi karan pencil bhi chalti hai).

qe: What is 'Addition Reaction' typical for?
qh: योगात्मक अभिक्रिया (Addition Reaction) किन यौगिकों में मुख्य रूप से होती है?
e: Addition reaction un compounds mein hoti hai jinke beech mein double ya triple bandhan khula hota hai - isliye alkene tatha alkyne (asantript hydrocarbon) mein hydrogen, halogen, paani ya halogen acid jud kar unhe santript product mein badal deti hai (jaise ethene + hydrogen se ethane tatha ethene + paani se ethanol banta hai). Iske ulat alkane (santript) mein aisi koi khuli jagah nahi hoti, isliye wo addition nahi de sakta - wahan substitution hoti hai. Isi kriya ke aadhaar par vanaspati ghee bhi banta hai, jahan drav tel mein hydrogen jod kar ushe thos banaya jaata hai. Isliye 'unsaturated hydrocarbon' hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: addition reaction asantript hydrocarbon (alkene tatha alkyne) mein hoti hai, kyunki unke double/triple bandhan hydrogen judne ke liye khula rehta hai.

qe: What is the IUPAC name for 'Ethyl Alcohol'?
qh: इथाइल अल्कोहल का IUPAC नाम क्या है?
e: Ethyl alcohol ka IUPAC naam ethanol (C2H5OH) hai, kyunki usmein do carbon atom hote hain tatha -OH kriya-sheel samooh lagta hai (alkane ethane se ek hydrogen hatta kar wahan OH daalne se banta hai). Isi naam se ise sharab, sanitizer tatha aushadhi ke bindu ke roop mein pehchaana jaata hai; ye shareer ke liye halka nasha deta hai, isliye ise 'drinking alcohol' bhi kehte hain. Iske ulat methanol (ek carbon) tatha propanol (teen carbon) alag compound hain tatha unke gun bhi bhinn hote hain - methanol zahari hai. Isliye ethanol hi sahi IUPAC naam hai. Exam point: ethyl alcohol ka IUPAC naam ethanol hota hai (do carbon tatha ek -OH samooh); ye nasheela par methanol se kaafi kam jaharila hota hai.

qe: Which gas is known as 'Coal Gas'?
qh: कोल गैस (Coal Gas) किसका मिश्रण है?
e: Koyle (coal) ko bina hawa ke garam karne par jo gas nikal kar jugapt (collect) hoti hai ushe coal gas kehte hain, tatha iska mukhya hissa hydrogen, methane tatha carbon monoxide hota hai (kuchh matara mein nitrogen tatha CO2 bhi). Ye gas purane zamane mein shehron ki roshni (gas lamps) tatha khane-pakane ke liye istemal ki jaati thi, kyunki ismein jalan ke yogya gases ka mila-jula roop hota hai tatha iski jyoti tez hoti hai. Iska samkopan se hi coal tar, benzene tatha anya kaarbo-rasiye nikaale jaate hain, isliye koyle ki aasav chullu (destructive distillation) bahut mahatvapurn udyog hai. Isliye hydrogen + methane + CO wala jod hi sahi hai - keval methane ya keval CO se ye gas nahi banti. Exam point: coal gas hydrogen, methane tatha carbon monoxide ka mishran hota hai; ise koyle ki aasav-chullu se banaya jaata hai tatha purane lampe mein jalaya jaata tha.

qe: How many 'Structural Isomers' does Pentane ($C_5H_{12}$) have?
qh: पेंटेन ($C_5H_{12}$) के कितने संरचनात्मक समावयवी (Structural Isomers) होते हैं?
e: Pentane (C5H12) ke teen alag sajaavat wale samrop (structural isomers) hote hain: seedhi shrankhla wala n-pentane, ek shakha wala isopentane tatha do shakha wala neopentane - isliye iske teen samrop bante hain. Sankhya badhne ka karan yahi hai ki paanch carbon atom ek doosre se kai tarah se jud sakte hain, tatha carbon badhne ke saath samrop ki sankhya tezi se badhti jaati hai (hexane ke paanch tatha decane ke lagbhag pachattar). Isi karan ek hi anu-sutra ke kai compound bante hain tatha unki pehchaan tatha naam-karan zaroori ho jaata hai. Isliye '3' hi sahi jod hai, anya aankde kam ya zyada hote hain. Exam point: pentane ke teen structural isomers hote hain (n-pentane, isopentane tatha neopentane), kyunki paanch carbon atom kai tarah se yaug kar sakte hain.

qe: What is the 'Functional Group' in Carboxylic Acids?
qh: कार्बोक्जिलिक अम्लों में कौन सा क्रियात्मक समूह होता है?
e: Kaarbo-sheeli amron (carboxylic acids) mein -COOH kriya-sheel samooh hota hai, jismein carbon double bandhan ke saath ek oxygen (C=O) tatha ek -OH samooh dono ke saath juda hota hai - isiliye inke gun acid jaise tatha aldehya jaise dono lagte hain. Isi samooh ke karan in mein khatta swap tatha rang pariksha (litmus test) ka dhan parinaam milta hai (jaise acetic acid, formic acid, palmitic acid). Iske ulat -CHO aldehydes ka, -OH alcohol ka, tatha -CO- ketones ka samooh hota hai, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: carboxylic acid ka kriya-sheel samooh -COOH hota hai; isi karan ye aml (acid) jaise byavhaar dete hain tatha amal-se (ester) banate hain.

qe: Which substance is used in 'Lead' pencils?
qh: लेड पेंसिल में वास्तव में क्या प्रयुक्त होता है?
e: Lead ki pencil ke andar graphite ka patla danda lagta hai, tatha 'lead' naam purani galatfehmi ki den hai (lekin usme sisa nahi hota) - graphite sasta, aasaani se chikna hone wala tatha kaagaz par saaf nishan chhodne wala padarth hai. Isi gun ke karan graphite ko bina tel ke snigdhak (dry lubricant) tatha 'high temperature' tak chalne wale bhi istemal kar sakte hain (koyle ki tulna mein jala nahi, kyunki wo bina hawa kaam karta hai). Heere se pencil likhi nahi ja sakti, kyunki wo bahut kathor hai tatha kaagaz ko cheer dega; isliye graphite hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: pencil ke andar graphite hota hai, kyunki uski paratein kaagaz par asaani se chikni parat chhod kar saaf nishan banati hain.

qe: What is the process of 'Hydrogenation' of vegetable oils?
qh: वनस्पति तेलों का 'हाइड्रोजनीकरण' क्या है?
o: Adding hydrogen to unsaturated fats to make them saturated (Ghee)
e: Vanaspati tel mein kamee ke bandhan hone ke karan wo drav hota hai; ushe hydrogen ke saath tatha nikal (catalyst) ki maujoodgi mein garam karne par double bandhan par hydrogen jud jaati hai tatha wo sat-reekh (saturated) ho kar ghana (solid) ban jaata hai, jise vanaspati ghee kehte hain. Isi kriya ko hydrogenation kehte hain tatha isi ke aadhaar par banaspati ghee ka udyog chalta hai (tel se ghee). Iske ulat paani ya vaayu jaisi kriya se ye badlav nahi hota; isliye 'adding hydrogen to unsaturated fats' wala jod sahi hai. Isi kriya ke niyantran ke anusar ghee ki mulaayamata ka barqarar rakha jaata hai. Exam point: hydrogenation mein asantript tel mein hydrogen jod kar ushe santript ghan (vanaspati ghee) banaya jaata hai (nikal catalyst ki maujoodgi mein).

qe: Which 'Alcohol' is poisonous and can cause blindness if consumed?
qh: कौन सा अल्कोहल अत्यधिक विषैला होता है और इसके सेवन से अंधापन हो सकता है?
e: Methanol (CH3OH) ek anu-kam alcohol hai jo jigar mein zaherile ayano tatha bhanwar (acidosis) paida karta hai; ye aankh ki sookhi parat ko vikrit karke andhadho (blindness) tak paida kar sakta hai tatha badi matara mein praan-ghaatak hai. Isi karan industrai (industrial) alcohol ya kaala-raashan (denatured) roop mein milne wale padarth ko kabhi naasne-paasne ke liye istemal nahi karna chahiye; ise khane ke liye banaye gaye sharab mein milana gair-kaununi hai. Ethanol iske ulat sharab mein peene-yogya hota hai (par adhik matara mein haanikarak), tatha isopropanol sanitizer ka kaam karta hai. Isliye methanol hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: methanol zahari alcohol hai jo andhapan tatha mrityu bhi kar sakta hai; isi karan diye gaye jodon mein se 'methanol' hi is prashn ka sahi uttar hai.

qe: What is the 'Main Component' of Biogas?
qh: बायोगैस का मुख्य घटक क्या है?
e: Biogas (gobar gas) mein methane sabse adhik hisse mein hota hai (lagbhag 50-70 pratishat), kyunki ye geele gobar, kachre tatha bekaar faslon ko bina hawa ke galaakar (anaerobik digester mein) banaayi jaati hai; baaki hisse mein CO2 tatha chhoti matara mein nitrogen, hydrogen tatha H2S hote hain. Isi methane ke karan ye gas jalne yogya hoti hai tatha gaoN mein khane-pakane tatha bhaap (batti) ke liye istemal hoti hai, tatha iske kyaare (slurry) ko khaad ke roop mein bhi kam mein laate hain. Iske ulat usmein hydrogen ya butane mukhya nahi hoti, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: biogas ka mukhya hissa methane hota hai (lagbhag 50-70%); isi karan ye gas jalne yogya hoti hai tatha anaerobik galaav se paida hoti hai.

qe: What is 'Denatured Alcohol'?
qh: विकृत अल्कोहल (Denatured Alcohol) क्या है?
o: Ethanol mixed with poisonous substances like Methanol to make it undrinkable
e: Denatured alcohol (kaala raashan) wo ethanol hota hai jismein jaan-boojh kar zehirile padarth (jaise methanol, pyridine tatha nila rang) mila diye jaate hain, taaki ushe peene ke liye istemal na kiya ja sake - isse udyog mein sasti (bakaya-mukt) alcohol mil jaati hai tatha sarkari kar se bacha ja sakta hai. Isi karan ise 'kaala' ya 'bina-peene yogya' bhi kehte hain, kyunki ismein mile zaher se andhaapan tatha mrityu tak ho sakti hai. Iske ulat sodhe hue bina wali tatha 'rectified spirit' (95% ethanol) peene ke liye nahi hoti, par usmein alag zaher nahi milaaye jaate - isliye ye naam sahi nahi. Exam point: denatured alcohol mein ethanol ke saath zehirile padarth (jaise methanol) mila diye jaate hain, taaki wo bina-peene yogya ho jaaye tatha sauda-industrai (industrial) kaam ke liye mil sake.

qe: What is the 'Functional Group' in Aldehydes?
qh: एल्डिहाइड का क्रियात्मक समूह क्या है?
e: Aldehydes mein -CHO kriya-sheel samooh hota hai, jismein carbon ke saath ek oxygen double bandhan (C=O) se tatha ek hydrogen seedha juda hota hai (R-CHO). Isi samooh ke karan aldehydes halke (reduce) hone ka gun dikhate hain - ye Fehling tatha Tollens abhikarmak se laal-avashep (red precipitate) tatha chaandi ka sheesha (silver mirror) dete hain (jaise formaldehyde, acetaldehyde). Iske ulat ketones ka -CO- , alcohol ka -OH tatha acid ka -COOH samooh hota hai, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: aldehydes ka kriya-sheel samooh -CHO hota hai; isi karan ye oxide tatha chaandi-avashep wali abhikriya (Tollens test) dete hain.

qe: Which acid is present in 'Vinegar'?
qh: सिरके में कौन सा अम्ल पाया जाता है?
e: Vinegar mein ek vaigyanik amal (acetic acid, jise ethanoic acid bhi kehte hain) lagbhag 5-8 pratishat paani mein ghuli hui matara mein hoti hai; ye falon ke rase mein hawa ki maujoodgi mein bacteria ke asar se banti hai. Iska istemal achar, chatni, sirkah (vinegar) tatha safai tatha bhandaron ke parikshan mein hota hai; iski tez gandh tatha khatta swap isi acid ki den hai. Iske ulat citric acid nimbu tatha santre mein, tatha lactic acid dahi tatha chhachh mein hota hai - yani wo padarth alag hain, isliye is prashn ka sahi jod acetic acid hai. Exam point: vinegar mein acetic acid (ethanoic acid) hota hai; yahi khatta swap tatha tez gandh deta hai tatha achar mein bhi yahi kam karta hai.

qe: What is the 'Bonding' in Diamond?
qh: हीरे में किस प्रकार का रासायनिक आबंधन होता है?
e: Heere mein har carbon atom apne padosi chaar carbon ke saath ek sahayogi (covalent) bandhan banata hai, isliye poora dhancha ek bina-ghoomne wala (rigid) thir-aayam (three-dimensional) jala banta hai jismein koi mukta electron ya aayan nahi hota. Isi karan heera vidyut ka kharab chaalak hai (usmein free electron nahi hote), tatha iski kathorta tatha rangheen safai bhi isi bandhan ki den hai. Graphite tatha metals ke vaaN (contrast) mein heere ka bandhan sahayogi (sharing) hota hai, aaynik ya dhaatui nahi; isliye wo 3550 degree C par bhi asaadhaaran (exceptional) hai. Exam point: heere mein carbon atomon ke beech sahayogi (covalent) bandhan hote hain - isi karan wo sabse kathor tatha vidyut ka kharab chaalak hota hai.

qe: Which hydrocarbon is known as 'Ethylene'?
qh: किस हाइड्रोकार्बन को सामान्य भाषा में एथिलीन कहा जाता है?
e: Ethene (CH2=CH2) ko uske purane naam 'ethylene' se bhi jaana jaata hai, isliye dono ek hi gas hain - ye ek asantript hydrocarbon hai jiska sutra CnH2n hota hai. Yahi gas fal pilaane ke liye itna prachlit hai tatha polythene (plastic) banane ka mukhya kaam-yogy (monomer) hota hai; ise poly (e)thene ke liye bahut bade paimane par banaya jaata hai. 'Ethylene' shabd ka arth hi do carbon (eth) wala double bandhan (ylene ka matlab alken) hai; ethene ke naam se ye naam purane vyavharik (IUPAC-purv) naam ke roop mein aata hai. Exam point: 'ethylene' ka IUPAC naam ethene (CH2=CH2) hai; ye ek asantript hydrocarbon hai jise polythene banane tatha fal pilaane mein istemal karte hain.

qe: What is 'Rectified Spirit'?
qh: रेक्टिफाइड स्पिरिट क्या है?
e: Rectified spirit wo ethanol hota hai jismein lagbhag 95.6 pratishat ethanol tatha 4.4 pratishat paani hota hai - ise aasav (distillation) ke zariye 'rectification' se banaya jaata hai, isliye iska naam rectified spirit pada. Is me paani ki matara kuchh isi karan bachi rehti hai ki ethanol tatha paani ek azeotropik mishran banate hain tatha saadharan aasav se 100% shuddh ethanol nikaalna sambhav nahi (use 'absolute alcohol' ke liye anya reeti lagti hai). Isi karan ye peene ke liye kabhi nahi banaya jaata, balki industrai (industrial) kaam tatha anya rasayan ke liye banaya jaata hai. Exam point: rectified spirit lagbhag 95% ethanol tatha 5% paani ka mishran hota hai; 100% shuddh ethanol aasav se nahi milta, kyunki wo paani ke saath azeotropik (sthir anupat) mishran banata hai.

qe: Which 'Carbon' allotrope is used in making 'Carbon Nanotubes'?
qh: कार्बन नैनोट्यूब बनाने के लिए कार्बन के किस रूप का संबंध है?
e: Carbon nanotubes banti hain jab graphite ki ek ya kai paratein belly (roll) kar ke naali (tube) ka roop le leti hain; yahi guddi (graphene) se juda hua roop hai, isliye iske aadhaar bindu par fullerene/graphene wagrah sahi hai. Iska samvahan ki kshamata tatha majbooti bahut adhik hoti hai (steel se kai guna), isliye ise halke tatha mazboot padarth, bijli ke electrode tatha sensor banane mein istemal karte hain. Iska pura khaanadaan fullerene ki khoj se hi shuru hua tha, isliye ise fullerene se juda roop kehte hain. Exam point: carbon nanotubes ka aadhaar fullerene/graphene wala roop hai (graphite ki parat belly hokar naali banti hai), isliye ise nano-technology ka mahatvapurn padarth maana jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Esterification'?
qh: एस्टरीकरण (Esterification) अभिक्रिया क्या है?
o: Reaction between Alcohol and Carboxylic Acid to form Ester
e: Esterification wo abhikriya hai jismein ek alcohol tatha ek carboxylic acid (aml) aapas mein mil kar ester tatha paani banate hain; ismein aml ke -OH tatha alcohol ke -H ke milne se paani nikalta hai, isliye ye 'sanghanan (condensation)' aa jaisi kriya hai. Iska sahi roop: aml + alcohol se ester + paani (man ki maujoodgi mein sulphuric acid) hota hai; isi kriya se phalon ki gandh (sugandh) wale ester bhi bante hain, jinhe sud-padarth tatha swaad (flavour) mein upyog karte hain. Isi karan sabun (soap) banane mein bhi yahi kriya (sabunikaran) kaam aati hai, jahan ester toot kar soap tatha glycerol banta hai. Exam point: esterification alcohol tatha carboxylic acid ke beech ki abhikriya hai, jismein ester tatha paani banta hai (man acid ki maujoodgi mein).

qe: What is the 'IUPAC' name of Formic Acid?
qh: फॉर्मिक अम्ल का IUPAC नाम क्या है?
e: Formic acid ka IUPAC naam methanoic acid hota hai, kyunki usmein keval ek carbon atom (meth) tatha -COOH samooh hota hai; yahi sabse saral carboxylic acid hai tatha iska anu-sutra HCOOH hota hai. Yahi padarth cheenti ke dank me tatha bichu jagah mein milta hai, tatha isi ke karan is purana naam 'formic' pada. Iske ulat ethanoic (acetic) tatha propanoic acid do-roop tatha teen-roop wale hote hain, isliye is prashn ka sahi jod methanoic acid hai. Exam point: formic acid ka IUPAC naam methanoic acid (HCOOH) hota hai - ye ek hi carbon wala sabse saral carboxylic acid hai jo cheenti ke dank mein paaya jaata hai.

qe: Which substance is used to 'Decolorize' sugar in industry?
qh: उद्योगों में चीनी से अशुद्ध रंग हटाने के लिए क्या उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Shakkar (sugar) ke ras ko rangheen banane ke liye 'animal charcoal' (janvaron ki haddiyon se banaya gaya koyla) ya 'activated charcoal' istemal hota hai, kyunki ismein atyant sookshm chhidra (pores) hote hain jahan rang wale bade anu adsorpt (chipak) jaate hain - isi ko adsorpshan kehte hain. Iska ulat koyle ke aam tukde ya graphite ki patti ye kaam nahi kar sakti, kyunki unmein rang ke anuon ko pakadne layak itni satah nahi hoti. Yahi karan hai ki animal charcoal ko shudhi tatha rang-haran (decolourise) ke liye istemal karte hain, jaise shakkar tatha anya rasayano ke udyog mein. Exam point: shakkar ka rang hataane ke liye animal charcoal (jaanvaron ki haddi ka koyla) istemal hota hai, kyunki uski sookshm chhidra wali satah rang ke anuon ko adsorpt (sobhit) kar leti hai.

qe: What is the suffix used in the IUPAC naming of 'Aldehydes'?
qh: एल्डिहाइड के IUPAC नामकरण में कौन सा प्रत्यय (Suffix) लगता है?
e: Aldehydes ke naam-karan (naming) mein alkane ke naam se 'e' hata kar '-al' pratyay joda jaata hai, isliye ek carbon wale ko methanal (formaldehyde) tatha do carbon wale ko ethanal (acetaldehyde) kehte hain. Ye pratyay IUPAC ka samanya niyam hai: ketone ke liye '-one' (jaise propanone) tatha alcohol ke liye '-ol' (jaise ethanol) hota hai, isliye aldehydes ka samooh alag pehchaana jaata hai. Iske ulat '-CHO' ek samooh (kriya-sheel samooh) hota hai tatha '-COOH' acid ka, isliye wo naam ke pratyay nahi hain. Exam point: aldehydes ke IUPAC naam ke ant mein '-al' pratyay lagta hai (jaise ethanal tatha methanal), tatha unka kriya-sheel samooh -CHO hota hai.

qe: Which functional group is present in 'Acetone', the common nail polish remover?
qh: नेल पॉलिश रिमूवर 'एसीटोन' में कौन सा क्रियात्मक समूह होता है?
e: Acetone (nail polish remover) mein ketone kriya-sheel samooh (functional group) hota hai, jismein carbon ke saath dono or carbon ya hydrogen ke samooh jude hote hain tatha beech mein C=O bandhan hota hai (R-CO-R). Iska IUPAC naam propanone hota hai tatha ye sabse saral ketone hai; isi samooh ke karan uski tez gandh, aasaani se bhaap banne ka gun tatha tel-grease ko ghulane ki kshamata hoti hai. Iske ulat aldehyde mein C=O ke saath ek hydrogen juda hota hai (R-CHO), alcohol mein -OH tatha acid mein -COOH hota hai, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: acetone mein ketone samooh (C=O beech mein) hota hai - isi karan ye nail polish tatha tel ko aasaani se ghula leta hai.

qe: What is the 'IUPAC name' of the compound $CH_3-CH_2-CHO$?
qh: यौगिक $CH_3-CH_2-CHO$ का IUPAC नाम क्या है?
e: CH3-CH2-CHO mein teen carbon ki seedhi shrankhla hoti hai tatha uske ant (terminal) carbon par -CHO samooh laga hota hai, isliye IUPAC naam propanal banta hai (propan = teen carbon tatha -al = aldehyde). Yahan ye samajhna zaroori hai ki samooh hamesha shrankhla ke ant wale carbon par hona chahiye, tabhi wo -al pratyay paata hai; yadi wo samooh beech wale carbon par hota to ye ketone ban jaata tatha naam propanone hota. Isliye propanal hi sahi naam hai - propan-1-ol mein -OH hota hai tatha propanoic acid mein -COOH hota hai. Exam point: CH3-CH2-CHO ka IUPAC naam propanal hota hai, kyunki teen carbon ke ant par -CHO (aldehyde) samooh laga hota hai.

qe: Which alcohol is known as 'Wood Spirit' because it was originally produced by the destructive distillation of wood?
qh: किस अल्कोहल को लकड़ी के भंजक आसवन से प्राप्त होने के कारण 'वुड स्पिरिट' कहा जाता है?
e: Methanol ko 'wood spirit' (lakdi ki aatma) kehte hain, kyunki purane zamane mein ise lakdi ke bhusey ko bina hawa ke garam karne (destructive distillation) se banaaya jaata tha tatha aasav (distill) mein 'spirit' shabd aane se yahi naam pada. Aaj ise industrai taur par carbon monoxide tatha hydrogen ki abhikriya se banaaya jaata hai tatha ise paint tatha varnish ke liye solvent banakar tatha industrai alcohol ko peene ke liye anupyukt banane mein istemal karte hain. Ye shareer ke liye bahut zehirila hota hai, isliye ise peene se andhaapan ya mrityu tak ho sakti hai. Exam point: methanol ko wood spirit kehte hain, kyunki purwa mein ise lakdi ki aasav-chullu (destructive distillation) se banaya jaata tha.

qe: What is the reaction between an 'Alcohol' and a 'Carboxylic Acid' in the presence of an acid catalyst called?
qh: अम्ल उत्प्रेरक की उपस्थिति में अल्कोहल और कार्बोक्जिलिक अम्ल की अभिक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
e: Alcohol tatha carboxylic acid ko aml (acid) ki maujoodgi mein mila kar garam karne par ester tatha paani banta hai; is abhikriya ko esterification kehte hain, kyunki ismein aml ka -OH hissa tatha alcohol ka -H hissa hat kar paani ban jaata hai (ye samghatan kriya ka roop hai). Jaise ethanoic acid tatha ethanol se ethyl ethanoate milta hai, jiski gandh phalon jaisi hoti hai; isliye is abhikriya ka upyog sugandh tatha swaad (essence) banane mein hota hai. Sulphuric acid yahan utprek (catalyst) ka kaam karta hai tatha paani nikalne mein sahayak hota hai. Exam point: alcohol tatha carboxylic acid ke beech aml-utprek ki maujoodgi mein hone wali is abhikriya ko esterification kehte hain, jismein ester tatha paani banta hai.

qe: In the IUPAC system, what is the name for 'Common Vinegar'?
qh: IUPAC प्रणाली में सिरके के मुख्य घटक का नाम क्या है?
e: Vinegar mein mile aml ka IUPAC naam ethanoic acid hota hai, kyunki ismein do carbon atom tatha -COOH samooh hota hai (ethane se ek hydrogen hata kar -COOH lagane par). Isi karan vyavhar mein ise 'acetic acid' tatha IUPAC mein 'ethanoic acid' kaha jaata hai - dono ek hi padarth ke naam hain. Iska 5-8 pratishat wala patla ghol hi vinegar hota hai jo achar, chatni tatha safai mein istemal hota hai; yahi uski khattas tatha tez gandh ka karan hai. Isliye ethanoic acid hi sahi jod hai, methanoic (ek carbon) ya propanoic (teen carbon) alag acid hote hain. Exam point: common vinegar wale aml ka IUPAC naam ethanoic acid (acetic acid) hota hai, kyunki usmein do carbon tatha -COOH samooh hote hain.

qe: Which functional group is represented by $-O-$ between two alkyl groups?
qh: दो एल्किल समूहों के बीच $-O-$ जुड़ा होने पर कौन सा क्रियात्मक समूह बनता है?
e: Ether kriya-sheel samooh mein ek oxygen atom do alkyl samoohon ke beech mein hota hai (-O-), isliye uska samanya roop R-O-R hota hai; ismein koi -OH ya C=O samooh nahi hota, isliye ye na alcohol ke jaise byavhaar karta hai na ketone ke jaise. Ether aam taur par sheela (volatile) tatha agni-grasak (highly inflammable) hote hain, isliye purane zamaane mein inhe nishaani (anesthesia) ke roop mein istemal karte the; aaj ye ghol (solvent) ke roop mein kam aate hain. Isi karan 'do alkyl samoohon ke beech -O-' wala vikalp hi sahi jod hai - alcohol, aldehyde tatha ketone ke samooh isse alag hote hain. Exam point: do alkyl samoohon ke beech -O- wala kriya-sheel samooh ether hota hai (samanya roop R-O-R, jise diethyl ether jaise roop mein istemal karte hain).

qe: What is the common name for 'Methanal'?
qh: मेथेनल (Methanal) का सामान्य नाम क्या है?
e: Methanal (HCHO) ka purana vyavharik naam formaldehyde hai tatha uske 40 pratishat paani wale ghol ko formalin kehte hain, jise jeev-vigyan (biology) mein namuno (specimen) tatha tibbi taur par disinfected karne ke liye istemal karte hain. Yahi sabse saral aldehyde hai, isliye iska naam 'meth' (ek carbon) tatha '-al' (aldehyde pratyay) se banta hai; ye tez gandh wali, paani mein aasaani se ghulne wali gas hai. Formalin ki kriya protein ko jama karne wali hoti hai, isliye ye jeevon tatha kachre ko sadne se rokta hai. Exam point: methanal ka common naam formaldehyde hota hai aur uske paani wale ghol ko formalin kehte hain, jo jeev tatha tibbi namuno ko sambhalne mein istemal hota hai.

qe: Which alcohol is used in 'Thermometers' for measuring very low temperatures in cold climates?
qh: अत्यधिक ठंडे प्रदेशों में तापमान मापने वाले थर्मामीटर में किस अल्कोहल का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Ethanol (ethyl alcohol) ka jamaank bahut kam (lagbhag -114 degree C) hota hai, isliye thande mausam tatha dhruviya (polar) kshetron mein tapman bahut neeche jaane par bhi wo thermometer mein drav roop mein hi rehta hai tatha paimana tootta nahi - yahi karan hai ki Russia tatha Canada jaise thande deshon ke thermometer mein ethanol (ya usme rang mila kar) bharte hain. Paare (mercury) ka jamav bindu -39 degree C hota hai, isliye usse itna thanda tapman nahi maapa ja sakta. Ethanol ka chaalak gun bhi is kaam mein sahayak hota hai, kyunki wo kaanch par asar nahi karta tatha saaf dikhta hai. Exam point: bahut thande climate ke thermometer mein ethanol bharte hain, kyunki uska jamaank lagbhag -114 degree C hai (paare ka -39 degree C se kaafi kam).

qe: What is 'Glacial Acetic Acid'?
qh: ग्लेशियल एसिटिक एसिड क्या है?
o: Pure ethanoic acid (100%) that freezes into ice-like crystals
e: Glacial acetic acid shuddh (100%) ethanoic acid hota hai tatha 16.6 degree C se neeche thanda hone par ye barf jaisi safed thos (crystals) ke roop mein jama jaata hai - isi 'barf' jaisi sajaavat ke karan ise glacial (hima) kaha jaata hai. Ise 'glacial' kehne ka koi sambandh paani ke barf se nahi, balki iske khud ke jamav se hai; iska jamav bindu saadharan kamre ke tapman se thoda upar hi hota hai, isliye thande mausam mein bottle ke andar ye thos dikhta hai. Yahi acid vinegar ka mukhya hissa hota hai (5-8% par), par shuddh roop bahut sanghatan-karak (corrosive) hota hai tatha jild par chot kar deta hai. Exam point: glacial acetic acid shuddh (100%) ethanoic acid hota hai jo thande tapman par barf jaisa thos ban jaata hai - isi liye ise glacial kaha jaata hai.

qe: Which enzyme converts 'Sugar' into 'Ethanol' during fermentation?
qh: किण्वन के दौरान शर्करा को एथेनॉल में बदलने वाला एंजाइम कौन सा है?
e: Sukroze (sugar) ko yisht (fermentation) ke dauran zymase enzyme ki sahayata se ethanol tatha carbon dioxide mein todta hai; yahi enzyme yisht mein hi maujood hota hai tatha isi karan sharab, beer tatha desi taur par bhi yisht ki abhikriya se alcohol banti hai. Ye enzyme zinda yisht ke bheetar hota hai, isliye pehle yisht ko sukroze ke ghol mein daal kar garm (par ubalne se kam) tapman par rakha jaata hai - tabhi abhikriya chalti hai. Isi silsile ki anya enzyme (jaise invertase) pehle sukroze ko glucose tatha fructose mein todti hai, jise aage zymase ethanol mein badalta hai. Exam point: yisht ka zymase enzyme hi khaand (sugar) ko ethanol tatha CO2 mein badalta hai; yahi klassik yisht abhikriya hai jo sharab banaati hai.

qe: What is the 'IUPAC name' of $CH_3-CO-CH_2-CH_3$?
qh: $CH_3-CO-CH_2-CH_3$ का IUPAC नाम क्या है?
e: CH3-CO-CH2-CH3 mein chaar carbon atom hote hain tatha C=O samooh doosre carbon par laga hota hai, isliye IUPAC naam butan-2-one banta hai (butan = chaar carbon, '-one' = ketone tatha 2 = samooh ki sthiti). Yahan sthiti ka aankda 2 likhna zaroori hai, kyunki samooh doosre carbon par hai; isi karan ye sashthanon (positional) samrop bhi dikhata hai (butanone aur butanal abhinna nahi hote). Isi tarah methyl ethyl ketone (MEK) vyavhar mein isi padarth ko kehte hain, jo paint tatha glue ke udyog mein ghol ke roop mein kaam aata hai. Exam point: CH3-CO-CH2-CH3 ka IUPAC naam butan-2-one hota hai, kyunki usmein chaar carbon tatha doosre carbon par ketone samooh hota hai.

qe: Which property of 'Esters' makes them useful in the food and perfume industries?
qh: एस्टर का कौन सा गुण उन्हें खाद्य और इत्र उद्योग में उपयोगी बनाता है?
e: Ester ka mukhya gun yahi hai ki uski gandh phalon jaise mithaayi wali hoti hai (jaise kele ka ester isoamyl acetate tatha pineapple ka ethyl butyrate), isliye jilebi ki sugandh tatha mithaiyan bhi ester ki den hoti hain. Isi gun ke karan ester ko khadyon ke swaad tatha sugandh (flavour) badhane ke liye tatha itra ke udyog mein sugandh-mishran banane ke liye istemal karte hain. Iske ulat unka tez khatta swap, zehirila gun ya vidyut chaalakta unke kaam ke nahi hain; isliye 'fruity smell' hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: ester ka upayog falon wali mitha gandh ke karan hi khane-pine tatha sugandh (perfume) ke udyog mein hota hai - yehi unka khaas gun hai.

qe: What is 'Saponification' chemically?
qh: रासायनिक रूप से साबुनीकरण (Saponification) क्या है?
e: Sabunikaran (saponification) mein ester (jise drav tel ya ghee ke roop mein lete hain) ke saath sodiye/sodium ya potassium hydroxide jaisa kshatriyak (base) mila kar garam kiya jaata hai, isse ester toot kar sabun (sodium salt of fatty acid) tatha glycerol banta hai - yani ye ester ka ksheerajal apghatan (alkaline hydrolysis) hai. Iska samikaran: tel/ghee + NaOH se sabun + glycerol; yahi karan hai ki purane taur par lakdi ki rakh se sabun banate the tatha aaj bhi sabun banaane ka yahi udyog hai. Ek hi roop mein aml (acid hydrolysis) se bhi ester toot sakta hai, par tab sabun ke bajaye fatty acid hi milta hai. Exam point: sabunikaran ester ka ksheerajaliya (alkaline) apghatan hai - ismein tel/ghee ke ester se sabun tatha glycerol banta hai.

qe: Which gas is evolved when 'Ethanoic Acid' reacts with Sodium Bicarbonate ($NaHCO_3$)?
qh: एथेनोइक अम्ल की सोडियम बाइकार्बोनेट ($NaHCO_3$) के साथ अभिक्रिया पर कौन सी गैस निकलती है?
e: Ethanoic acid (acetic acid) ek kamzor aml hai tatha sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3) jaisa carbonated (bicarbonate) amal (base) ke saath milne par ye CO2 gas chhodta hai, isliye jhaag tatha bulbuti dikhti hai. Ye abhikriya isi karan aml ki pehchaan (test) ke liye bhi istemal hoti hai, tatha isi par soda water tatha baking powder ka siddhant bhi tika hai (yani acid + bicarbonate se CO2 gas). Iske ulat bahut kamzor aml (jaise paani mein alkali) ya alcohol ke saath ye gas nahi nikalta, isliye anya vikalp galat hain. Exam point: ethanoic acid aur sodium bicarbonate ki abhikriya se carbon dioxide (CO2) gas nikalta hai - yahi jhaag wala baubble is abhikriya ki pehchaan hai.

qe: What is 'Power Alcohol'?
qh: 'पावर अल्कोहल' क्या है?
e: Power alcohol (shakti-alcohol) ethanol tatha petrol ka mishran hota hai, jise aam taur par 20 hisse ethanol tatha 80 hisse petrol ke anupat mein banate hain; ise chakra ke indhan (motor fuel) ke roop mein istemal karte hain. Iska fayda yahi hai ki ganna tatha anya faslon se bane ethanol se petrol ki kham (import) kam hoti hai tatha jalne se nikalne wala dhuan bhi kam hota hai (isliye ise harit indhan kaha jaata hai). Isi tarah petrol mein 5-10 pratishat ethanol milane wale indhan ko E5 tatha E10 kehte hain, jo aaj bharat mein bhi bechaa jaata hai. Exam point: power alcohol ethanol tatha petrol ka mishran hota hai (lagbhag 20:80 anupat mein), jise chakra ke indhan ke roop mein istemal karte hain.

qe: Which alcohol has 'three' -OH groups and is used as a moisturizer in cosmetics?
qh: किस अल्कोहल में तीन -OH समूह होते हैं और सौंदर्य प्रसाधनों में मॉइस्चराइजर की तरह प्रयुक्त होता है?
e: Glycerol (glycerine) ka anu-sutra C3H8O3 hota hai tatha usmein teenon carbon atom par ek-ek -OH samooh juda hota hai, isliye ise tri-alcohol ya trihydroxy alcohol kehte hain. Yahi paani ko sookh rakhne wali kshamata (moisture-absorbing gun) deta hai, isliye ise cream, lotion tatha anya saundarya-padarth (cosmetics) mein namak (moisturizer) ke roop mein milaate hain; ye swaad mein mitha hone ke karan khadyon mein bhi milta hai. Yahi padarth sabun banaane ke samay up-utpad (by-product) ke roop mein nikalta hai tatha dhamake wale padarth (nitroglycerine) ka aadhaar bhi banta hai. Exam point: glycerol (glycerin) mein teen -OH samooh hote hain tatha isi karan ye namak (moisturizer) ke roop mein cosmetics mein istemal hota hai (sabun banaane ka up-utpad bhi yahi hai).

qe: What is the common name for 'Propanone'?
qh: प्रोपेनोन का सामान्य नाम क्या है?
e: Propanone ka purana vyavharik naam acetone hota hai, tatha ise sabse saral ketone maana jaata hai - ismein teen carbon atom hote hain tatha beech wale carbon par C=O samooh laga hota hai. Yahi nail polish remover tatha paint thinner ke roop mein istemal hota hai, kyunki ye tel, grise tatha paint jaise padarthon ko aasaani se ghula leta hai; iski tez gandh aur aasaani se bhaap banne ka gun isi ko is kaam ke liye upyukt banata hai. Isse kaushal taur par laboratory mein ghol (solvent) tatha saafai ke liye bhi lete hain. Exam point: propanone ka common naam acetone hota hai; yahi sabse saral ketone hai jo nail polish tatha paint ko ghulane ke liye istemal hota hai.

qe: In IUPAC naming, what does the suffix '-oic acid' represent?
qh: IUPAC नामकरण में '-oic acid' प्रत्यय किसे दर्शाता है?
e: IUPAC naam mein '-oic acid' pratyay carboxylic acid (kaarboksil aml) ko batata hai, kyunki ismein carbon ke saath -COOH samooh hota hai (jaise ethanoic acid, methanoic acid, propanoic acid). Isi pratyay ko dekh kar hi pata chal jaata hai ki padarth aml hai tatha wo nila litmus ko laal karega, carbonate ke saath CO2 dega tatha ester banayega. Iske ulat '-ol' alcohol ka, '-al' aldehyde ka, '-one' ketone ka tatha '-oate' ester ka pratyay hota hai, isliye inhe milana galat hoga. Exam point: '-oic acid' pratyay carboxylic acid batata hai (jaise ethanoic acid) - isi pratyay se aml ka gun tatha uski abhikriyaayein pata chalti hain.

qe: Which chemical is used to 'Denature' ethanol for industrial use?
qh: औद्योगिक उपयोग के एथेनॉल को पीने अयोग्य बनाने (Denature करने) के लिए क्या मिलाया जाता है?
e: Ethanol ko bina-peene-yogya (denatured) banane ke liye usmein methanol ya pyridine jaisa zehirila padarth mila diya jaata hai, taaki sasti industrai alcohol ka galat upyog na ho; yahin se ishe 'denatured' kaha jaata hai. Ismein mile zaher ke aankde itne khatarnaak hote hain ki peene par aankhon ki roshni ja sakti hai ya jaan bhi ja sakti hai, isliye ishe kabhi bhi naas-paas ke padarthon mein shamil nahi karna chahiye. Pyridine ki tez badbu khud hi saavdhani kar deti hai tatha nila rang milaane se iski pehchaan aasaan ho jaati hai. Exam point: ethanol ko industrai kaam ke liye denatured banane mein methanol ya pyridine jaisa zaher milaaya jaata hai, taaki wo bina-peene yogya ho jaaye.

qe: What is the bond angle in 'Ethene' ($C_2H_4$)?
qh: एथीन ($C_2H_4$) में बंध कोण कितना होता है?
e: Ethene (C2H4) mein dono carbon atom double bandhan se jude hote hain tatha har carbon par do-do hydrogen hoti hain; double bandhan ke karan poora anu ek samtal (plane) mein sthir ho jaata hai tatha bandhan-kon lagbhag 120 degree hota hai. Yahi karan hai ki ethene ke sabhi atom ek samtal par lete hain, isliye uski sajaavat samtal (planar) kahalati hai; iske ulat methane ka kon 109.5 degree hota hai, kyunki wahan chaar bandhan teen-aayam (3D) roop mein faile hote hain. Isi 120 degree kon tatha samtal sajaavat ke karan ethene cis-trans samropan bhi dikhata hai. Exam point: ethene mein bandhan-kon lagbhag 120 degree hota hai (samtal sajaavat), kyunki double bandhan ke karan wahan teenon atom samooh ek hi samtal mein rehte hain.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Saturated' fatty acid?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक 'संतृप्त' वसीय अम्ल (Saturated Fatty Acid) है?
e: Stearic acid (C17H35COOH) ek santript fatty acid hota hai, kyunki uski lambi hydrocarbon shrankhla mein koi double bandhan nahi hota - isliye usmein hydrogen se bhar chuke carbon hote hain tatha wo kamre ke tapman par thos rehta hai. Isi tarah palmitic acid bhi santript hai, jabki oleic tatha linoleic acid asantript hote hain (unki shrankhla mein ek ya adhik C=C bandhan hote hain) tatha kamre ke tapman par drav (tel) hote hain. Yahi antar khane wale tel tatha ghee ke gun mein dikhta hai - ghee mein santript fatty acid adhik hote hain, isliye wo thos hota hai. Exam point: stearic acid ek santript fatty acid hai, kyunki uski shrankhla mein koi double bandhan nahi hota (isi karan wo thos tatha sthir hota hai).

qe: What is 'Tincture of Iodine' composed of?
qh: टिंचर आयोडीन किसका विलयन होता है?
e: Tincture of iodine iodine ki thodi matara (lagbhag 2-7 pratishat) ko ethanol tatha paani ke mishran mein ghula kar banaaya jaata hai, isliye ye ek 'tincture' (alcohol wala ghol) hota hai. Iska istemal kaat (cut), chot tatha operation se pehle jild ko jivanu-mukt (antiseptic) karne ke liye hota hai; ethanol jald bhaap ban kar sookh jaata hai tatha iodine jivanuon ko maar deta hai. Iske ulat iodine ko keval paani mein ghulana mushkil hota hai (wo ghulta nahi), isliye uske liye potassium iodide milana padta hai - isi karan ethanol wala ghol alag hote hain. Exam point: tincture of iodine mein iodine ko ethanol tatha paani ke mishran mein ghulaya jaata hai, aur ise jild par antiseptic ke roop mein lagaya jaata hai.

qe: Which 'Aldehyde' is found in Cinnamon?
qh: दालचीनी में कौन सा एल्डिहाइड मुख्य सुगंध घटक होता है?
e: Cinnamon (dalchini) ki khaas gandh tatha swaad usmein maujood cinnamaldehyde aldehyd se aata hai; ismein ek badi sugandhit shrankhla tatha -CHO samooh hota hai, isliye ye aldehydes ke parivar ka sadasya hai tatha saadharan tapman par halka peela drav hota hai. Yahi padarth dalchini ke chhalke se praapt hota hai tatha ise khane-pine, khadya-sugandh tatha sugandhit tel (perfume) mein istemal karte hain; isi ke kaaran dalchini ka swaad 'metha' tatha sugandh itni tez lagti hai. Iske ulat benzoic acid (preservative) ya vanillin alag padarth hain, isliye wo jod galat honge. Exam point: cinnamon mein maujood aldehyd cinnamaldehyde hota hai, jiski tez sugandh tatha -CHO samooh hi dalchini ki khaas pehchaan banate hain.

qe: What is the IUPAC name for 'Wood Alcohol'?
qh: वुड अल्कोहल का IUPAC नाम क्या है?
e: Wood alcohol (lakdi ki aasav se milne wala) ka IUPAC naam methanol hota hai; usmein ek hi carbon tatha ek -OH samooh hota hai, isliye 'meth' tatha '-ol' jodkar yahi naam banta hai. Ye halka, rangheen tatha tez gandh wala drav hota hai tatha paani mein poori tarah ghul jaata hai; isi karan ye rasayanik laboratory tatha paint-varnish udyog mein ghol (solvent) ke roop mein upyogi hai. Iski sabse badi savdhani yahi hai ki ye bahut zehirila hai - thodi matara bhi aankhon ki roshni chhin sakti hai, isliye ishe ethanol ka vikalp kabhi nahi samajhna chahiye. Exam point: wood alcohol ka IUPAC naam methanol (CH3OH) hota hai - ek carbon wala yahi alcohol lakdi ki aasav-chullu se milta tha tatha bahut zehirila hota hai.

qe: Which functional group makes a compound 'Acidic'?
qh: कौन सा क्रियात्मक समूह कार्बनिक यौगिक को अम्लीय गुण प्रदान करता है?
e: Kis compound mein acidic gun (khattas) hota hai ye uske kriya-sheel samooh par nirbhar karta hai; -COOH (carboxyl) samooh mein ek H atom aisi jagah se juda hota hai ki wo aasaani se ion ke roop mein nikal jaata hai, isliye yahi samooh compound ko amliya (acidic) banata hai (jaise acetic acid, formic acid). Iske ulat -OH wala alcohol kamzor tatha tatha -CHO aldehyd, -CO- ketone tatha -O- ether is gun ko nahi dete, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Isi karan kaarbo-sanyojakon (organic compounds) ki khattas keval unke samooh se tay hoti hai, shrankhla ki lambai se nahi. Exam point: -COOH (carboxyl) samooh hi compound ko acidic banata hai, kyunki usmein se H+ aayan aasaani se nikal jaata hai (jaise ethanoic acid mein).

qe: What is 'Ethyl Ethanoate' an example of?
qh: एथिल एथेनोएट किसका उदाहरण है?
e: Ethyl ethanoate (CH3COOC2H5) mein wahi sajaavat hoti hai jo ester ki pehchaan hai: ek carbon ke saath ek or oxygen double bandhan (C=O) tatha doosri or ek oxygen jiske aage ethyl samooh (-O-CH2CH3) hota hai. Isi sajaavat ke karan iski gandh phalon jaisi mithi hoti hai tatha ye sugandh tatha swaad ke mishranon mein ghol (solvent) ki tarah kaam aata hai; isi parivar ke ester sabunikaran (saponification) mein bhi bante-tutte hain. Acetone, glucose ya alcohol ke samooh (jaise -CO-, -CHO, -OH) isse alag hote hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: ethyl ethanoate ek ester hai, kyunki usmein R-COO-R sajavati hoti hai tatha uski gandh phalon se milti-julti mithi hoti hai.

qe: Which acid is present in 'Sour Milk' or curd?
qh: खट्टे दूध या दही में कौन सा अम्ल होता है?
e: Dahi tatha khatte doodh (sour milk) mein lactic acid hota hai, jo dudh ki shakkar (lactose) par lactic acid bacteria ke asar se banta hai - isi karan dudh khata ho jaata hai tatha uska swaad tatha ghanaapan badal jaata hai. Yahi acid dahi, chhachh tatha anya utpadon mein bhi hota hai tatha ise khane ke preserve (surakshit rakhne) tatha swaad badhane mein istemal karte hain; isi ke karan vyayam ke baad masheshon mein jalan hoti hai. Iske ulat acetic acid sirkah mein tatha tartaric acid imli tatha angoor mein hota hai, isliye wo jod sahi nahi. Exam point: khatte dudh tatha dahi mein lactic acid hota hai, jo lactose par bacteria ke asar se banta hai tatha swaad tatha ghanata dono badal deta hai.

qe: What is the primary difference between 'Soaps' and 'Detergents'?
qh: कठोर जल में साबुन और डिटर्जेंट के कार्य में मुख्य अंतर क्या है?
o: Detergents are effective in hard water; soaps are not
e: Sabun tatha detergent mein mukhya antar yahi hai ki detergent nirvaih (hard water) mein bhi jhaag deta hai tatha kaam karta hai, kyunki usmein sodium soochak (surfactant) ki sajaavat calcium tatha magnesium ke saath avilep (insoluble) laur nahi banati, jabki sabun hard water ke (calcium-magnesium) aaynon ke saath avilep laur banakar bekaar ho jaata hai. Sabun tail-tatha-tel se banta hai tatha jeev-janit (biodegradable) hota hai par hard water mein uski saafai ki kshamata ghat jaati hai; detergent petroleum se banta hai, jyada jhaag deta hai tatha anya jal mein bhi kaam karta hai. Isi karan aaj dhulai ke powder mein detergent adhik hota hai tatha nadiyon mein jhaag dikhti hai (isliye jal pradushan ki samasya bhi banti hai). Exam point: detergent nirvaih tatha anya prakar ke jal mein bhi kaam karta hai jabki sabun hard water mein avilep laur banakar bekaar ho jaata hai.

qe: Which test is used to distinguish between 'Alcohols' and 'Phenols'?
qh: अल्कोहल और फिनोल के बीच अंतर करने के लिए कौन सा रासायनिक परीक्षण किया जाता है?
e: Alcohol tatha phenol mein antar karne ke liye ferric chloride (FeCl3) ka pariksha istemal hota hai - phenol (aur anya anunaad) par ye daalte hi rang badal kar baingani ya nila-bainguni ho jaata hai, jabki aam alcohol ke saath aisa koi rang nahi banta. Iska karan yahi hai ki phenol mein -OH samooh chakra (benzene ring) se juda hone ke karan aayan ban jaata hai tatha iron ke saath rang wala samooh bana leta hai; alcohol mein aisa nahi hota. Iske ulat litmus pariksha, sodium metal ya Tollens abhikarmak se ye dono saaf taur par alag nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: alcohol tatha phenol mein antar karne ke liye ferric chloride (FeCl3) pariksha istemal hoti hai - phenol ke saath ye bainguni rang deta hai, alcohol ke saath nahi.

qe: What is the 'IUPAC name' of $CH_3-CH(OH)-CH_3$?
qh: यौगिक $CH_3-CH(OH)-CH_3$ का IUPAC नाम क्या है?
e: Jab propan ki teen carbon wali shrankhla mein -OH samooh beech wale carbon par hota hai, to ushe propan-2-ol likha jaata hai (aankda 2 uske sathan ko batata hai); yahi compound isopropyl alcohol ke naam se bhi jaana jaata hai. Iski sthiti likhna zaroori hai kyunki ek hi samooh ke alag-alag sthan par alag compound banta hai tatha unke gun badal jaate hain - jaisa propan-1-ol tatha propan-2-ol mein dikhta hai. Isi karan ye sanitizer tatha safai ke gholon (rubbing alcohol) mein bahut prachlit hai tatha jivanuon ko tezi se maarta hai. Exam point: is padarth ka IUPAC naam propan-2-ol hai, kyunki -OH ka sathan doosra carbon hai (isliye naam mein aankda 2 likha jaata hai).

qe: Which substance is used as 'Antifreeze' in car radiators?
qh: कार के रेडिएटर में जमने से रोकने (एंटीफ्रीज) के लिए क्या मिलाया जाता है?
e: Ethylene glycol (1,2-ethanediol) ka jamaank bahut kam (lagbhag -13 degree C) tatha kvathank adhik hota hai, isliye car athava machine ke radiator mein daalne par wo sardi mein jama nahi hota - yahi ushe antifreeze banata hai. Yahi karan hai ki thande deshon mein paani ke saath ise milaya jaata hai, taaki engine ki cooling vyavastha jama kar na toot jaaye; iske saath hi ye radiator ko jang lagna bhi rokta hai. Ye mitha hone ke karan zaherila asar bhi deta hai, isliye iske upyog mein savdhani rakhni padti hai tatha iska prabhav jaanvaron par bhi khatarnaak hota hai. Exam point: car ke radiator mein ethylene glycol ko antifreeze ke roop mein daala jaata hai, kyunki (jamaank ke kaafi kam hone se) ye thande mausam mein jama nahi hota tatha engine ko surakshit rakhta hai.

qe: What is 'Methylated Spirit'?
qh: मेथिलेटेड स्पिरिट क्या है?
e: Jab ethanol mein jaan-bujha kar zehirila padarth mila diya jaata hai (jaise methanol) tatha usme nila rang bhi daal diya jaata hai, to ushe methylated spirit kehte hain; ismein ethanol hote hue bhi wo peene ke liye upyukt nahi rehta. Yahi padarth laboratory tatha furniture ki safai, paint tatha spirit lamp ke liye sasta tatha kar-mukt roop mein milta hai, kyunki iska upyog nasha karne ke liye nahi hota. Yadi koi ishe peeta hai to usme mile zaher se aankhon ki roshni ja sakti hai, isliye ishe savdhani se rakha jaata hai tatha rang ke kaaran iski pehchaan turant ho jaati hai. Exam point: methylated spirit ethanol tatha methanol ka wo mishran hota hai jismein nila rang mila diya jaata hai - isi kaaran ye peene ke liye upyukt nahi hota.

qe: Which chemical is known as 'Oil of Wintergreen'?
qh: 'ऑयल ऑफ विंटरग्रीन' किसे कहा जाता है?
e: 'Oil of wintergreen' (hima-harit tel) abhyasa mein methyl salicylate hota hai, jise wintergreen paudhe se nikaala jaata hai tatha iski tez sugandh tatha tapak (balm) jaise asar ke karan dard-nashak (pain relief) ke liye lagaya jaata hai. Iska rasayanik roop salicylic acid ka ester hota hai, isliye yahi ester kaum ko bhi sugandh tatha dard-nashak mele (gel) ke roop mein kaam aati hai; yahi padarth chhote bachcho ke liye zehirila ho sakta hai. Iske ulat estragon ya other oil (jaise clove oil ka eugenol) alag padarth hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: oil of wintergreen ka rasayanik naam methyl salicylate hota hai, jise uski tez sugandh tatha dard-nashak asar ke karan lagaya jaata hai.

qe: What is the suffix for 'Ketones' in IUPAC naming?
qh: कीटोन के IUPAC नामकरण में कौन सा प्रत्यय लगता है?
e: Ketone ke IUPAC naam mein alkane ka ant '-e' hata kar '-one' joda jaata hai tatha C=O ke sathan ke hisaab se aankda bhi likha jaata hai, jaise propanone tatha butan-2-one. Isi pratyay se saaf pata chalta hai ki samooh beech wale carbon par hai, isliye wo aldehyd jaisa ant (terminal) byavhaar nahi dikhata. Iske vipreet aldehyd ke naam ke ant mein '-al' lagta hai (jaise ethanal), isliye dono ke pratyay alag rakhen tatha unhe milaayein nahi. Exam point: ketones ke naam ke ant mein '-one' lagta hai (jaise propanone tatha butan-2-one), tatha C=O samooh ka sathan bhi likha jaata hai.

qe: Which 'Aldehyde' is used as a 'Silvering agent' for mirrors in the lab?
qh: प्रयोगशाला में दर्पण निर्माण (Tollen's Test) में कौन से यौगिक चांदी की परत जमाते हैं?
e: Tollen's abhikarmak (ammoniakal silver nitrate) aldehydes ke saath abhikriya kar ke chandni (silver) ki patli parat deewar par jama kar deta hai - ise 'silver mirror test' kehte hain. Isliye asli survey mein kisi bhi aldehyd ka istemal mirror ki silvering ke liye ho sakta hai (jaise methanal ya ethanal), kyunki aldehyd ka -CHO samooh aise kam (reduce) karke chandni ko dhatau roop mein badal deta hai. Iske ulat ketone is pariksha mein ye asar nahi deta, isliye yahi aldehyd tatha ketone mein antar karne ka ek aasan tareeka bhi hai. Exam point: mirror par chandni chadhaane (silver mirror) ke liye koi bhi aldehyd istemal ho sakta hai, kyunki aldehyd Tollen's abhikarmak se chandni ko dhatau roop mein jama kar deta hai.

qe: What is the common name of 'Ethanoic Acid'?
qh: एथेनोइक अम्ल का सामान्य नाम क्या है?
e: Ethanoic acid ka purana vyavharik (common) naam acetic acid hota hai; iska 'acet' bhaag sirke (vinegar) se juda hai, kyunki sadhe hue sharab tatha falon ke ras mein yahi amal banta hai tatha 5-8% ghol ke roop mein sirkah ban jaata hai. IUPAC naam ethanoic acid isliye hota hai ki usmein do carbon (eth) tatha -COOH samooh hota hai - dono naam ek hi padarth ke hain, isliye is prashn mein 'acetic acid' sahi jod hai. Yahi acid achar, chutney tatha safai mein bhi istemal hota hai tatha iski tez gandh usi ki pehchaan hai. Exam point: ethanoic acid ka common naam acetic acid hai; yahi sirkah (vinegar) ka mukhya hissa hota hai jo khatta swaad deta hai.

qe: Which acid is found in 'Sting' of a Honeybee?
qh: मधुमक्खी के डंक में कौन सा अम्ल होता है?
e: Madhumakhi (honeybee) ke dank (sting) mein methanoic acid (formic acid) hota hai, jise poorane naam se 'formic acid' bhi kehte hain kyunki wo pehle cheenti (formica) se nikaala gaya tha. Yahi acid dank ke samay jild mein lagta hai tatha jalan tatha dard ka karan banta hai; dank ko neutralize karne ke liye saadharan taur par base jaise baking soda ya sabun (kshariya) lagaya jaata hai. Iska anu-sutra HCOOH hota hai tatha yahi sabse saral carboxylic acid hai, isliye ise anya acid (acetic ya citric) se alag pehchaana jaata hai. Exam point: madhumakhi ke dank mein methanoic acid (formic acid) hota hai; isi karan dank ki jagah par jalan hoti hai tatha ushe kshariya padarth se saaf kiya jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Proof Spirit'?
qh: प्रूफ स्पिरिट क्या है?
e: Proof spirit wo maap-paimana hai jismein alcohol tatha paani ka nishchit anupat tay hota hai; bharat mein proof spirit ko lagbhag 57.1 pratishat ethanol (volume ke hisaab se) wala maana jaata hai tatha usse adhik shuddhata wali sharab ki shuddhata 'over proof' kahi jaati hai. Iska istemal kar (excise) tatha shuddhata (quality) ko tay karne ke liye hota hai, kyunki sirf 'sharab hai' kehne se matara ka pata nahi chalta - isliye proof ka anupat nishchit hona zaroori hai. Iske ulat 95% wala rectified spirit tatha 100% wala absolute alcohol alag-roop hote hain, isliye wo aankde proof spirit ke nahi hain. Exam point: proof spirit mein lagbhag 57.1% (volume) ethanol hota hai - isi anupat se sharab ki shuddhata tatha kar tay ki jaati hai.

qe: Which alcohol is 'Absolute Alcohol'?
qh: परम अल्कोहल (Absolute Alcohol) किसे कहते हैं?
e: Absolute alcohol ka matlab 100 pratishat ethanol (vyavhar mein 99.5 pratishat se adhik) hota hai - isse paani ki matara poori tarah nikaal di jaati hai, isliye ishe 'niravashtha' kaha jaata hai. Ye 95.6 pratishat wale mishran (rectified spirit) se aage badhkar banta hai, kyunki wahin par paani tatha ethanol ka azeotrop bana rehta hai tatha saadharan aasav se paani aur nahi nikalta; iske liye calcium oxide ya benzene jaisi anya reeti lagti hai. Iska upyog shushk (dry) kriyaon tatha anusandhan (research) mein hota hai, kyunki paani ke kaaran kai abhikriyaayein ruk jaati hain. Exam point: absolute alcohol se matlab 100% (poori shuddh) ethanol hota hai, jo paani nikaalne ki vishesh reeti se banta hai kyunki saadharan aasav se 100% ethanol nahi milta.

qe: What is the IUPAC name for $CH_3-CH_2-COOH$?
qh: $CH_3-CH_2-COOH$ का IUPAC नाम क्या है?
e: CH3-CH2-COOH mein teen carbon atom hote hain tatha unki shrankhla ke ant (terminal) kone par -COOH samooh lagta hai, isliye IUPAC naam propanoic acid banta hai (prop = teen carbon tatha '-oic acid' = carboxylic acid). Isi karan ise vyavhar mein propionic acid bhi kehte hain, tatha ye bread tatha anya khadyon mein preserve (surakshit rakhne) ke roop mein istemal hota hai. Iske ulat do carbon wale ethanoic acid tatha chaar carbon wale butanoic acid alag padarth hain, isliye wo jod sahi nahi. Exam point: CH3-CH2-COOH ka IUPAC naam propanoic acid hota hai, kyunki usmein teen carbon tatha ant par -COOH samooh hota hai.

qe: Which functional group is found in 'Perfumes' and 'Artificial Flavors'?
qh: इत्र और कृत्रिम सुगंधों में कौन सा क्रियात्मक समूह सबसे आम है?
e: Ester ki sajaavat R-COO-R hoti hai tatha uski gandh phalon tatha mithaiyon jaisi hoti hai - isi karan ise sugandh tatha swaad badhane ke liye khadyon tatha sugandh (perfume) mein milaate hain. Jaise isoamyl acetate kela jaisi gandh deta hai tatha ethyl butyrate pineapple jaisi; chhote ester kuchh matara mein aise asthir (volatile) hote hain ki unki gandh door tak pahunchti hai. Iske ulat alcohol, ketone ya acid ke samooh ke upyog se sugandh ki kriya itni prabhavi tatha vividh nahi hoti, isliye 'ester' hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: perfume tatha artificial flavour mein ester ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ester ki gandh phalon jaisi mithi tatha tez hoti hai (aisi hi asli sugandh ke liye).

qe: What is 'Bakelite'?
qh: बेकेलाइट क्या है?
e: Bakelite ek thermo-setting polymer (thos-plastic dhaatu) hai jo phenol tatha formaldehyde ke samghatan (condensation) se banta hai, isliye ise phenol-formaldehyde resin bhi kehte hain. Apne thermo-setting gun ke karan ye ek baar sajaane ke baad garam karne par pighalta nahi, isliye ise bijli ke switch, plug, tava ke hath tatha anya garam-tatha-tap wale saman mein istemal karte hain - ye vidyut tatha ushma ka kharab chaalak (insulator) bhi hota hai. Iske ulat keval phenol ya keval formaldehyde padarth (monomer) hote hain, polymer nahi, isliye wo jod sahi nahi. Exam point: Bakelite ek polymer (phenol-formaldehyde resin) hai jo thermo-setting hota hai tatha switch-plug tatha bijli ke saman mein insulator ke roop mein kam aata hai.

qe: Which gas is evolved when 'Ethanol' reacts with Sodium metal?
qh: जब एथेनॉल सोडियम धातु से अभिक्रिया करता है तो कौन सी गैस निकलती है?
e: Ethanol mein sodium metal dala jaaye to uska ek H atom sodium se hisaab mein nikalta hai tatha ethoxide banata hai - saath hi hydrogen gas (H2) ke bulble nikalte hain. Yahi abhikriya yahi dikhati hai ki ethanol ke -OH samooh mein hydrogen kuchh had tak acid jaise byavhaar karta hai tatha iske liye na jin nahi hota; isi se ye pata chalta hai ki ethanol ek kamzor acid hai. Iske ulat CO2 ya O2 gas is abhikriya mein nahi banti, isliye wo jod galat hain; isi karan sodium ko sharab ki bottle mein rakhna khatarnaak hota hai (aag pakad sakti hai).
