Exam point: ethanol tatha sodium metal ki abhikriya se hydrogen gas nikalta hai tatha sodium ethoxide banta hai - isse pata chalta hai ki -OH samooh ka hydrogen hataya ja sakta hai.

qe: What is the 'IUPAC name' of $CH_3-O-CH_3$?
qh: $CH_3-O-CH_3$ का IUPAC नाम क्या है?
e: CH3-O-CH3 mein ek oxygen atom do methyl samoohon ke beech mein hota hai, isliye ise 'methoxy methane' ya 'dimethyl ether' kaha jaata hai - IUPAC mein chhoti shrankhla ko 'methoxy' samooh maankar bada hissa 'methane' ke saath joda jaata hai. Isse pata chalta hai ki ether ke naam mein '-O-' wale hisse ko 'alkoxy' roop mein likha jaata hai tatha baaki hydrocarbon ka naam aage aata hai. Isi karan CH3-O-CH3 ka naam methoxymethane hota hai (dimethyl ether uska common naam hai), tatha methanol ya methanal alag samooh wale padarth hain. Exam point: CH3-O-CH3 ka IUPAC naam methoxymethane hota hai, kyunki usmein oxygen do methyl samoohon ke beech hota hai (common naam dimethyl ether hai).

qe: Which acid is present in 'Tamarind'?
qh: इमली में कौन सा अम्ल उपस्थित होता है?
e: Imli ke khatte swaad ka karan us ke andar maujood tartaric acid hota hai, jo imli ke gudde mein svaabhhavik roop se paaya jaata hai tatha isi se achar, chatni tatha imli ki goli ka khatta tatha chatpata swaad banta hai. Yahi padarth cooking mein khameer (baking) tatha anya mithaiyon mein bhi kam aata hai, kyunki ye khattas ke saath mithaas ko santulit karta hai; ise 'cream of tartar' tatha anya roop mein bhi bechte hain. Iske ulat citric acid nimbu-santre mein tatha acetic acid sirkah mein hota hai, isliye wo jod imli ke liye sahi nahi. Exam point: imli mein tartaric acid hota hai - yahi uske khatte-chatpate swaad ka karan hai tatha achar tatha chatni mein bhi yahi swaad deta hai.

qe: What is 'Pyrolysis' of methane called?
qh: मीथेन का पायरोलिसिस (उच्च ताप पर बिना हवा के गर्म करना) क्या कहलाता है?
e: Methane ko bahut uchch tapman par bina hawa (oxygen) ke garam karne ki kriya ko 'cracking' (ya thermal decomposition) kehte hain, jismein badi anu chhoti anuon mein toot jaati hai - methane se is tarah carbon (kaala) tatha hydrogen gas banti hai, tatha aise hi roop mein ethane-ethylene jaise anya hydrocarbon bhi banti hain. Iska mahatva yahi hai ki petroleum-shodhak (refinery) mein badi hydrocarbon ke chhote tukde kar ke petrol tatha LPG jaise upyogi indhan banaaye jaate hain. Yadi methane ko hawa ki maujoodgi mein jalaya jaaye to wo CO2 tatha paani deta hai (jalan), par tab ye 'cracking' nahi kehlata. Exam point: methane ka uchch tapman par bina hawa ke tootne wala apghatan 'cracking' ya thermal decomposition kehlata hai - isse hydrogen tatha carbon (tatha halke hydrocarbon) milte hain.

qe: Which compound is known as 'Chloroform'?
qh: क्लोरोफॉर्म के नाम से किस यौगिक को जाना जाता है?
e: Chloroform ek saadharan chloro-carbon hota hai jiska anu-sutra CHCl3 hota hai tatha ismein ek carbon par teen chlorine tatha ek hydrogen judi hoti hai; iski tez sugandh tatha kuchh halka nasha asar ke karan ise purane zamaane mein shalya-chikitsa (surgery) mein behoshi (anesthesia) ke liye istemal karte the. Iska vibechan (decomposition) sauraj ki roshni tatha hawa ki maujoodgi mein hone se ise kaale/ dhoop se bachakar (aanbar-colour bottle mein) rakhna padta hai; aaj ise ogranic ghol (solvent) ke roop mein tatha kuchh aushadhiyon mein istemal karte hain. Iske ulat CCl4 (carbon tetrachloride) tatha CH2Cl2 (methylene chloride) alag samooh hain, isliye wo jod galat hain. Exam point: chloroform ka anu-sutra CHCl3 hota hai - ise pehle behoshi ke liye istemal karte the tatha aaj ishe dhoop se bachakar rakha jaata hai (sauraj ki roshni se vibechit hota hai).

qe: What is the 'Structure' of Benzene?
qh: बेंजीन ($C_6H_6$) की संरचना कैसी होती है?
o: Cyclic hexagonal ring with alternate single and double bonds
e: Benzene ki sajaavat ek chakrakar (cyclic) chhat-kon (hexagonal) ring hoti hai jismein chhah carbon atom aapas mein ek-ek antar se (alternate) ek bandhan tatha ek double bandhan se jude hote hain, isliye ushe 'benzene ring' kehte hain. Isi sajaavat ke karan benzene ke khaas gun (sugandh, sthirta tatha substitution abhikriya) banaate hain tatha vahi ushe anya hydrocarbon se alag karta hai; iski anunaad (resonance) ke karan ye asi samaan nahi hota tatha uski shrankhla katt nahi hoti. Iske ulat seedhi shrankhla ya do-ring wale padarth benzene ki sajaavat nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: benzene ki sajaavat chhat-kon (hexagonal) ring hoti hai jismein ek-ek antar se akela tatha double bandhan hote hain - yahi uski khaas pehchaan hai.

qe: Who proposed the 'Hexagonal Ring' structure of Benzene with alternating double bonds?
qh: बेंजीन की एकांतर द्विबंध वाली षट्कोणीय वलय संरचना किसने प्रस्तावित की थी?
e: Benzene ki chhat-kon (hexagonal) ring wali sajaavat tatha ek-ek antar se double bandhan ki kalpana August Kekule ne pesh ki thi, isliye ise 'Kekule structure' ya Kekule ka siddhant kehte hain. Unhone ye dikhaya ki benzene mein chhah carbon ek bandhi hui ring banate hain tatha hydrogen har carbon par ek hoti hai; aage chalkar yahi soch anunaad (resonance) tatha 'chakrakar aayan' wali dhaarna tak pahunchi. Iske ulat Faraday, Dalton ya Lavoisier ke naam benzene ki ring sajaavat se nahi jude, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: benzene ki hexagonal ring wali sajaavat sabse pehle August Kekule ne pesh ki thi, isliye ise Kekule sajaavat (structure) kehte hain.

qe: What is the 'IUPAC name' of Phenol?
qh: फिनोल का व्यवस्थित नाम क्या है?
e: Phenol (C6H5OH) ka IUPAC naam hydroxybenzene hota hai, kyunki usmein benzene ki ring par ek -OH samooh (hydroxyl) laga hota hai - yani yahi benzene ka hydroxy roop hai. Isi samooh ke kaaran phenol mein alcohol ka gun tatha acid ka halka gun dono dikhta hai (ye kamzor acid hota hai tatha ferric chloride se bainguni rang deta hai), isi karan ishe jivanu-nashak tatha plastic (bakelite) banane mein istemal karte hain. Bina -OH wala benzene ya phenyl jaisa koi anya roop phenol ka IUPAC naam nahi hai. Exam point: phenol ka IUPAC naam hydroxybenzene hota hai, kyunki usmein benzene ring par ek -OH samooh laga hota hai (isliye ye kamzor acid bhi hota hai).

qe: Which compound is known as 'Toluene'?
qh: टॉलूईन किसे कहा जाता है?
e: Toluene (methylbenzene) benzene ke chakra (ring) par ek methyl samooh (-CH3) lagne se banta hai, isliye ushe methylbenzene bhi kehte hain; iska anu-sutra C7H8 hota hai. Isi methyl samooh ke karan benzene ki tulna mein toluene thoda kam zehirila tatha aasaani se oxid (toot) hone wala hota hai, isliye ise paint tatha ink mein ghol banane, petrol ki octane sankhya badhane tatha glue ke kaam mein lete hain. Benzene, xylene tatha aniline bilkul alag padarth hote hain, isliye wo jod yahan sahi nahi honge. Exam point: toluene ko methylbenzene kehte hain, kyunki wo benzene ke ring par ek methyl samooh wala padarth hai (C7H8).

qe: What is the product of 'Complete Oxidation' of primary alcohols using acidified $K_2Cr_2O_7$?
qh: अम्लीय $K_2Cr_2O_7$ द्वारा प्राथमिक अल्कोहल के पूर्ण ऑक्सीकरण से क्या बनता है?
e: Kis alcohol ka kya utpad banta hai ye uski koti (primary, secondary, tertiary) par nirbhar karta hai; primary alcohol (jaise ethanol) ka do-chakra oxid (pehle aldehyd, phir aml) ke saath tak oxid hone par carboxylic acid banta hai, isliye acidified K2Cr2O7 ushe seedha acid (ethanoic acid) mein badal deta hai. Iska karan yahi ki primary alcohol ke paas do hydrogen wala karbon hota hai, isliye wo pehle aldehyd tatha aage aml ban jaata hai - jabki secondary alcohol ketone tatha tertiary alcohol aage oxid nahi hota. Isliye yahan 'carboxylic acid' hi sahi utpad hai, ketone ya aldehyd nahi (wo beech ke padav ke utpad hote hain). Exam point: primary alcohol ko acidified K2Cr2O7 se poora oxid karne par carboxylic acid milta hai (do padav wala oxid), isliye yahi sahi utpad hai.

qe: Which gas is evolved when 'Ethyne' is passed through red-hot iron tubes (Polymerization)?
qh: जब एथाइन (एसिटिलीन) को रक्त तप्त लोहे की नली से गुजारा जाता है तो क्या बनता है?
e: Ethyne ko laal-tapak (red hot) loha ki naali se guzaara jaata hai to uske teen molecule aapas mein milkar ek chhah-carbon wala chakra (benzene) bana lete hain - is abhikriya ko polymerikaran (polymerization) ya chakriyakaran (cyclization) kehte hain. Isi kriya se purane taur par benzene banaate the tatha yahi dikhati hai ki teen chhote asantript anu mil kar ek sugandh-chakra (aromatic ring) bana lete hain. Iske ulat ethane ya methane jaisi santript gas aise tapman par chakra nahi banati, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: ethyne ko red-hot iron naali se guzarnne par benzene banta hai (teen ethyne anu milkar ek chakra banate hain) - isi kriya ko polymerization kehte hain.

qe: What is the 'Functional Group' in Phenol?
qh: फिनोल में उपस्थित क्रियात्मक समूह कौन सा है?
e: Phenol (C6H5OH) mein -OH samooh seedha benzene ke chakra par juda hota hai, isliye iske gun alcohol tatha aml dono se thoda-thoda milte hue tatha usi ke sath hi bhinn hote hain; isi khaas roop ko phenolic -OH kaha jaata hai. Isi karan phenol paani mein thoda ghulta hai, ferric chloride ke saath bainguni rang deta hai tatha soda ke saath sodium phenoxide banata hai - aam alcohol (jaise ethanol) ye teeno byavhaar nahi dikhata. Iska matlab yahi hai ki -OH ke saath ring ka jura hona uski khattas badha deta hai, isliye yahin phenol ka khaas samooh hai; -COOH ya -CHO jaise samooh alag padarthon ke hote hain. Exam point: phenol ka kriya-sheel samooh phenolic -OH hota hai - ye seedha benzene chakra par laga hota hai, isliye uske gun alcohol tatha aml dono se alag hote hain.

qe: Which compound is used as a 'Refrigerant' and is known as Freon-12?
qh: प्रशीतक के रूप में प्रयुक्त होने वाला 'फ्रेयॉन-12' (Freon-12) कौन सा है?
e: Freon-12 ek chloro-fluoro carbon (CFC) hai jiska anu-sutra CF2Cl2 hota hai; ye na jalne wala, na zehirila tatha aasaani se drav banne wala padarth hai, isliye ise purane refrigerator tatha air conditioner mein shitalak (refrigerant) ke roop mein istemal karte the. Iski bhaap bahut kam tapman par banti hai tatha ye ghunghuni (compressor) ke tel ke saath ghul jaata hai, isliye ye beeswin sadi ke pahle shitalan (refrigeration) udyog ka mukhya padarth ban gaya. Iska bada nuksan yahi hai ki ye ozone ki parat ko todta hai (Montreal Protocol mein ishe pratibandhit kiya gaya), isliye ab uske sthan par anya padarth istemal hote hain. Exam point: Freon-12 (CF2Cl2) ek CFC shitalak hai; ye ozone ko kshati pahunchaane ke karan ab pratibandhit hai.

qe: What is 'TNT' (Trinitrotoluene) primarily used for?
qh: टीएनटी (TNT) का मुख्य उपयोग क्या है?
e: TNT (trinitrotoluene) ek vistrak (explosive) hai jismein toluene par teen nitro samooh lage hote hain (C6H2CH3(NO2)3); yahi uski vistarak (explosive) shakti ka karan hai, kyunki usmein oxygen andar hi andar bandhi hoti hai tatha achanak tootne par badi urja nikalati hai. Iska mukhya upyog khanan (mining), sadak-tatha-surang banane tatha yuddh ke hathiyaron mein hota hai, kyunki ye bahut sthir hota hai tatha vahan (transport) karne mein aasaani se na phatta. Iske ulat ise dawa ya sugandh ke liye istemal nahi karte, isliye anya vikalp yahan lagu nahi hote. Exam point: TNT ek vistarak (explosive) hai, jise khanan tatha yuddh mein istemal karte hain - ismein toluene par teen nitro samooh hote hain.

qe: What is 'Gammexane' (Lindane) chemically?
qh: गेमेक्सिन (लिंडेन) रासायनिक रूप से क्या है?
e: Gammexane (lindane) benzene hexachloride (BHC) hota hai, jismein benzene ke chakra par chhah chlorine atom lage hote hain (C6H6Cl6 ke ek khaas roop); ise ek prabal kitanu-nashak (insecticide) ke roop mein istemal karte hain tatha yahi DDT ka vikalp tha. Iska ekaantrik (specific) roop (gamma-BHC) tatha sabse adhik kitanu-nashak shakti wala hota hai, isliye ise 'gammexane' kaha jaata hai. Iske ulat ye ek vidyut-rodi (insulator) ya fuel nahi hai, balki keval ek kitanu-nashak hai - iska nuksan yahi hai ki ye chhabee mein jama hokar insaan tatha jeevon ke liye haanikarak ho jaata hai. Exam point: gammexane ka rasayanik naam benzene hexachloride (BHC) hai, jo ek prabal kitanu-nashak hai.

qe: Which compound is formed when 'Phenol' reacts with Zinc dust?
qh: जब फिनोल को जिंक चूर्ण के साथ गर्म किया जाता है तो क्या बनता है?
e: Phenol ka zinc dust (jaste ka churan) ke saath garam kiya jaaye to uske -OH samooh hatt jaata hai (uska oxygen zinc ke saath jud kar zinc oxide banata hai) tatha phenoxide ke sthan par seedha hydrogen aa jaata hai - isliye utpad benzene banta hai. Yahi abhikriya isi baat ka proof hai ki phenol mein -OH kuchh aml jaisa hota hai tatha aise apchayan se hataya ja sakta hai, isliye ishe phenol ka pehla organic rudhaan (reduction) kehte hain. Iske ulat sodium phenoxide ya benzoic acid ke roop mein phenol baadalna in abhikriya ka utpad nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: phenol tatha zinc dust ki abhikriya se benzene banta hai, kyunki phenol ka -OH samooh hat jaata hai tatha wahan hydrogen aa jaata hai.

qe: What is the 'Hybridization' of carbon atoms in Benzene?
qh: बेंजीन के सभी कार्बन परमाणुओं का संकरण (Hybridization) क्या होता है?
e: Benzene ke chhah carbon atom chaar-chaar bandhan nahi banate, balki har carbon teen sigma bandhan (do carbon ke saath tatha ek hydrogen ke saath) banata hai tatha uske paas ek p electron chakra ke bheetar paryaapt (delocalised) ho jaata hai; teen bandhan wale carbon ki hybridisation sp2 hoti hai. Isi sp2 hybridisation ke karan benzene poora samtal (planar) hota hai tatha uske chhah p electron milkar ek aisa pi ghair-mukammal (cloud) banate hain jo ushe asamanya sthirta deta hai; isi karan benzene addition ke bajaye substitution kriya deta hai. Isliye 'sp2' hi sahi jod hai, sp ya sp3 nahi - sp3 methane tatha sp ethene wale bandhan-parisar ke hote hain. Exam point: benzene ke carbon ki hybridisation sp2 hoti hai (har carbon ke teen sigma bandhan hone ke kaaran), isliye benzene samtal tatha khushbudaar hota hai.

qe: Which reagent is used for 'Decarboxylation' of sodium salts of fatty acids to produce alkanes?
qh: फैटी एसिड के सोडियम लवणों से कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड हटाकर एल्केन बनाने में कौन सा अभिकर्मक प्रयुक्त होता है?
e: Fatty acid ke sodium salt (soap) ko soda lime (NaOH tatha CaO ka 3:1 mishran) ke saath garam karne par usme se CO2 nikal jaata hai tatha ek carbon kam wali alkane bach jaati hai - isi kriya ko vikaarboxylikaran (decarboxylation) kehte hain, tatha soda lime hi iska mukhya abhikarmak hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki soda lime NaOH tatha CaO ka mishran hone se gila (hygroscopic) nahi hota tatha tapman aasaani se badh jaata hai, isliye abhikriya saaf chalti hai. Iske ulat H2SO4, KMnO4 ya NaOH ke akele istemal se ye kriya poori nahi hoti, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: fatty acid ke sodium salt ka vikaarboxylikaran soda lime (NaOH + CaO, 3:1) dwara hota hai, jisse ek carbon kam wali alkane banti hai.

qe: What is 'Aniline' chemically?
qh: एनिलीन रासायनिक रूप से क्या है?
e: Aniline ka rasayanik naam aminobenzene (C6H5NH2) hai, kyunki usmein benzene ke chakra par ek amino samooh (-NH2) juda hota hai; ye rangheen se halka peela drav (tel) hota hai jiski gandh machhli jaisi hoti hai. Yahi padarth rang (dye), aushadhi tatha plastik (jaise polyurethane) banane mein sabse adhik istemal hota hai, isliye yahi 'dye udyog ki jaan' kaha jaata hai; ise HNO3 tatha tin- HCl se phenol tatha benzene ke zariye tatha nitrobenzene ke rudhaan (reduction) se banaate hain. Iske ulat benzene, phenol ya styrene ke roop alag padarth hote hain, isliye wo jod sahi nahi. Exam point: aniline ka rasayanik naam aminobenzene hai - ismein benzene chakra par -NH2 samooh laga hota hai tatha isi se rang banane ke udyog chalta hai.

qe: Which 'Haloalkane' is used in fire extinguishers under the name 'Pyrene'?
qh: पायरीन के नाम से अग्निशामक यंत्रों में कौन सा हैलोएल्केन उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Pyrene naam ke agnigraahak (fire extinguisher) mein carbon tetrachloride (CCl4) hota hai, jo ek bhaari, na jalne wala tatha vaayu se bhaari drav hota hai; aag par chhidkne ya daalne par ye bhaap ban kar aag ke upar chhat ki tarah baith jaata hai tatha oxygen hata deta hai. Isi ke saath ye aag ki ushma tatha aankd (radiant heat) sokh leta hai, isliye bijli tatha tel ki aag mein purane taur par yahi istemal hota tha. Iske ulat paani ya CO2 se kuchh aag (jaise vidyut tatha sODium) bujhaana khatarnaak ho sakta hai, isliye CCl4 ka apna mahatva tha; aaj zehirila bhaap ke karan iska upyog seemit hai. Exam point: Pyrene agnigraahak mein carbon tetrachloride (CCl4) hota hai, jo vaayu se bhaari bhaap ban kar aag par chhat ki tarah baith jaata hai tatha oxygen hata deta hai.

qe: What is the result of 'Mild Oxidation' of a secondary alcohol?
qh: द्वितीयक (Secondary) अल्कोहल के ऑक्सीकरण से क्या उत्पाद प्राप्त होता है?
e: Secondary alcohol (jaise propan-2-ol) mein -OH wala carbon do aur carbon samoohon ke saath juda hota hai, isliye mild oxid (jaise K2Cr2O7 ke kam matara ya PCC) se pehle uspar se ek hydrogen nikalta hai tatha C=O bandhan ban jaata hai - isliye utpad ketone (propanone) milta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki us carbon par aage hydrogen nahi bachti, isliye aage oxid nahi hota tatha wo acid mein nahi badalta (jabki primary alcohol acid tak jaata hai). Isliye yahan 'ketone' hi sahi utpad hai, carboxylic acid ya aldehyd nahi - aldehyd keval primary alcohol se banta hai. Exam point: secondary alcohol ka mild oxid se ketone banta hai, kyunki uske carbon par aage hydrogen nahi hoti, isliye wo aml tak oxid nahi ho paata.

qe: Which compound gives a 'Yellow Precipitate' with Iodine and Alkali (Iodoform test)?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा यौगिक आयोडोफॉर्म परीक्षण में पीला अवक्षेप देता है?
e: Iodoform pariksha mein jisasb padarth mein CH3-CO- ya CH3-CH(OH)- jaisa samooh hota hai, ushe iodine tatha ksheerajal (NaOH) ke saath garam karne par peela avilep (precipitate) banta hai; ethanol (CH3CH2OH) aisa hi padarth hai, isliye yahi pariksha dhan (positive) hoti hai. Peela avilep tri-iodomethane (iodoform) ka hota hai tatha uski tez gandh se hi pariksha ki pushti hoti hai - isliye ishka naam iodoform pariksha pada. Iske ulat methanol, glucose tatha diethyl ether is pariksha ka dhan parinaam nahi dete, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: iodoform pariksha mein ethanol ke saath peela avilep banta hai; isse CH3-CO- ya CH3-CH(OH)- wale padarthon ki pehchaan hoti hai.

qe: What is 'Naphthalene' commonly used for in households?
qh: घरेलू रूप से नेफ़थलीन की गोलियों का प्राथमिक उपयोग क्या है?
e: Naphthalene do benzene chakra milkar bana hua svasth (fused) sugandh padarth hai (C10H8); iski khaas tez gandh hoti hai jo keedon ko door rakhti hai, isliye ise ghar-grihasthi mein 'mothballs' (kapdon ke goli) ke roop mein istemal karte hain. Ye kamre ke tapman par dheere-dheere sublimation hota hai (thos se seedha bhaap) tatha uski gandh hawa mein faitt jaati hai, isliye kapde tatha almari ki keed-makodi nasht ho jaate hain. Iske ulat ye khane ke pakaane, dawa ya bijli ke kaam mein nahi aata, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: naphthalene ka ghar mein istemal mothballs ke roop mein hota hai, kyunki uski sublimation tatha tez gandh keedon ko door rakhti hai.

qe: Which reaction is used to synthesize 'Alkanes' by the coupling of two alkyl halides with Sodium?
qh: सोडियम की उपस्थिति में दो एल्किल हैलाइड अणुओं के जुड़ने से एल्केन बनाने की अभिक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
e: Wurtz abhikriya mein do alkyl halide (jaise methyl chloride) ko sukhi (dry) diethyl ether mein sodium dhaatu ke saath mila kar garam kiya jaata hai; sodium halide hat kar do alkyl samooh aapas mein jud jaate hain tatha ek lambi shrankhla wali alkane banti hai (2R-X + 2Na se R-R + 2NaX). Yahi abhikriya chhoti halide se badi alkane banane ka ek aasaan tareeka deti hai tatha isi ke ek roop (Friedel-Crafts) se benzene par alkyl samooh lagta hai. Iske ulat Grignard, Cannizzaro ya Hofmann abhikriya alag uddeshya ke liye hoti hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: do alkyl halide ko sodium ke saath jodne wali abhikriya Wurtz abhikriya kehlati hai, jisse lambi-shrankhla wali alkane banti hai.

qe: Which compound is produced when 'Ethanol' is heated with excess concentrated $H_2SO_4$ at 170°C?
qh: जब एथेनॉल को 170°C (443 K) पर सांद्र $H_2SO_4$ के साथ गर्म किया जाता है तो क्या बनता है?
e: Ethanol ko adhik matara mein saandrit (concentrated) H2SO4 ke saath 170 degree C par garam karne par paani nikal jaata hai tatha ek double bandhan ban jaata hai, isliye utpad ethene banta hai - isi kriya ko niyojana (dehydration) kehte hain. Ye abhikriya unke liye prayog kiya jaata hai jahan alkene chahiye tatha gas nikalne ke liye sasti reeti ho; kam tapman (lagbhag 140 degree C) par iske bajaye diethyl ether banta hai, isliye tapman ka niyantran zaroori hai. Iske ulat ethane ya acetic acid is pravah mein nahi bante, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: ethanol ko 170 degree C par adhik H2SO4 ke saath garam karne par ethene banta hai (paani nikalne wali abhikriya 'dehydration'), isliye yahi sahi utpad hai.

qe: What is the 'IUPAC name' of Glycerin?
qh: ग्लिसरीन का IUPAC नाम क्या है?
e: Glycerin ka IUPAC naam propane-1,2,3-triol hota hai; ismein propan ki teen carbon wali shrankhla hoti hai tatha har carbon (1, 2 tatha 3) par ek-ek -OH samooh juda hota hai, isliye naam ke aage teen sathan ke aankde 1,2,3 lagte hain. Glycerin mein teeno carbon par -OH hone ki pushti iske naam ke aankdon (1,2,3) se hi hoti hai, kyunki ek hi samooh alag-alag sthan par hone se alag naam ban jaata hai. Isi karan ye paani sokhne wala (moisturizer) tatha mithas wala padarth hai, isliye yahi sahi naam hai, anya roop nahi. Exam point: glycerin ka IUPAC naam propane-1,2,3-triol hota hai, kyunki usmein teen carbon par teen -OH samooh hote hain.

qe: Which reaction introduces an 'Alkyl group' into a benzene ring using an alkyl halide and anhydrous $AlCl_3$?
qh: निर्जल $AlCl_3$ की उपस्थिति में बेंजीन वलय में एल्किल समूह जोड़ने की अभिक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
e: Friedel-Crafts alkylikaran wahi abhikriya hai jismein benzene ke chakra par alkyl samooh lagta hai; iske liye alkyl halide tatha anhydrous aluminium chloride (AlCl3) ka istemal hota hai, jo alkyl halide se ek carbocation (jaise CH3+) bana kar chakra par hamla karta hai. Isi kriya se toluene, ethylbenzene tatha anya alkylbenzene bante hain, jo rang, sugandh tatha dawa ke udyog mein kaam aate hain; AlCl3 yahan utprek (catalyst) hota hai tatha uske bina abhikriya shuru hi nahi hoti. Iske ulat Wurtz tatha Cannizzaro abhikriya benzene par alkyl nahi lagati, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: benzene par alkyl samooh lagane wali abhikriya Friedel-Crafts alkylikaran kehlati hai - ismein alkyl halide tatha AlCl3 (utprek) istemal hote hain.

qe: What is 'Aspirin' chemically?
qh: एस्पिरिन का रासायनिक नाम क्या है?
e: Aspirin ka rasayanik naam acetylsalicylic acid hota hai; ismein salicylic acid ke -OH par acetyl samooh (CH3CO-) laga hota hai, isi karan wo aml (acid) tatha dard-nashak (analgesic) dono kaam karta hai. Yahi duniya ki sabse prachlit aushadhi hai, jo bukhar, dard tatha sokh (inflammation) mein istemal hoti hai tatha isi ke aadhaar par anya dawa bhi bani; iska istemal jaldi (peth) ke dard tatha dil ki dawaon mein bhi hota hai. Iske ulat phenol, salol ya acetic acid ke roop is alag padarth hain, isliye wo jod sahi nahi. Exam point: aspirin ka rasayanik naam acetylsalicylic acid hai - isi karan wo dard-nashak tatha sokh-nashak (anti-inflammatory) ke roop mein kaam karta hai.

qe: What is 'Lucas Reagent' used to distinguish?
qh: ल्यूकास अभिकर्मक (Lucas Reagent) का उपयोग किनके बीच विभेद करने के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Lucas abhikarmak (saandrit HCl tatha anhydrous ZnCl2 ka mishran) primary, secondary tatha tertiary alcohol mein antar karne ka aasan tareeka deta hai; ise alcohol mein daalne par tertiary alcohol turant dhundhla (cloudy) ho jaata hai, secondary thodi der mein tatha primary kamre ke tapman par badlav nahi dikhata. Iska karan yahi hai ki tertiary carbocation sabse sthir hota hai tatha jaldi banta hai, isliye uska alkyl chloride sabse jaldi banta hai; primary ka carbocation sthir nahi hota, isliye abhikriya hi nahi hoti. Iske ulat ye reagent aldehyd tatha ketone ya benzene chakra ki pehchaan ke liye nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Lucas abhikarmak primary, secondary tatha tertiary alcohol mein antar karne ke liye istemal hota hai - tertiary turant dhundhla hota hai tatha primary nahi hota.

qe: Which compound is known as 'Oil of Mirbane' and has an almond-like smell?
qh: कड़वे बादाम जैसी गंध वाले किस यौगिक को 'ऑयल ऑफ मिरबेन' कहा जाता है?
e: Nitrobenzene ka purana vyavharik naam 'oil of mirbane' hai; iska badam jaisa khaas swap hota hai tatha iska anu-sutra C6H5NO2 hota hai, jismein benzene chakra par ek nitro (-NO2) samooh hota hai. Yahi padarth benzene ko saandrit HNO3 tatha H2SO4 ke saath garam karker banaaya jaata hai tatha ye halka peela drav hota hai; iska upyog aniline banane tatha anya sugandh (perfume) tatha ghol (solvent) mein hota hai. Iske ulat phenol, toluene ya aniline ke roop tatha sugandh alag padarth hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: oil of mirbane ka rasayanik naam nitrobenzene hai - uski badam jaisi gandh tatha benzene chakra par -NO2 samooh uski pehchaan hai.

qe: Which reaction is used to prepare 'Salicylaldehyde' from Phenol?
qh: फिनोल से सेलिसिल्डिहाइड बनाने वाली प्रसिद्ध अभिक्रिया कौन सी है?
e: Reimer-Tiemann abhikriya mein phenol ko chloroform (CHCl3) tatha kshar (NaOH) ke saath garam kiya jaata hai, jisse benzene chakra par ek -CHO samooh lag jaata hai tatha salicylaldehyde banta hai; ismein pehle dichlorocarbene banta hai jo chakra par daakhil hota hai. Iska mahatva yahi hai ki yahin se salicylaldehyde milta hai, jo aage aspirin tatha anya sugandh tatha dawa banane ke kaam aata hai. Iske ulat Friedel-Crafts, Wurtz ya Cannizzaro abhikriya se ye padarth nahi banta, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: phenol se salicylaldehyde banane ke liye Reimer-Tiemann abhikriya (chloroform tatha NaOH ke saath) istemal hoti hai - ismein benzene chakra par -CHO lagta hai.

qe: What is the 'Monomer' of Natural Rubber?
qh: प्राकृतिक रबर का मूल एकलक (Monomer) क्या है?
e: Prakritik rabar (natural rubber) ek bahulak (polymer) hai jiska mukhya nirmaanika (monomer) isoprene (2-methyl-1,3-butadiene) hota hai; hazaaron isoprene anu aapas mein jud kar cis-roop ka lamba drav (latex) banate hain tatha usi se rabar ke gun aate hain. Yahi karan hai ki rabar kheenchne par failta hai tatha chhodne par wapas sikudta hai (elastic), tatha isi gun se tyre, sole tatha anya saman bante hain. Iske ulat neoprene tatha styrene tatha isobutylene ke roop alag polimeron ke nirmaanika hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: prakritik rabar ka nirmaanika isoprene hota hai - isi ke anu milkar cis-polyisoprene (rabar) banate hain jo kheenchne par failta hai.

qe: Which 'Polymer' is used to make non-stick cookware like 'Teflon'?
qh: नॉन-स्टिक बर्तनों की कोटिंग बनाने के लिए किस बहुलक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Teflon (PTFE) ka poora naam polytetrafluoroethylene hota hai, jo tetrafluoroethylene ke bahulakaran (polymerization) se banta hai; ismein carbon-fluorine bandhan bahut mazboot hote hain, isliye ye atyant asthir (unreactive) tatha ushma-sahishnu (heat resistant) hota hai. Isi karan khane ke bartan (non-stick tawa) par iski patli parat chadhaai jaati hai, kyunki khaana usse chipakta nahi tatha uchch tapman par bhi ye kharab nahi hota; ise oil tatha rasayano se bachav ke liye bhi istemal karte hain. Iske ulat PVC, polythene ya bakelite ke gun tatha nirmaanika isse alag hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: non-stick bartan (Teflon) mein polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ye uchch tapman par sthir tatha khaane ko chipakne nahi deta.

qe: What is 'Nylon 6,6' classified as?
qh: नायलॉन 6,6 किस प्रकार का बहुलक है?
e: Nylon 6,6 ek polyamide hai, kyunki usmein bar-bar amide bandhan (-CO-NH-) bante hain; ye adipic acid tatha hexamethylenediamine ke samghatan (condensation) se banta hai. Apne mazboot tatha rasayan-sahishnu bandhan ke karan ise rope, parachute, brush, tatha machine ke hisson mein istemal karte hain; isi karan ye 'pehla poora synthetic fibre' maana jaata hai tatha ise 'silk jaisa' bhi kehte hain. Iske ulat polyester, polythene ya bakelite ke bandhan tatha gun alag hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Nylon 6,6 ek polyamide hai - ismein bar-bar amide bandhan (-CO-NH-) hote hain, isliye ye mazboot tatha resham jaisa fibre banta hai.

qe: Which polymer is used for making 'Plastic Pipes' (PVC)?
qh: प्लंबिंग और बिजली के तारों की कोटिंग में प्रयुक्त PVC का पूरा नाम क्या है?
e: PVC (polyvinyl chloride) vinyl chloride ke bahulakaran se banta hai tatha ise pipes (plastic naali), wire ke cover tatha khidki ke frame banane mein istemal karte hain; ismein chlorine hone ke karan ye aag nahi pakadta tatha sadharan rasayano se kharab nahi hota. PVC ko jahan-jahan kathorta chahiye (jaise pipe) wahan plasticizer ke bina lete hain tatha jahan lachak chahiye (jaise wire ka cover) wahan plasticizer mila dete hain, isliye ek hi bahulak ke kai roop bante hain. Iske ulat polythene, bakelite tatha teflon ke gun tatha upayog alag hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: plastic naali (PVC pipe) banane ke liye polyvinyl chloride ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ye mazboot, jang-rahit tatha aag na pakadne wala hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Monomer' of Orlon (Acrylic fiber)?
qh: ऑर्लोन (एक्रिलिक फाइबर) का एकलक क्या है?
e: Orlon (acrylic fibre) ka nirmaanika acrylonitrile (CH2=CHCN) hota hai; iske bahulakaran se bane resh (fibre) unni jaisa garam tatha mazboot hota hai, isliye sweater, shawl tatha anya garam kapdon mein iska istemal hota hai. Acrylonitrile ke anuon ke beech mazboot aakarshan hone ke karan ye fibre sikudta nahi tatha dhoop tatha keede se kharab nahi hota, isliye ye unni (wool) ka achha vikalp hai. Iske ulat caprolactam (nylon 6), isoprene (rabar) tatha tetrafluoroethylene (teflon) ke nirmaanika alag padarthon ke hote hain. Exam point: Orlon (acrylic fibre) ka nirmaanika acrylonitrile hota hai - isse banne wala fibre unni jaisa garam tatha mazboot hota hai.

qe: What is 'Rayon'?
qh: रेयान किस प्रकार का रेशा है?
e: Rayon ko 'semi-synthetic' fibre kehte hain, kyunki iska kachcha maal (cellulose) praakritik (lakdi ka gudda ya kapas ka lintar) hota hai, par ushe rasayanik kriya se ghula kar resh (fibre) banaya jaata hai - yani wo poori tarah praakritik nahi, balki punarutpadit (regenerated) cellulose hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki cellulose paani tatha aam gholon mein nahi ghulta, isliye ushe pehle rasayanik roop mein badal kar phir fibre ke roop mein nikaala jaata hai; isi karan ise 'artificial silk' bhi kehte hain. Iske ulat nylon tatha polyester poori tarah sanshleshit (synthetic) hote hain, isliye wo Rayon ki tulna mein alag hain. Exam point: Rayon punarutpadit (regenerated) cellulose hai, isliye ishe semi-synthetic fibre kehte hain - kachcha maal praakritik tatha banane ki kriya rasayanik hoti hai.

qe: What is 'Vulcanization' of rubber?
qh: रबर का वल्कनीकरण (Vulcanization) क्या है?
e: Vulcanization mein praakritik rabar ko sulfur ke saath garam kiya jaata hai tatha sulfur ke pradesh (bridges) rabar ki shrankhlaon ko aapas mein bandh dete hain; isi karan rabar mazboot, lachakdar tatha tapman ke badlav se kam prabhavit hota hai. Iske saath hi iski chipchipaahat tatha garmi mein narm hone wali samasya khatm ho jaati hai, isliye tyre tatha anya mazboot saman banane ke liye yahi kriya zaroori hai. Iske ulat oxygen, nitrogen ya paani ke saath garam karna is kriya ka hissa nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: vulcanization mein rabar ko sulfur ke saath garam kiya jaata hai - isse rabar mazboot, lachakdar tatha tapman-sahishnu ban jaata hai (tyre ke liye zaroori).

qe: What is 'Buna-N'?
qh: ब्यूना-एन (Buna-N) क्या है?
e: Buna-N ek sanshleshit (synthetic) rabar hai jise acrylonitrile tatha butadiene ke bahulakaran (copolymerization) se banaya jaata hai; ise 'nitrile rubber' bhi kehte hain tatha iski khaas baat yahi hai ki ye tel tatha ghol (solvent) ko sah leta hai. Isi gun ke karan ise tel-tatha-benzin ke pipe, gasket tatha fuel ki nalion mein istemal karte hain, jahan saadharan rabar tel se phool jaata ya ghul jaata. Iske ulat Buna-S (styrene tatha butadiene) tatha neoprene abhinna nirmaanikon se bante hain, isliye wo vikalp alag hain. Exam point: Buna-N ek sanshleshit rabar hai jo butadiene tatha acrylonitrile se banta hai tatha tel tatha ghol ko sahne wale saman (gasket, pipe) mein istemal hota hai.

qe: What is 'Gutta Percha'?
qh: गट्टा-पर्चा (Gutta Percha) क्या है?
e: Gutta percha ek praakritik bahulak hai jo isoprene ka trans-roop hota hai; iske ulat saadharan rabar cis-roop hota hai, isliye dono ke gun alag hote hain - gutta percha kam lachakdar tatha adhik kathor hota hai. Ye purane zamaane mein bijli ke taar ke insulation tatha samundari cable (tAre) mein istemal hota tha tatha aaj bhi golf ball tatha dentist ke saman mein kaam aata hai, kyunki ye paani tatha bijli dono ko rokta hai. Iske ulat ye bakelite, neoprene ya buna jaisa sanshleshit bahulak nahi, balki ek praakritik trans-isomer hai. Exam point: gutta percha polyisoprene ka praakritik trans-isomer hai - iske guna saadharan (cis) rabar se alag hone ke karan ise cable insulation tatha dalam (dentistry) mein istemal karte hain.

qe: What is 'Plexiglass' (Lucite)?
qh: प्लेक्सिग्लास (Lucite) रासायनिक रूप से क्या है?
e: Plexiglass (Lucite) ka rasayanik naam polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA) hota hai; ye methyl methacrylate ke bahulakaran se banta hai tatha kaanch jaisa saaf par usse halka tatha tootne par tikke nahi chubhne wala hota hai. Isi gun ke karan ise halke 'transparent' saman jaise hawai jahaz ki khidki, sign board, show-case, lamp cover tatha chashme ke lene mein istemal karte hain tatha isi se 'organic glass' bhi kehte hain. Iske ulat polythene, PVC ya bakelite apardharshak (opaque) ya adhik bhaari hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Plexiglass ka rasayanik naam polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA) hota hai - ye kaanch jaisa saaf par halka tatha tootne par kam khatarnaak hota hai.

qe: Which polymer is used for making 'Bulletproof' windows and high-quality safety helmets?
qh: बुलेटप्रूफ ग्लास और सुरक्षा शील्ड बनाने में कौन सा पॉलीमर प्रयोग होता है?
e: Polycarbonate ek bahulak hai jismein carbonate (-O-CO-O-) samoohon se carbon ki shrankhla banti hai; iska naam 'lexan' se bhi jaana jaata hai tatha ye atyant mazboot hone par bhi saaf (transparent) rehta hai. Isi gun ke karan ise barmi-proof (bulletproof) khidki, hawai jahaz ka shield, suraksha helmet tatha dhaatau ki jagah lene wale mazboot hisson mein istemal karte hain, kyunki ye tootne ke bajaye jhatka sokh leta hai. Iske ulat PMMA (plexiglass) saaf hota hai par usse kam mazboot tatha polythene apardharshak hota hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: barmi-proof khidki tatha suraksha helmet mein polycarbonate ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ye saaf hone ke saath-saath atyant mazboot tatha jhatka-soakh ho sakta hai.

qe: Which polymer is a 'Copolymer' of Butadiene and Styrene?
qh: ब्यूटाडाईन और स्टाइरीन का सह-बहुलक कौन सा है?
e: Buna-S ko 'SBR' (styrene-butadiene rubber) kehte hain tatha yahi butadiene tatha styrene ke sahayukt (copolymer) bahulakaran se banta hai. Yahi duniya mein sabse adhik bane wale synthetic rabar mein se hai tatha ise tyre, sole, belt tatha anya rabar ke saman mein istemal karte hain, kyunki ye praakritik rabar jaisa lachakdar par usse sasta tatha gharsh-sahishnu hota hai. Iske ulat Buna-N (nitrile) tatha neoprene ke nirmaanik alag hote hain, isliye 'butadiene tatha styrene ka sahayukt bahulak' hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: Buna-S do nirmaanikon ka sahayukt bahulak (copolymer) hai - butadiene tatha styrene; isi liye ise SBR kehte hain tatha tyre mein istemal karte hain.

qe: What is 'Neoprene' primarily used for?
qh: नियोप्रीन (पॉलीक्लोरोप्रीन) का मुख्य उपयोग क्या है?
e: Neoprene polychloroprene hai, jise chloroprene ke bahulakaran se banaya jaata hai; tel, sauraj ki roshni (UV), ushma tatha kai rasayan ishe kharab bhi nahi kar paate. Isi karan ise rasayan-rodhak gloves (chemical gloves), wetsuit (paani ke khel ka poshaakh) tatha iske jooton mein istemal karte hain, kyunki paani tatha rasayan ke samne saadharan rabar ke gun kam pad jaate hain. Iske ulat bakelite, teflon tatha nylon alag parampariv (family) ke bahulak hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: neoprene tel tatha rasayano ko rokne wali khaas rabar hai - isi karan ise chemical-resident gloves tatha wetsuit banane mein istemal karte hain.

qe: What are 'Micelles' in the context of cleaning with soap?
qh: साबुन के जलीय घोल में मैल साफ करते समय 'मिसेल' (Micelles) क्या होते हैं?
o: Spherical clusters of soap molecules with dirt trapped in the hydrophobic interior
e: Sabun ke anu (molecule) dono sire (end) par alag byavhaar karte hain - ek sire par lambi hydrocarbon shrankhla paani se door rahati hai (hydrophobic) tatha doosre sire par aayan wala hissa paani se judta hai (hydrophilic); isliye paani mein in anuon ka samooh banta hai jismein shrankhla bheetar tatha aayan bahar rehte hain. Chiknaai (grees tatha tel) in galon (micelles) ke bheetar phans jaati hai tatha paani se juudkar bah jaati hai - isi karan kapde saaf hote hain. Iska matlab hai ki safai keval jhaag se nahi balki in guthliyon ke bheetar chiknaai bandh hone se hoti hai. Exam point: micelles sabun ke anuon ki golij samooh hoti hain jismein chiknaai bheetar phans jaati hai - isi karan sabun paani mein chiknaai ko hata leta hai.

qe: Which polymer is used for making 'Bulletproof' vests?
qh: बुलेटप्रूफ जैकेट बनाने के लिए कौन सा उच्च शक्ति वाला सिंथेटिक फाइबर प्रयुक्त होता है?
e: Kevlar ek atyant mazboot bahulak hai jo aramide parampariv se aata hai tatha uski shrankhlaon ke beech mazboot hydrogen bandhan hote hain; isi karan wo goli ki tez urja ko sokh leta hai tatha goli-rodhak jacket (bulletproof vest) mein istemal hota hai. Dhaatu se halka hone ke karan ye police tatha sena ke poshaakh, helmet tatha rakchha-kavach (armour) mein bhi kaam aata hai tatha apne kam bhaar ke karan pehna ja sakta hai. Iske ulat nylon, PVC tatha polyester ke gun tatha mazbooti is nivel ki nahi hoti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: goli-rodhak jacket (bulletproof vest) banane ke liye Kevlar ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ye dhaatu se halka hone ke saath goli ki urja sokhne wala mazboot fibre hai.

qe: What is the monomer of 'Nylon 6'?
qh: नायलॉन 6 का एकलक (Monomer) क्या है?
e: Nylon 6 ka nirmaanika caprolactam hota hai, jise garam karke kholne (ring-opening polymerization) se bahulak banta hai; ismein chhah carbon ka ek chakra (ring) khul kar lambi shrankhla ban jaati hai. Iske ulat Nylon 6,6 mein do abhinna nirmaanika (adipic acid tatha hexamethylenediamine) samghatan se judte hain, isliye dono ke naam ke aankde alag hote hain - 6 ka matlab ek-ek nirmaanika mein chhah carbon, tatha 6,6 ka matlab dono nirmaanikon mein chhah-chhah carbon. Isi karan ye dono nylon ke gun mazboot par thode alag hote hain, isliye yahan 'caprolactam' hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: Nylon 6 ka nirmaanika caprolactam hota hai, jiske chakra ka kholna bahulak banata hai (Nylon 6,6 mein do alag nirmaanika hote hain).

qe: Which reaction mechanism involves a 'Carbocation' intermediate and proceeds in two steps?
qh: कौन सी न्यूक्लियोफिलिक प्रतिस्थापन अभिक्रिया दो चरणों में होती है और इसमें कार्बोकैटायन मध्यवर्ती बनता है?
e: SN1 abhikriya do padav mein chalti hai - pehle halide aayan (leaving group) nikal jaata hai tatha ek carbocation banta hai (dheema padav), phir nucleophile us par hamla karta hai (tez padav); isliye rate keval us pehle padav par nirbhar hota hai tatha carbocation ka sthir hona abhikriya ko tez kar deta hai. Isi karan SN1 tertiary halide ke saath tezi se hoti hai, kyunki tertiary carbocation sabse sthir hota hai; iske saath hi samropan (racemization) bhi dikhta hai kyunki carbocation samtal (planar) hota hai. Iske ulat SN2 ek hi padav mein chalti hai tatha inversion deti hai, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: carbocation madhyavarti (intermediate) tatha do padav wali abhikriya SN1 hoti hai - isi karan tertiary halide ke saath iska rate sabse tez hota hai.

qe: The 'SN2' reaction mechanism is characterized by which of the following?
qh: SN2 अभिक्रिया की मुख्य विशेषता क्या है?
e: SN2 abhikriya ek hi padav mein chalti hai, jismein nucleophile ek taraf se aata hai tatha halide aayan doosri taraf se nikal jaata hai - isi karan mole ki sajaavat mud (invert) jaati hai, jise Waldens inversion kehte hain. Iska matlab hai ki jo 'R' roop ka padarth tha wo abhi 'S' roop ban jaata hai tatha or ulta bhi hota hai; isi karan SN2 ke saath chiral centre wale padarth ka utpad ek hi soch (configuration) wala hota hai. Iske ulat SN1 mein carbocation samtal hota hai, isliye racemization (dono roop) hoti hai, isliye dono abhikriyaon mein antar saaf hota hai. Exam point: SN2 abhikriya ka khaas nishaan sajaavat ka ulta hona (Walden inversion) hai, kyunki ye ek hi padav mein nucleophile ke back-side hamle se chalti hai.

qe: According to 'Huckel's Rule', a compound is aromatic if it is planar, cyclic, and has how many pi electrons?
qh: हकल नियम (Huckel's Rule) के अनुसार कोई समतलीय चक्रीय यौगिक एरोमैटिक होने के लिए कितने पाई इलेक्ट्रॉनों की आवश्यकता रखता है?
e: Huckel ke niyam ke anusar koi bhi chakrakar (cyclic), samtal (planar) tatha apchuurit (conjugated) padarth tabhi aromatik (sugandh) hota hai jab uske pi electron ki ginti 4n + 2 ho (jahan n = 0, 1, 2...); yani 2, 6, 10, 14 jaisi sankhyaayein is niyam mein aati hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki in sankhyaon par pi electron ka samooh poore chakra mein paryaapt (delocalised) hoker ushe adhik sthirta deta hai, isliye benzene (6 pi electron) tatha naphthalene (10) sugandh hain. Iske ulat 4n (jaise 4, 8, 12) wale chakra us niyam se bahar (anti-aromatic) maane jaate hain, isliye '4n + 2' hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: Huckel ke niyam ke anusar aromatik hone ke liye pi electron ki ginti 4n + 2 honi chahiye (jaise benzene mein 6).

qe: Which rule predicts the major product in the 'Dehydration' of alcohols or dehydrohalogenation?
qh: एल्किल हैलाइड से हाइड्रोजन हैलाइड के विलोपन में अधिक प्रतिस्थापित एल्कीन बनने का नियम क्या कहलाता है?
e: Saytzeff (Zaitsev) ka niyam batata hai ki alcohol ka niyojana (dehydration) ya haloalkane ka dehydrohalogenation hone par mukhya utpad wahi hota hai jismein zyada pratisthapit (substituted) double bandhan banta hai - yani hydrogen un carbon se nikalta hai jahan kam hydrogen ho. Iska karan yahi hai ki zyada pratisthapit alkene adhik sthir hota hai, isliye use banane ki or abhikriya jhukti hai; isi karan 2-butene tatha 1-butene mein mukhya utpad 2-butene hota hai. Iske ulat Hofmann ka niyam ulta (kam pratisthapit) utpad deta hai, jo khaas sthitiyon mein lagu hota hai. Exam point: Saytzeff (Zaitsev) ka niyam dehydration tatha dehydrohalogenation ka mukhya utpad batata hai - yani zyada pratisthapit (sthir) alkene banta hai.

qe: What is the 'Electrophile' in the Nitration of Benzene?
qh: बेंजीन के नाइट्रीकरण में सक्रिय इलेक्ट्रॉनस्नेही (Electrophile) क्या होता है?
e: Benzene ka nitrikaran (nitration) saandrit HNO3 tatha H2SO4 ke mishran se hota hai; ismein sabse pehle H2SO4 ki sahayata se nitronium aayan (NO2+) banta hai tatha wahi vidyutatmak (electrophile) hokar benzene chakra par hamla karta hai tatha nitrobenzene banta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki benzene ke p electron ghair-mukammal (cloud) electron-maangne wale (electrophile) par hamla karta hai, isliye yahin NO2+ asli hamlavar hai; isi tarah sulfo-nikaran mein SO3 asli electrophile hota hai. Iske ulat NO3- ya HNO3 ke roop mein aayan alag hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: benzene ke nitrikaran mein asli electrophile nitronium aayan (NO2+) hota hai, jo HNO3 tatha H2SO4 se banta hai tatha nitrobenzene deta hai.

qe: The 'Markovnikov Rule' is used to predict the addition of $HBr$ to which type of molecule?
qh: मार्कोवनीकॉफ का नियम किस प्रकार के अणुओं पर HBr के योग को निर्धारित करता है?
e: Markovnikov ka niyam kehta hai ki asammitrik (unsymmetrical) alkene par HBr jaisa aayanik (ionic) judaav hone par hydrogen us carbon par jaati hai jahan zyada hydrogen (kam pratisthapit) ho tatha halide doosre carbon par - isse sthir carbocation wala madhyavarti banta hai. Isi karan propene par HBr se 2-bromopropane mukhya utpad hota hai, tatha ushe 1-bromopropane sirf thodi matara mein milta hai. Iske ulat santript alkane mein koi double bandhan hi nahi hota, isliye wahan ye niyam lagu nahi hota. Exam point: Markovnikov ka niyam asammitrik alkene (jaise propene) par HBr ke judaav ko batata hai - hydrogen us carbon par jaati hai jahan pehle se zyada hydrogen hoti hai.

qe: The 'Peroxide Effect' (Kharasch Effect) leads to which type of addition of HBr?
qh: परॉक्साइड की उपस्थिति में एल्कीन पर HBr का योग किस नियम के तहत होता है?
e: Peroxide (Kharasch) prabhav mein HBr ka judaav Markovnikov ke niyam ke ulta hota hai, kyunki peroxide ki maujoodgi mein abhikriya muktak (free radical) ke roop mein chalti hai tatha sabse sthir muktak (bromine sabse pehle kam pratisthapit carbon par) banta hai. Isi karan propene par peroxide wale HBr se 1-bromopropane mukhya utpad hota hai, jabki bina peroxide ke 2-bromopropane milta hai - yani ek hi reagens se do alag utpad milte hain. Iske ulat HCl tatha HI ke saath ye prabhav saaf nahi dikhta, isliye yahan HBr hi khaas hai. Exam point: peroxide (Kharasch) prabhav se HBr ka judaav anti-Markovnikov hota hai - yani halide kam pratisthapit (terminal) carbon par lagta hai.

qe: What is the order of stability for 'Carbocations'?
qh: कार्बोकैटायनों के स्थायित्व का सही घटता क्रम क्या है?
e: Carbocation ki sthirta is baat par nirbhar karti hai ki uske aas-paas kitne alkyl samooh hain, kyunki alkyl samooh electron chhodkar (hyperconjugation tatha induction se) dhan aavesh ko sambhaalte hain - isliye tertiary (teen alkyl) sabse sthir, phir secondary, phir primary tatha sabse kam sthir methyl hota hai. Isi karan tertiary alcohol sabse tezi se abhikriya deta hai (jaise Lucas pariksha mein) tatha SN1 abhikriya tertiary halide ke saath tez chalti hai. Iske ulat primary carbocation adhik asasthir hota hai tatha banne mein adhik urja maangta hai, isliye abhikriya dheemi chalti hai. Exam point: carbocation ki sthirta ka kram tertiary, phir secondary, phir primary hota hai - kyunki alkyl samooh dhan aavesh ko sambhaalne mein madad karte hain.

qe: Which reaction converts an 'Amide' into a 'Primary Amine' with one less carbon atom?
qh: हॉफमैन ब्रोमामाइड निम्नीकरण अभिक्रिया में एमाइड से क्या बनता है?
e: Hofmann bromamide apghatan (degradation) mein ek amide ko bromine tatha kshar (sodium hydroxide) ke saath tapaya jaata hai, jisse ek carbon kam wali primary amine banti hai (R-CONH2 se R-NH2) - isi karan ye amine banane ka aasan tareeka hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki is kriya mein amide ka carbonyl carbon alag (carbon dioxide ke roop mein) nikal jaata hai, isliye carbon ki sankhya ek kam ho jaati hai tatha amine milti hai. Iske ulat Cannizzaro, Wurtz ya Friedel-Crafts abhikriya se amine nahi milti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: amide se ek carbon kam wali primary amine banane wali abhikriya Hofmann bromamide apghatan hai - ismein bromine tatha NaOH ke saath amine banti hai.

qe: The 'Cannizzaro Reaction' is given by aldehydes that do NOT have:
qh: कैनिजारो अभिक्रिया वे एल्डिहाइड देते हैं जिनमें अनुपस्थित होता है:
e: Cannizzaro abhikriya ve aldehyd dete hain jinke alpha carbon par ek bhi hydrogen nahi hoti (jaise formaldehyde, benzaldehyde), kyunki aise aldehyd khud ko oxid tatha rudhaan (reduce) dono nahi kar sakte tatha kshar ki maujoodgi mein ek anu dusre ko electron deta hai. Isse ek hi padarth se alcohol tatha acid dono banta hai (dismutation), isliye ye abhikriya aldehyd ke do alag roop ek saath banane ka anokha tareeka hai. Iske ulat alpha-hydrogen wale aldehyd (jaise ethanal) aise byavhaar ke bajaye aldol samghatan dete hain, isliye yahan 'alpha-hydrogen ka na hona' hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: Cannizzaro abhikriya ve aldehyd dete hain jinke alpha carbon par hydrogen nahi hoti (jaise formaldehyde tatha benzaldehyde).

qe: Which reaction is used to test for 'Primary Amines' using Chloroform and alcoholic KOH?
qh: क्लोरोफॉर्म और KOH के साथ गर्म करने पर दुर्गंधयुक्त आइसोसायनाइड बनाने वाली कार्बिलएमीन अभिक्रिया किसकी पहचान है?
e: Carbylamine (Isocyanide) pariksha mein primary amine ko chloroform (CHCl3) tatha shaar (alcoholic KOH) ke saath garam kiya jaata hai, jisse uski badbu wali (foul smelling) isocyanide banti hai; isi tez tatha badbu wali gandh se primary amine ki pehchaan hoti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki primary amine (-NH2) ka hydrogen tatha chloroform milkar -NC (isocyanide) samooh banate hain, jo sirf primary amine mein hi sambhav hai - secondary tatha tertiary amine ye pariksha nahi dete. Isi karan ye pariksha amine ki koti (degree) jaanne ka saaf tareeka hai, anya abhikriyaon ke saath milaakar. Exam point: chloroform tatha alcoholic KOH ke saath primary amine ki pehchaan wali abhikriya carbylamine pariksha kehlati hai - ismein badbu wali isocyanide banti hai.

qe: Which reaction converts 'Benzene Diazonium Chloride' to Chlorobenzene using $Cu_2Cl_2 / HCl$?
qh: बेंजीन डायजोनियम क्लोराइड से क्लोरोबेंजीन बनाने की सैंडमायर अभिक्रिया (Sandmeyer Reaction) में क्या प्रयुक्त होता है?
e: Sandmeyer abhikriya mein benzene diazonium chloride ko cuprous chloride (Cu2Cl2) tatha HCl ki upasthiti mein abhikriya karaai jaati hai, jisse diazonium samooh (-N2Cl) hat jaata hai tatha uski jagah chlorine lag jaata hai - isliye chlorobenzene banta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki diazonium aayan (diazonium salt) asaadharan roop se asthir (unstable) hota hai tatha catalyst ki upasthiti mein aasaani se tootkar nitrogen gas chhod deta hai, jisse naya samooh (Cl, Br ya CN) chakra par lag jaata hai. Isi kriya ke anya roop se bromobenzene tatha benzotitrile bhi banaaye jaate hain, isliye ye rang-tatha-dawa banane ke udyog mein bahut upyogi hai. Exam point: diazonium salt se chlorobenzene banane wali Cu2Cl2/HCl wali abhikriya Sandmeyer abhikriya kehlati hai.

qe: Which class of drugs is used to reduce or abolish pain without causing loss of consciousness?
qh: बिना बेहोशी लाए दर्द को कम करने या समाप्त करने वाली औषधियां क्या कहलाती हैं?
e: Analgesic wo aushadhiyan hoti hain jo dard ko kam karti hain ya mita deti hain par rogi ki chetna (consciousness) ko nahi khoti - yani ye anubhuti ko dheela kar deti hain, sula nahi deti. Inka karan yahi hai ki ye shareer mein dard ke snayusanket (pain signals) ko banne ya pahunchne se rokti hain (jaise aspirin tatha paracetamol), isliye mareej bed par hote hue bhi jaagta rehta hai par dard mehsoos nahi hota. Iske ulat anaesthetic (behoshi ki dawa) chetna ko hi khatm kar deti hai, isliye dono aushadhiyon ko milana galat hoga. Exam point: analgesics dard kam karti hain bina chetna khoye - jaise aspirin, jo dard-nashak ke roop mein istemal hoti hai.

qe: What is the primary use of 'Antipyretics'?
qh: ज्वरनाशी (Antipyretics) दवाओं का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
o: To lower body temperature in high fever
e: Antipyretic dawa ka mukhya kaam bukhar (fever) mein sharer ke tapman ko kam karna hota hai; ye hypothalums ke tapman-niyantrak (thermoregulatory centre) par asar karke tapman ko saadharan (normal) ki or laati hai. Isi karan paracetamol (Crocin) tatha aspirin jaisi dawaaon ko bukhar utaarne ke liye dete hain, tatha bukhar ke saath hone wali thakan tatha sar-dard bhi kam hoti hai. Iske ulat antibiotic jivanuon ko maarta hai tatha analgesic keval dard kam karti hai - bukhar utaarna unka mukhya kaam nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: antipyretic dawaon ka mukhya kaam bukhar (badhe hue tapman) ko kam karna hota hai - jaise paracetamol.

qe: A condition where 'Glucose' is found in the urine is called:
qh: मूत्र में ग्लूकोज (शर्करा) की उपस्थिति वाली स्थिति को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Jab khoon mein glucose ki matara itni badh jaati hai ki gurde uski poori punravshoshan (reabsorption) nahi kar paate, to bacha hua glucose peshab (urine) ke saath bahar nikal jaata hai - isi sthiti ko glycosuria kehte hain. Yahi karan hai ki madhumeh (diabetes) ke rogi ki janch peshab mein shakkar dhoondhne se hoti hai, kyunki uske khoon mein glucose ka star 'renal threshold' se upar chala jaata hai. Iske ulat ye khoon mein urea ya protein ke badhne wali sthiti nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: peshab mein glucose (shakkar) nikalne wali sthiti ko glycosuria kehte hain - yahi diabetes ki pehchaan wali janch hai.

qe: Which bacterium is responsible for 'Tuberculosis' (TB), a major respiratory disease in India?
qh: तपेदिक (टीबी) रोग के लिए कौन सा जीवाणु जिम्मेदार होता है?
e: Tuberculosis (TB) ka karan Mycobacterium tuberculosis naam ka jivanu (bacterium) hota hai, jo ek chhadi (rod) jaisa jivanu hai tatha hawa ki boondon ke zariye ek vyakti se doosre mein faitt hai. Yahi jivanu mukhya roop se phere (lung) par hamla karta hai tatha dheere-dheere phere ke ootak (tissue) ko nasht kar deta hai, isliye rogi ko lambe samay tak khaansi, bukhar tatha wazan ghatna jaisi samasyaayein hoti hain. Iska elaj DOTS jaisi lambi dawa se hota hai, kyunki ye jivanu sharer mein chhipa reh sakta hai tatha adhoora elaj karne par dawa-pratirodhi (drug-resistant) ho jaata hai. Exam point: TB ka karan Mycobacterium tuberculosis hota hai, jo hawa se faitt hai tatha mukhya roop se phere ko prabhavit karta hai.

qe: What is 'BCG' vaccine used for?
qh: बीसीजी (BCG) का टीका किस बीमारी से बचाव के लिए लगाया जाता है?
e: BCG (Bacillus Calmette-Guerin) vaccine tuberculosis se bachav ke liye lagaya jaata hai, tatha ise janm ke thodi der baad hi bachhe ko lagaya jaata hai. Ismein kamzor (attenuated) kiye gaye jivanu hote hain, jo bimaar nahi karte par shareer mein pratiraksha (immunity) paida kar dete hain, isliye aage TB ke jivanu se ladne ki kshamata ban jaati hai. Isi karan bharat jaisi desh mein BCG sarvajanik tikakaran (universal immunization) ka hissa hai, kyunki TB yahan bahut aam hai. Exam point: BCG vaccine tuberculosis ke bachav ke liye lagaya jaata hai - ismein kamzor jivanu se pratiraksha banai jaati hai.

qe: The 'DOTS' strategy is associated with the treatment of which disease?
qh: 'डॉट्स' (DOTS) रणनीति किस बीमारी के उपचार और नियंत्रण से जुड़ी है?
e: DOTS (Directly Observed Treatment, Short-course) TB ke elaj ki wo reeti hai jismein rogi ki dawa uske saamne koi swasthya-karmi khilaata hai, taaki dawa poori tatha niyamit roop se li jaaye. Iska karan yahi hai ki TB ki dawa lambi (6-9 mahine) chalti hai tatha beech mein chhod dene par jivanu dawa ke prati pratiridh (resistant) ho jaata hai - isliye nigrani zaroori hai. Isi karan ye reeti bharat ke rashtriya kshay niyantran karyakram ka mukhya hissa bani, jisse ilaaj ki safalta badhi tatha naye pratiridh roop kam hue. Exam point: DOTS TB ke ilaaj ki nukari (supervised) reeti hai, jismein dawa poori karana sunishchit kiya jaata hai taaki jivanu pratirodhi na bane.

qe: In 'Infant Respiratory Distress Syndrome' (IRDS), the primary deficiency is of:
qh: समय से पूर्व जन्मे शिशुओं में 'IRDS' रोग मुख्य रूप से किसकी कमी से होता है?
e: Infant Respiratory Distress Syndrome (IRDS) naye janme shishu mein saans lene ki takleef ki wo sthiti hai jismein phere ke alveoli mein surfactant (jise lecithin bhi kehte hain) ki kami hoti hai; is padarth ke bina alveoli har saans par chipak jaate hain tatha phoolte nahi. Iska karan yahi hai ki surfactant paani ke prisht-tanav (surface tension) ko kam karta hai, isliye uske bina shishu ko saans lene mein bahut urja lagti hai tatha wo tezi se thak jaata hai. Isliye samay-se-pehle janme shishu (premature) sabse adhik prabhavit hote hain, kyunki unka surfactant us waqt tak poora nahi banta. Exam point: IRDS mein surfactant (lecithin) ki kami hoti hai, jiske bina alveoli chipak jaate hain tatha shishu ko saans lene mein kadhi takleef hoti hai.

qe: What is 'Cyanosis'?
qh: साइनोसिस (Cyanosis) क्या है?
o: Bluish discoloration of skin due to low oxygen
e: Cyanosis wo sthiti hai jismein khoon mein oxygen ki kami ke karan jild tatha mukhdhatu (mucous membrane) halki neeli ya bainguni dikhne lagti hai, khaas taur par hoth tatha ungliyon ke sire par. Iska karan yahi hai ki kam oxygen wala deoxyhaemoglobin (jo nila dikhta hai) khoon mein badh jaata hai, isliye jild ka rang neela pad jaata hai; ye phere, dil ya jaharili gas (jaise CO) ki bimari ka sanket hota hai. Iske ulat peela padna (jaundice) bilirubin tatha safed ho jaana khoon ki kami se juda hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: cyanosis mein oxygen ki kami ke karan jild tatha hoth neele-bainguni dikhte hain - ye phere ya dil ki takleef ka pratik (sign) hota hai.

qe: Which of the following describes 'Oxygen Toxicity'?
qh: ऑक्सीजन विषाक्तता (Oxygen Toxicity) की सही व्याख्या क्या है?
o: Damage caused by breathing high partial pressures of oxygen for long periods
e: Oxygen toxicity tab hoti hai jab koi vyakti lambe samay tak bahut adhik dabav wali (partial pressure) oxygen mein saans leta hai - jaise deep-sea diving ya ICU ventilation ke dauran. Isse phere ke ootak mein muktak (free radicals) bante hain, jo alveoli tatha aankh tatha snayu tantra ko kshati pahunchate hain; isliye divers ke tank mein oxygen ko helium jaisa inert gas milakar hissa (partial pressure) kam kiya jaata hai. Iske ulat kam oxygen (hypoxia) ya carbon dioxide se hone wali sthityan alag hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: oxygen toxicity adhik dabav wali oxygen lambe samay lene se hoti hai - isi karan divers ke tank mein oxygen ko dilute kiya jaata hai.

qe: The 'Mantoux Test' (Skin test) is used to screen for:
qh: मैनटॉक्स परीक्षण (Mantoux Test) किसकी जांच के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Mantoux test (tine test) TB ke jivanu ke prati sharer ki pratiraksha (immunity) jaanne ke liye jild par liya jaane wala pariksha hai; ismein TB ke antigen ka thoda ghol jild mein chubhoya jaata hai tatha 48-72 ghante baad us jagah ka sujan (swelling) maapa jaata hai. Yadi vyakti pehle se jivanu ke sampark mein aaya hai to uski shaariya-koshikaayein (T-cells) us jagah par birang (react) karti hain tatha laal-sujan banta hai - isse sangraman (infection) ka pata chalta hai. Iske ulat ye COVID ya typhoid ke liye nahi, balki TB ke jivanu ki pehchaan ke liye hota hai. Exam point: Mantoux test TB (kshay) ki janch ke liye jild par liya jaata hai - ismein 48-72 ghante baad sujan paida hone par parinaam dhan maana jaata hai.

qe: What is the function of the 'Cilia' in the trachea?
qh: श्वास नली (ट्रेकिया) में मौजूद 'सिलिया' का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
o: Moving mucus and trapped particles upward away from the lungs
e: Trachea (shwasanalika) ki antari parat par chhote-chhote rom (cilia) hote hain, jo lehar-daar chalan (beating) karte hain; inki madad se shwasanalika mein phansi kachra, dhool, jivanu tatha balgam (mucus) upar ki or - gale ki or - dhakel diya jaata hai. Isi karan ye kachra nigal jaata hai ya khaansi/bhukane se bahar aa jaata hai tatha phere tak nahi pahunchta; yahi phere ki pehli raksha-rekha hai. Iske ulat ye oxygen ko sokhne ya khoon tak pahunchane ka kaam nahi karti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: trachea ki cilia balgam tatha kachre ko upar dhakel kar phere se door rakhti hain - yahi shwasan tantra ki raksha ka pehla kadam hai.

qe: Which type of 'Lung Cancer' is most strongly linked to tobacco smoking?
qh: धूम्रपान से सबसे मजबूती से जुड़ा फेफड़ों के कैंसर का प्रकार कौन सा है?
e: Small cell lung carcinoma (chhote koshika wala phere ka cancer) tambaku (tobacco) ke dhuen se sabse adhik jurda hua hai; ye phere ke beech wale hisse (central) mein banta hai tatha bahut tezi se faitt tatha asaani se sharer ke anya bhaag tak pahunch jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki tambaku ke dhuen mein maujood kai kankadi (carcinogens, jaise nitrosamines) seedha DNA ko kshati pahunchate hain, isliye ye cancer bahut hamlavar hota hai par shuruaat mein lakshan kam dikhate hain. Iske ulat non-small cell cancer ka sambandh bhi smoking se hota hai, par small cell ka sambandh sabse gahan maana jaata hai. Exam point: smoking se sabse adhik juda hua phere ka cancer small cell lung carcinoma hai; ye bahut tezi se faitt hai tatha shuruaat mein lakshan kam dikhata hai.

qe: What is 'Hypercapnia'?
qh: हाइपरकेपनिया (Hypercapnia) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Abnormally high levels of CO2 in the blood
e: Hypercapnia wo sthiti hai jismein khoon mein carbon dioxide (CO2) ki matara saadharan se bahut adhik ho jaati hai; iska karan mukhya roop se kam shvasan (hypoventilation) hota hai - yani vyakti poori tarah saans nahi le paata, isliye CO2 sharer se bahar nahi nikalta. Iske karan sar-dard, susti, bhram (confusion) tatha gahri nind (somnolence) jaisi samasyaayein hoti hain; bahut adhik badh jaane par ye jaanleva bhi ho sakta hai, isliye ICU mein CO2 ka star maapa jaata hai. Iske ulat oxygen ki kami wali sthiti (hypoxia) tatha badhe tapman wali (hyperthermia) alag hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: hypercapnia ka matlab khoon mein CO2 ka star badh jaana hai, jo kam shvasan (hypoventilation) ke karan hota hai.

qe: What is the clinical diagnostic significance of the 'Lecithin to Sphingomyelin' (L/S) ratio?
qh: 'लेसिथिन से स्फिंगोमाइलिन' (L/S) अनुपात का नैदानिक महत्व क्या है?
e: Lecithin tatha sphingomyelin (L/S) ka anupat biliary (amniotic) drav mein maapa jaata hai tatha isse bhrahun ke phere ke paripakv (mature) hone ka pata chalta hai - 2 se adhik anupat aam taur par phere ke paripakv hone ka sanket hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki lecithin (surfactant ka mukhya tatva) bhraun ke phere mein samay ke saath badhta jaata hai, isliye asaadharan kam aankde par IRDS ka khatra zyada hota hai. Isi karan samay-se-pehle prasav ke nirnay mein ye janch madadgar hoti hai, kyunki iske aadhaar par phere ki tayaari ka andaza lagta hai. Exam point: L/S anupat bhraun ke phere ki paripakvata (maturity) batata hai - yahi IRDS ke khatre ka andaza lagane ke liye istemal hota hai.

qe: Which of the following is the 'Universal form' of energy for cell respiration?
qh: कोशिकीय श्वसन के लिए ऊर्जा का सार्वभौमिक रूप कौन सा अणु है?
e: ATP (adenosine triphosphate) ko koshika ki 'urja ki mudra' ya saarvabhaumik urja-roop kehte hain, kyunki shvasan (respiration) mein nikli urja isi anu mein bandh (store) hoti hai tatha koshika ke sabhi kaam isi se chalti hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki ATP mein do phosphate ke beech ek high-energy bandhan hota hai tatha uske tootne par turant urja mil jaati hai, isliye koshika ushe jaldi istemal kar sakti hai. Iske ulat glucose tatha anya padarth (jaise fat) urja ke bhaar (reservoir) hain, par seedha kaam ke liye ATP hi chahiye hota hai. Exam point: ATP koshika ke shvasan ki saarvabhaumik (universal) urja hai - yahi anu urja ko bandh kar sabhi jivan-kriyaon ke liye chhoda karta hai (jaise yahi kehlata hai ATP).

qe: What is 'Hemoptysis'?
qh: हेमोप्टाइसिस (Hemoptysis) क्या है?
o: Coughing up blood from the respiratory tract
e: Sangrahan (hemoptysis) ka matlab hai khaansi ke saath khoon aana, jis ka srot phere ya shwasan tantra (mukhya roop se bronchi) hota hai - ye pasli ya pet ke ghay se alag hota hai. Iska karan phere mein aise chot, sangram (TB), cancer ya rag-tantuka ka phaTna ho sakta hai, isliye gahre laal rang wala jhaagdaar (frothy) khoon iska khaas nishaan hota hai; ise kabhi bhi har (ignore) nahi karna chahiye. Iske ulat naak se khoon (epistaxis) ya pet se khoon (hematemesis) alag sthiti hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: hemoptysis ka matlab shwasan-tantra ya phere se khaansi ke saath khoon nikalna hai - yahi TB tatha anya phere ki bimariyon ka khaas nishaan hota hai.

qe: The 'Trachea' divides into right and left primary bronchi at the level of which vertebrae?
qh: श्वास नली (ट्रेकिया) किस कशेरुका के स्तर पर दाएँ और बाएँ प्राथमिक ब्रोंकाई में विभाजित होती है?
e: Trachea (shwasanalika) neeche jaate hue lagbhag paanchave vaksa (T5) ke sthan par do bhaagon mein bant jaati hai - daahina tatha baayan mukhya bronchi - tatha yehi jagah 'carina' kehlati hai. T5 (paanchave vaksa) ka ye sthan isliye mahatvapurn hai ki yahan se vipath (foreign body) jab daahini or jaata hai to zyada aasaani se phere mein utar jaata hai, kyunki daahini bronchus zyada seedhi tatha chaudi hoti hai. Isi karan doctor kabhi-kabhi bronchoskopy tatha X-ray mein isi sthan ko dhyaan se dekhte hain; anya vaksa (C7, T3 ya L1) is vichaar ke anusaar sahi nahi hote. Exam point: trachea T5 vaksa ke sthan par daahini tatha baayan primary bronchus mein bant jaati hai - isi jagah ko carina kehte hain.

qe: Which of the following describes 'Cheyne-Stokes' breathing?
qh: चेन-स्टोक्स श्वसन (Cheyne-Stokes breathing) की क्या विशेषता है?
o: Cycles of increasing and decreasing breathing followed by apnea
e: Cheyne-Stokes shvasan ek aisi vikrit shvasan (abnormal breathing) reeti hai jismein saans dheere-dheere gahri hoti jaati hai, phir halki padi jaati hai tatha kuchh samay ke liye saans bilkul ruk (apnea) jaati hai; phir yahi chakra dohraata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki mastishk (brain) ka shvasan-kendra CO2 ke star prati sahi tarah se pratikriya nahi de paata, isliye shvasan ka niyantran asthir (unstable) ho jaata hai - ye heart failure, stroke ya uchch sthalon ki bimari mein dikhta hai. Iske ulat keval tez saans (tachypnea) ya gahri saans (Kussmaul) alag reeti hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Cheyne-Stokes shvasan mein saans badhne-ghatne ke chakra bante hain tatha beech mein apnea aata hai - ye mastishk ke shvasan-niyantran ki gadtii (imbalance) ka nishaan hai.

qe: What is the theoretical 'Respiratory Quotient' (RQ) of Protein oxidation?
qh: प्रोटीन के ऑक्सीकरण का श्वसन गुणांक (RQ) मान कितना होता है?
e: Respiratory Quotient (RQ) batata hai ki koshika dwara chhodi gayi CO2 tatha upyog ki gayi O2 ka anupat kya hai; carbohydrate ke liye ye 1.0 hota hai, fat ke liye lagbhag 0.7 tatha protein ke liye 0.8-0.9 hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki protein mein oxygen ki matara kam hoti hai tatha uske tootne ke liye zyada oxygen chahiye, isliye RQ 1 se kam aata hai; isi gun se ye pata lagta hai ki sharer kis indhan (carbohydrate, fat ya protein) ka upyog kar raha hai. Iske ulat carbohydrate wala 1.0 tatha fat wala 0.7 alag aankde hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: protein ke oxid hona par RQ lagbhag 0.8-0.9 hota hai - yahi anupat batata hai ki sharer ka indhan kaunsa hai.

qe: Which inert gas is used to dilute Oxygen in the tanks of deep-sea saturation divers to avoid toxicity?
qh: गहरे समुद्र के गोताखोरों के सिलेंडर में ऑक्सीजन को पतला करने के लिए कौन सी गैस मिलाई जाती है?
e: Bahut gehre samudra mein (saturation diving) divers ke tank mein shuddh oxygen ka dabav adhik hone se oxygen toxicity tatha snayu (nervous system) par narve (narcosis) jaisi samasya hoti hai; isliye oxygen ko helium jaisa inert gas mila kar uska hissa kam kiya jaata hai. Helium ka fayda yahi hai ki wo sharer mein nahi ghulta (bina kriya), bahut halka hai tatha dabav badhne par bhi uska nasha nahi hota, isliye deep diving mein yahi gas upyukt maani jaati hai. Iske ulat nitrogen ya argon adhik gholeel tatha nashak ho jaate hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: deep-sea saturation divers ke tank mein oxygen ko helium se dilut kiya jaata hai, taaki oxygen toxicity se bacha ja sake tatha nasha na ho.

qe: The normal 'Pleural Cavity' between the lung linings contains:
qh: फेफड़ों के आवरण की 'प्लूरल गुहा' में सामान्यतः क्या उपस्थित होता है?
o: A thin layer of serous fluid
e: Phere ke charon or ek dohari jhilli (double membrane) hoti hai - bahari 'parietal pleura' tatha andaruni 'visceral pleura' - aur in dono ke beech ki ek patli khaali jagah pleural cavity kehlati hai; ismein sirf ek patli parat wala saarv (serous fluid) hota hai, hawa nahi. Is taral (fluid) ka kaam yahi hai ki dono jhilliyaan ek doosre par aasaani se sarak sake tatha saans lete samay gharsh (friction) na ho; isi karan saans lena chubhta nahi tatha phere khulne-sikudne mein aasaani hoti hai. Iske ulat ismein hawa ya khaali sthiti nahi hoti (hawa aane par 'pneumothorax' wali takleef hoti hai), isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: pleural cavity mein sarv (serous fluid) ki ek patli parat hoti hai, jo saans lete samay jhilliyon ke beech gharsh ko rokti hai.

qe: What is 'Anaerobic Threshold' during strenuous physical exercise?
qh: व्यायाम के दौरान 'अवायवीय दहलीज' (Anaerobic Threshold) क्या है?
o: Point during exercise where lactic acid starts to accumulate
e: Anaerobic threshold (lactate threshold) wo bindu hota hai jab vyayam ki tez gati ke karan mastishk (muscles) ko utni oxygen nahi mil paati jitni unhe chahiye, isliye wo oxygen ke bina urja banaane lagte hain tatha lactic acid jama hone lagta hai. Isi bindu ke baad thakan, masheShon mein jalan tatha saans phoolne jaisi sthitiyan banti hain, isliye khelon ki taiyaari mein ise (jaise blood lactate test) maapa jaata hai tatha taiyaari se badhaya jaata hai. Iske ulat ye bindu keval oxygen ki kami (hypoxia) ya tapman ka naap nahi hai, balki vyayam ke dauran banne wala roop hai. Exam point: anaerobic threshold wo samay hai jab vyayam ke karan lactic acid jama hone lagta hai - yahi shareer ka 'anaerobik' urja istemal karne ka bindu hai.

qe: Which anatomical division of the 'Pharynx' serves solely as a respiratory air passage?
qh: ग्रसनी (Pharynx) का कौन सा भाग केवल वायु मार्ग के रूप में कार्य करता है?
e: Grasnala (pharynx) ke teen bhaag hote hain - nasopharynx, oropharynx tatha laryngopharynx; inmein nasopharynx (naak ka khaali bhaag) sirf hawa (shvasan) ke liye kaam karta hai, kyunki wahan khaane ka raasta nahi aata tatha wahan sirf hawa ka aana-jaana hota hai. Isi karan naak se saans lene wali hawa is bhaag se hoti hui trachea tak pahunchti hai, tatha isi bhaag mein 'adenoids' (lymph ootak) hote hain; iske ulat oropharynx tatha laryngopharynx sahkshan (digestive) tatha shvasan dono raaste hote hain. Isliye nasopharynx hi wo bhaag hai jo keval shvasan ke liye hai. Exam point: pharynx ka nasopharynx bhaag keval hawa ke aane-jaane (shvasan) ke liye kaam karta hai; baaki bhaag khaane tatha hawa dono ke raaste hain.

qe: Where does the fundamental exchange of respiratory gases take place in human lungs?
qh: मानव फेफड़ों में गैसों का वास्तविक आदान-प्रदान कहाँ होता है?
e: Phere ke bheetar hawa bronchus se bronchioles tatha ant mein alveoli (hawa ki chhoti thailiyan) tak pahunchti hai; asli gas-tabdeel (exchange) alveoli mein hi hoti hai, kyunki wahan ki deewar bahut patli hoti hai tatha us par khoon ki bahut baarik koshikaayein (capillaries) chhipki hoti hain. Isi patli deewar tatha chaude kshetrafal ke karan oxygen khoon mein aur CO2 bahar aasaani se jaa-paa sakta hai; phere ka baaki hissa (bronchi, trachea) keval hawa ka raasta hai, na ki gas ka bahav-bindu. Isi karan alveoli ki sankhya karodon mein hoti hai tatha unka kul kshetrafal lagbhag ek tennis court jitna banta hai. Exam point: shvasan-gas ki asli tabdeel alveoli mein hoti hai, kyunki wahan patli deewar tatha khoon ki baarik nalikan (capillary) ek saath hoti hain.

qe: Which organ is primarily targeted and inflamed in Tuberculosis (TB) and Pneumonia?
qh: तपेदिक (टीबी) और निमोनिया से मुख्य रूप से कौन सा अंग प्रभावित होता है?
e: TB (kshay) tatha nimoniya (pneumonia) dono mukhya roop se phere (lung) par hamla karte hain - TB ke jivanu dheere-dheere phere ke ootak mein ghar banaate hain tatha unhe 'cavity' (gaadha) mein badal dete hain, jabki pneumonia mein phere ki hawa ki thailiyaan taral (fluid) tatha jivanuon se bhar jaati hain. Isi karan dono bimariyon mein khaansi, saans ki takleef tatha bukhar jaisi samasyaayein hoti hain tatha X-ray mein phere ke dhabbe dikhte hain. Iske ulat gurda ya mastishk mein TB ke jivanu pahunch sakte hain, par mukhya lakshan aam taur par phere ke hi hote hain. Exam point: TB tatha pneumonia dono ka mukhya lakshya phere hote hain; isi karan dono mein khaansi tatha saans ki takleef mukhya lakshan hote hain.

qe: Which chronic respiratory disorder is characterized by bronchospasm and severe wheezing, often aggravated by fungal spores or allergens?
qh: फेफड़ों की वह कौन सी बीमारी है जिसमें कवक या एलर्जी के कारण श्वासनलियों में संकुचन और भारी खांसी होती है?
e: Asthma (dama) ek lambi avadhi ki (chronic) shwasan bimari hai jismein shvasan-marg (bronchi) ke snayu (muscles) achanak sikud jaate hain tatha unki antari parat sujan (inflamed) hone lagti hai, isse hawa ka raasta patla ho jaata hai tatha seeti jaisi aawaz (wheezing) tatha saans phoolna shuru hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki asthme ke rogion mein dhool, parag (pollen), fungal spore ya thandi hawa jaisi cheezein snayu-tantra ko uksa deti hain tatha bronchi mein jhaag (mucus) badh jaata hai - isliye ise 'trigger' (upadrav) kehte hain. Isi karan inhaler (saans ke zariye dawa) ka istemal hota hai, jo bronchi ko kholta hai. Exam point: asthma ki pehchaan bronchospasm tatha wheezing hai, jo dhool tatha fungal spore jaise upadravon se badh jaati hai.

qe: What is the physiological definition of 'Hypoxia'?
qh: हाइपोक्सिया (Hypoxia) की सही शारीरिक परिभाषा क्या है?
e: Hypoxia wo sthiti hai jismein ootak (tissues) ko poori matara mein oxygen nahi mil paati, chahe khoon mein oxygen ki matara kam ho, khoon ka bahav ruk gaya ho ya ootak khud oxygen nahi le paaye. Iske karan koshikaayein urja (ATP) ka nirman kam kar paati hain, isliye kamzori, bhram (confusion) tatha bahut badh jaane par mastishk tatha dil ka kaam ruk sakta hai; uchch sthalon par kam oxygen ke karan bhi yahi hota hai. Iske ulat hypercapnia mein CO2 ka star badh jaata hai tatha hyperoxia mein oxygen adhik hoti hai - dono alag samasyaayein hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: hypoxia ka matlab ootak mein oxygen ki kami hai - isi karan koshikaayein urja kam bana paati hain tatha sharer kamzor padta hai.

qe: Insects primarily breathe through which specialized respiratory network?
qh: कीट मुख्य रूप से अपने शरीर के किस तंत्र से सांस लेते हैं?
e: Keedon-makodon (insects) mein shvasan ke liye vishesh naali-tantra (tracheal system) hoti hai, jismein shareer ke chhidron (spiracles) se hawa naaliyon (tracheae) mein jaati hai jo poore shareer ki koshikaon tak seedha pahunchti hai - yani oxygen seedha ootak tak pahunchta hai, khoon ke zariye nahi. Isi karan keede ke shareer mein mukhya roop se oxy-jaivik-naali (tracheoles) ka jaal bichha hota hai tatha unka 'khoon' oxygen dhone ka kaam mukhya roop se nahi karta; iske ulat mendhak (skin tatha phefde) tatha machhli (gills) alag tareeke se saans lete hain. Isliye keedon ke liye trachea wala jod hi sahi hai. Exam point: keede trachea (shvas-naaliyon) ke jaal se saans lete hain - hawa seedha ootak tak pahunchti hai, na ki khoon ke zariye.

qe: Which internal organ is primarily responsible for the elimination of gaseous Carbon Dioxide (CO2) and water vapor?
qh: कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड (CO2) और जलवाष्प के उत्सर्जन के लिए कौन सा मुख्य अंग जिम्मेदार है?
e: Shvasan mein nikli carbon dioxide (CO2) tatha paani ki bhaap ko bahar nikalne ka mukhya kaam phere (lungs) karte hain; alveoli ki patli deewar se ye dono padarth khoon se hawa mein aakar saans ke zariye bahar chale jaate hain. Isi karan saans chhodne wali hawa mein CO2 ki matara aane wali hawa se lagbhag 100 guna adhik hoti hai, tatha saans ke saath paani ki bhaap bhi bahar nikal jaati hai - isliye sheeshe ke saamne saans chhodne par us par namii ki parat aa jaati hai. Iske ulat gurda (kidney) ang-paani tatha urea nikaalta hai, isliye wo gas tatha bhaap ke liye sahi vikalp nahi. Exam point: phere CO2 tatha paani ki bhaap ko bahar nikalne wala mukhya ang hain; isi liye saans chhodne wali hawa mein CO2 tatha namii zyada hoti hai.

qe: What happens to the volumetric composition of atmospheric gas during a normal respiratory cycle?
qh: सामान्य श्वसन चक्र के दौरान ली गई और छोड़ी गई हवा में गैसों का क्या प्रतिशत होता है?
o: Inhale 21% O2, Exhale approx 17% O2 (approx 4% utilized)
e: Aane wali hawa mein oxygen lagbhag 21 pratishat tatha chhodi gayi hawa mein lagbhag 17 pratishat oxygen hoti hai, kyunki shareer har saans mein lagbhag 4-5 pratishat oxygen ka upyog kar leta hai (baaki hissa CO2 tatha paani ki bhaap se badal deta hai). Yahi 4 pratishat ka antar hi 'utilized oxygen' kehlata hai tatha ise saans ki janch (jaise pulse oximeter, spirometer) se dekha jaata hai; gahan vyayam mein ye matara badh jaati hai. Iske ulat nitrogen ka hissa (78%) tatha argon jaisi ashkriya gasen lagbhag same rehti hain, kyunki wo shareer mein nahi ghulti tatha upyog nahi hoti. Exam point: aane wali hawa mein 21% tatha chhodi gayi hawa mein lagbhag 17% oxygen hoti hai - yani har saans mein kareeb 4% oxygen upyog hoti hai.

qe: Which toxic gas binds to human hemoglobin with an affinity roughly 200 to 250 times greater than oxygen?
qh: कौन सी जहरीली गैस हीमोग्लोबिन से ऑक्सीजन की तुलना में 200 से 250 गुना अधिक मजबूती से जुड़ती है?
e: Carbon monoxide (CO) ek rangheen tatha gandhheen jaharili gas hai jo haemoglobin se lagbhag 200-250 guna adhik mazbooti se jud jaati hai (carboxyhaemoglobin banakaar), isliye oxygen ke liye koi jagah nahi bachti tatha ootak ko oxygen nahi pahunchti. Iska karan yahi hai ki CO ka bandhan haemoglobin ke saath oxygen se kai guna sthir hota hai, isliye thodi matara bhi bahut nuksan karti hai tatha rogi ka rang 'cherry red' dikhta hai; yahi Minto (silent) mrityu ka karan banta hai. Iske ulat CO2 shareer mein banta hai tatha uski zehirila matara kam hoti hai, isliye wo jod sahi nahi. Exam point: CO haemoglobin se 200-250 guna adhik mazbooti se judta hai, isliye oxygen ka dhulai band ho jaati hai - yahi aag-bujhane yantra ya bandh kamre ki mrityu ka karan hai.

qe: What is the biomechanical function of the 'C-shaped' hyaline cartilage rings supporting the trachea?
qh: श्वास नली (ट्रेकिया) में लगे C-आकार के हायलिन कार्टिलेज के छल्लों का क्या कार्य है?
o: Prevent airway collapse during negative pressure changes
e: Trachea ke aage-pichhe (wall) mein 'C' aakaar ki hyaline cartilage ki valayein hoti hain, jo trachea ko khuli (open) rakhne ka kaam karti hain - inke bina saans lete samay andar ka rin dabav (negative pressure) trachea ko baith (collapse) kar deta, jisse hawa ka raasta band ho jaata. Unka C-aakaar isliye hai ki aage cartilage hai tatha peeche nachh (smooth muscle) - yani khane ki naali (oesophagus) failne ki jagah bachi rehti hai, isliye nigalne mein rukavat nahi hoti. Iske ulat ye oxygen ke sokhne ya balgam banane ka kaam nahi karti, keval dhaanche ko saadharan rakhti hai. Exam point: trachea ki C-aakaar valayein use baithne (collapse) se bachaati hain tatha unka C-roop nigalne ke liye jagah chhodta hai.

qe: Which specialized radiological imaging scan is clinically used to quantify pulmonary involvement and ground-glass opacities in lungs?
qh: फेफड़ों के संक्रमण या क्षति का सटीक आकलन करने के लिए किस विशेष सीटी स्कैन का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: HRCT (High-Resolution Computed Tomography) phere ki bariki se janch karne wala ek vishesh CT scan hai, jismein bahut patli paraton (thin slices) ke chitre liye jaate hain; isse 'ground-glass opacities' (dhundhle kaanch jaisi jagah) tatha fiberosis (rag-tantuka ka jamaav) saaf dikhte hain. Yahi karan hai ki COVID tatha anya phere ki bimariyon mein phere ka kitna hissa prabhavit hua hai, ise isi scan se maapa jaata hai, kyunki saadharan X-ray mein itni bariki nahi dikhti. Iske ulat saadharan X-ray, MRI ya PET scan is naap ke liye upyukt nahi, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: phere ki bariki se janch tatha ground-glass opacities maapne ke liye HRCT scan istemal hota hai - yahi phere ki bimari ke vistar ka sahi andaza deta hai.

qe: How many anatomical lobes are present in the left and right lungs of a healthy human?
qh: मानव के दाएँ और बाएँ फेफड़ों में क्रमशः कितने लोब्स (Lobes) होते हैं?
o: Left has 2 lobes, Right has 3 lobes (Total 5)
Left has 3 lobes, Right has 2 lobes
e: Manushya ke daahine phere mein teen pind (lobes) hote hain - upper, middle tatha lower - jabki baayen phere mein do hi, kyunki daayen or dil ki majudgi ke karan jagah thodi kam banti hai tatha baayen phere mein 'cardiac notch' bana hota hai; yani kul paanch lobes hote hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki har pinda ka apna bronchus tatha khoon ki nahi hoti, isliye pinde ke hisse alag-alag bimari mein prabhavit ho sakte hain tatha doctor X-ray mein unhe alag pehchaanta hai.
