Iske ulat dono phere mein barabar pinde hone wala jod sahi nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hai. Exam point: manushya ke daahine phere mein teen tatha baayen mein do pinde hote hain (kul paanch) - yahi sharir-rachana ka sahi aankda hai.

qe: Where does the metabolic process of 'Internal' (Cellular) respiration occur?
qh: कोशिकीय श्वसन (Cellular Respiration) शरीर में कहाँ संपन्न होता है?
e: Koshika-shvasan (cellular respiration) ka asli hissa koshikaon ke bheetar chalta hai - pehla padav (glycolysis) cytoplasm mein tatha aage ke padav (Krebs chakra tatha electron parivhan) mitochondria mein hote hain; isi karan ise 'antar-koshikiya' (internal) shvasan kehte hain. Yahi karan hai ki mitochondria ko 'koshika ka urja-ghar' kaha jaata hai tatha ATP (urja ki mudra) wahin banti hai; bahari shvasan keval gas ka aana-jaana hai, jahan urja ka nirmaan nahi hota. Iske ulat bahari shvasan phefre aur alveoli mein hota hai, isliye is prashn mein koshikaon ke bheetar wala roop hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: internal (koshika) shvasan koshikaon ke bheetar - cytoplasm tatha mitochondria mein hota hai; yahi urja (ATP) banane ka asli bindu hai.

qe: The initial metabolic pathway of glucose breakdown occurring in the cytoplasm without oxygen is:
qh: ऑक्सीजन के बिना कोशिका द्रव्य में ग्लूकोज के टूटने का पहला चरण क्या कहलाता है?
e: Glucose ka pehla viyogan (breakdown) jab oxygen ke bina cytoplasm mein hota hai to ushe glycolysis (EMP pathway) kehte hain; ismein ek glucose ke anu se do pyruvate ke anu bante hain tatha thodi urja (net 2 ATP) milti hai. Yahi kriya sabhi jeevon (aerobic tatha anaerobic dono) mein chalti hai tatha iske baad agar oxygen mile to pyruvate mitochondria mein jaata hai tatha uske bina lactic acid ya ethanol banta hai; isliye yahi shvasan ka pehla tatha aam padav hai. Iske ulat Krebs chakra tatha electron parivhan mitochondria mein tatha oxygen par nirbhar hote hain, isliye wo is prashn ke sahi jod nahi. Exam point: oxygen ke bina cytoplasm mein glucose tootne wali pehli kriya glycolysis (EMP pathway) kehlati hai, jismein 2 ATP milti hain.

qe: What is the net ATP yield gained directly from the Glycolysis pathway per molecule of glucose?
qh: ग्लाइकोलाइसिस प्रक्रिया के दौरान एक ग्लूकोज अणु से शुद्ध (Net) कितने एटीपी प्राप्त होते हैं?
e: Ek glucose ke ek anu se glycolysis (EMP pathway) mein net do (2) ATP ke anu milte hain - yani shuruaat mein 2 ATP kharch hoti hain tatha kul 4 ATP bantin hain, isliye bacha hua laabh 2 ATP ka hota hai. Iske saath hi 2 NADH bhi bante hain, jo aage electron parivahan shrankhla mein bahut adhik ATP (lagbhag 5 ATP) dene mein sahayak hote hain; isliye glycolysis akeli kam urja deta hai, par agle padav ke liye aadhaar ban jaata hai. Iske ulat ye kriya mitochondria mein nahi hoti, isliye 'wo poora 36-38 ATP' wala aankda yahan sahi nahi hoga. Exam point: glycolysis se seedha net 2 ATP per glucose milti hain (aur 2 NADH), baaki urja aage ke padavon se milti hai.

qe: Which 2-carbon molecule serves as the essential metabolic link between cytoplasmic Glycolysis and the mitochondrial Krebs cycle?
qh: ग्लाइकोलाइसिस और क्रैब्स चक्र के बीच योजक कड़ी (Connecting Link) के रूप में कौन सा अणु कार्य करता है?
e: Glycolysis ke baad bane pyruvate ko mitochondria mein le jaane ke liye ushe pehle do-carbon wale acetyl-CoA mein badalna padta hai; yahi acetyl-CoA aage Krebs chakra (citric acid cycle) mein ekhon (enter) hota hai, isliye ise 'glycolysis tatha Krebs chakra ke beech ka pul' kaha jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki acetyl-CoA mein bacha hua urja-khand (acetyl group) hi aage oxid hota hai tatha CO2 tatha ATP banata hai; yadi ye padav na ho to energy ka poora shrankhla ruk jaata. Iske ulat glucose, pyruvate ya lactic acid seedha Krebs chakra mein enter nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: glycolysis tatha Krebs chakra ke beech ka do-carbon wala pul acetyl-CoA hota hai - yahi mitochondria mein Krebs chakra ko start karta hai.

qe: What is the primary biomechanical function of the Diaphragm during muscular inhalation (inspiration)?
qh: सांस लेते समय डायफ्राम का मुख्य कार्य क्या होता है?
o: Contracts and flattens downward, expanding thoracic cavity volume to draw air in
e: Diaphragm (vaksheen) ek pathhadar snayu (muscular sheet) hai jo pe (pectoral) tatha pet (abdominal) gunnah (cavities) ko alag karti hai; saans lete yani dahal (inspiration) samay ye sikud kar niche flat hoti hai, jisse vaksheen ki jagah badhti hai tatha phere ke andar hawa kheenchi jaati hai. Isi karan gehri saans mein pet bahar ki or ubharta dikhta hai, kyunki diaphragm niche hoti hai tatha andar ka dabav ghat jaata hai; chhodne (expiration) samay ye dheeli hokar wapas dome aakaar mein aa jaati hai. Iske ulat sirf passliyan (ribs) hi saans ka kaam nahi karti, isliye 'diaphragm' hi is prashn ka sahi jod hai. Exam point: dahal samay diaphragm sikud kar niche flat hoti hai tatha vaksheen ki jagah badhne se hawa andar kheenchti hai.

qe: What respiratory organ is utilized by aquatic tadpoles before metamorphosing into lung-bearing adult frogs?
qh: टेडपोल (मेंढक का बच्चा) श्वसन के लिए किस अंग का उपयोग करता है?
e: Machhli jaisi tatha mendhak ke tadpole (leavat avastha) mein tatha unke shishu jeev-kriya mein gills (gilphade) hi shvasan ke liye istemal hote hain, kyunki wo paani mein rehte hain tatha gills paani mein ghuli oxygen sokh lete hain. Jab tadpole bada hokar mendhak ban jaata hai to uske gills lupt ho jaate hain tatha phere (aur jild) shvasan ka mukhya saadhan ban jaate hain, isliye vyask mendhak paani ke andar bhi hawa lene ke liye upar aata hai. Iske ulat trachea keedon mein tatha alveoli manushya mein shvasan ke ang hote hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: mendhak ke tadpole (bachhe) apne avastha-badal se pehle gills se saans lete hain, baad mein phefde mukhya saadhan ban jaate hain.

qe: What is the acoustic Voice Box in the human respiratory system responsible for phonation?
qh: मानव श्वसन प्रणाली में ध्वनि उत्पन्न करने वाला 'वॉयस बॉक्स' क्या कहलाता है?
e: Larynx (kanth-nasika) shvasan-naali ke upar wala bhaag hai jismein 'vocal cords' (swar tantu) lage hote hain; hawa ke guzarne se ye tantu kampan karte hain tatha aawaz (swar) paida hoti hai - isi liye ise 'voice box' (swar-peti) kehte hain. Iska aakaar tatha tantuon ka tanav badalne se aawaz ki pitch (uchchata) badalti hai, isliye gaana, bolna tatha khaansi ka niyantran isi se hota hai; isi karan ise ek shvasan tatha swar dono ka ang maana jaata hai. Iske ulat pharynx keval raasta hai tatha alveoli gas tabdeel ka ang hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: manushya ke shvasan tantra mein aawaz (phonation) paida karne wala 'voice box' Larynx hota hai - yahi swar-tantuon (vocal cords) ko sambhaale rakhta hai.

qe: What is the common anatomical crossroads where the digestive tract and respiratory tract intersect?
qh: पाचन और श्वसन दोनों तंत्रों के लिए उभयनिष्ठ (Common) मार्ग कौन सा है?
e: Pharynx (grasnala) hi wahi jagah hai jahan se khaane ki naali (oesophagus) tatha shvasan ki naali (trachea) dono ke raaste nikalte hain, isliye ise 'crossroads' (chauraha) kehte hain; nigalne ke samay epiglottis ka dhakkan trachea ko band kar deta hai taaki khaana saans ki naali mein na jaaye. Isi karan yadi koi khaane ke saath bolta ya hansata hai to khaana galat raaste mein (trachea) chala jaata hai tatha khaansi ka daur padta hai; isi karan pharynx ko pachan tatha shvasan ka saanjhaa raasta kaha jaata hai. Iske ulat larynx, oesophagus ya bronchus aise saanjhe bindu nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: pachan tatha shvasan ke raaste pharynx (grasnala) mein milte hain - yahi gale ka wahi chauraha hai jahan khaana ya hawa galat raaste mein ja sakti hai.

qe: Why does the human body lose its internal core heat production after death?
qh: मृत्यु के कुछ समय बाद शव ठंडा क्यों पड़ जाता है?
o: Cessation of cellular respiration and exothermic metabolic heat production
e: Sajeev koshikaayein apni urja (ATP) banane ke liye glucose ka upyog karti hain tatha is kriya mein kuchh urja ushma ke roop mein bahar nikalati hai - isi karan shareer ka tapman bana rehta hai tatha wo 'garam' rehta hai. Mritu ke baad koshikaon ki shvasan ruk jaati hai tatha ye ushma paida hona band ho jaata hai, isliye dabav ki tapman dheere-dheere kamre ke tapman ke barabar ho jaata hai. Iske ulat rasayanik kriya rukne ka matlab ye nahi ki saare padarth turant nasht ho jaate hain; par haan, urine tatha anya bahav (flux) bhi ruk jaate hain, isliye 'koshika shvasan ka rukna' hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: mrityu ke baad koshika-shvasan ruk jaane ke karan urja (ushma) paida hona band ho jaata hai tatha dabav ka tapman girkar vaataavran jaisa ho jaata hai.

qe: Why is the percentage of Nitrogen gas identical (approx 78%) in both inhaled and exhaled air?
qh: अंदर ली गई और बाहर छोड़ी गई हवा में नाइट्रोजन का प्रतिशत लगभग 78% समान क्यों रहता है?
o: Molecular Nitrogen is metabolically inert and not consumed or absorbed by human tissues
e: Aane wali tatha chhodi gayi hawa mein nitrogen gas ka anupat lagbhag ek hi (78 pratishat) rehta hai, kyunki nitrogen ek niShkriya (inert) gas hai - yani ye sharer ke ootak dwara na sokhi jaati hai na upyog ki jaati hai, na hi usme koi kriya hoti hai. Isi karan shvasan mein keval oxygen ka hissa ghatta hai (21 se 17 pratishat) tatha CO2 ka hissa badhta hai, par nitrogen jaisa ka taisa rehta hai; isliye ise 'ashkriya' gas bhi kehte hain. Iske ulat yadi nitrogen upyog hoti to uska hissa hamesha girta rehta, par aisa nahi hota, isliye 'niShkriya hona' hi iska sahi karan hai. Exam point: nitrogen ek niShkriya (inert) gas hai - isi karan uski matara aane wali tatha chhodi gayi hawa mein lagbhag ek jaisi (78%) rehti hai.

qe: Which instrument is deployed in respiratory physiology to record lung volumes, capacities, and ventilatory flow rates?
qh: फेफड़ों की क्षमता और श्वसन आयतन को मापने के लिए किस उपकरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Spirometer (respirometer) ek aisa yantra hai jo saans ke sambandh wali jaankariyan - jaise vaayukosh (tidal volume), jiwan-kshamata (vital capacity) tatha prati-second hawa ka bahav (flow rate) - maap kar ke unka aalekh (graph) bana deta hai. Iska upyog phere ki bimari (asthma, COPD) ki janch tatha ilaaj ka asar jaanne ke liye hota hai, kyunki isse ye pata chalta hai ki phere kitni hawa le-te hain tatha kitni hawa nikaal paate hain. Iske ulat stethoscope sunne ke liye, BP yantra dabav maapne ke liye tatha X-ray chhabi lene ke liye hota hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: phere ke aayatan tatha hawa ke bahav (flow) maapne wala yantra spirometer hota hai, jo phere ki bimariyan jaanne mein kam aata hai.

qe: What protective physiological reflex occurs if a foreign food particle accidentally enters past the glottis into the trachea?
qh: यदि भोजन गलती से श्वास नली में चला जाए तो कौन सी सुरक्षात्मक प्रतिवर्ती क्रिया होती है?
o: Violent Coughing and choking reflex to eject the foreign object
e: Jab khaane ka koi kan galat raaste se glottis (swar-dwar) ko paar kar ke trachea mein chala jaata hai, to trachea ki antari parat ka sanket mastishk tak pahunchta hai tatha khaansi ka tez reflex (pratikriya) shuru ho jaata hai - hawa ke tez jhatke se wo kan bahar nikal jaata hai. Isi karan aam taur par khaansi tatha dam-ghutan ki kriya se khaana ya koi kan bahar aa jaata hai; ise 'protective reflex' kehte hain tatha yahi sharer ki raksha ke liye bana hai. Iske ulat ye kriya sneezing (chheenk) ya nishshwasan (swallowing) se alag hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: khaana galat raaste se trachea mein jaane par tez khaansi tatha dam-ghutan wala bachav-reflex (protective reflex) chalta hai, jo kan ko bahar nikaalta hai.

qe: What happens to the position of the diaphragm during passive exhalation (expiration)?
qh: सांस बाहर छोड़ते (उच्छ्वास) समय डायफ्राम की गति कैसी होती है?
o: Relaxes and curves upward into a dome shape
e: Saans chhodne (passive expiration) ke samay diaphragm pehle ki tarah sikudi nahi rehti - wo dheeli ho jaati hai tatha wapas upar ki or dome (gumbad) aakaar mein aa jaati hai. Isse vaksheen ki jagah ghatti hai tatha phere ke andar ka dabav badhta hai, jis se hawa apne aap bahar nikal jaati hai - isiliye saadharan saans chhodne mein snayu ki vishesh mehnat nahi lagti (ye passive kriya hai). Iske ulat saans lene (inspiration) mein diaphragm sikud kar flat hoti hai, isliye dono kriyaon mein ulta asar hota hai. Exam point: passive exhalation mein diaphragm dheeli hokar gumbad (dome) aakaar mein wapas aati hai, jisse vaksheen ki jagah ghatne se hawa bahar nikal jaati hai.

qe: What is the normal resting respiratory breathing rate of a healthy adult human?
qh: विश्राम अवस्था में एक स्वस्थ वयस्क की सामान्य श्वसन दर प्रति मिनट कितनी होती है?
e: Swasth vyask ki saans ki gati saadharan aaram ke samay lagbhag 12 se 16 saans prati minute hoti hai; ye gati umar, vyayam, tapman tatha bimari ke hisaab se badal jaati hai - bachchon mein ye tez tatha vyayam ya bukhar mein bhi badh jaati hai. Isi karan doctor saans ki gati ko 'vital sign' maan kar maapta hai, kyunki ismein badlav phere, dil ya mastishk ki takleef ka pehla sanket hota hai; aaram mein rogi ki saans tez (tachypnea) ya dheemi ho to usi se aage ki janch hoti hai. Iske ulat 60-100 (dhadkan ka aankda) ya 120/80 (rakt-dabav) alag naap hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: swasth vyask ki saans ki gati 12-16 saans prati minute hoti hai - yahi 'vital sign' ke roop mein maapi jaati hai.

qe: Which muscular component is the most significant driver for expanding thoracic volume during active inspiration?
qh: सामान्य सांस लेने के दौरान छाती का आयतन बढ़ाने वाली सबसे महत्वपूर्ण मांसपेशी कौन सी है?
e: Saans lete (active inspiration) samay sabse adhik yogdaan diaphragm (vaksheen snayu) ka hota hai, jo sikudkar niche chali jaati hai tatha vaksheen ki gahrai badha deti hai; uske saath-saath bahari passli-tatha-antarvanshiya snayu (external intercostals) passliyon ko upar-kinare ki or uthate hain, jisse vaksheen ki chaudai badhti hai. Isi karan saans lete samay vaksheen ka bada hissa hawa kheenchne mein lagta hai (lagbhag 70 pratishat hissa diaphragm se); iske ulat andar ki passli-tatha-antarvanshiya snayu (internal intercostals) chhodne (expiration) mein madad karti hain. Isliye yahan 'diaphragm' hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: active inspiration mein vaksheen ki jagah sabse adhik diaphragm ke sikudne se badhti hai - saath mein bahari antarvanshiya snayu bhi madad karti hain.

qe: Which oxygen-binding hemoprotein found in skeletal muscle tissues possesses a higher oxygen affinity than adult hemoglobin?
qh: मांसपेशियों की कोशिकाओं में ऑक्सीजन संचित करने वाला वर्णक कौन सा है जिसकी ऑक्सीजन बंधुता हीमोग्लोबिन से अधिक होती है?
e: Myoglobin wo laal rang wala protein hai jo peShiyon (skeletal muscles) mein paaya jaata hai tatha oxygen ko bandh kar ke rakhta hai; iski oxygen se lagav (affinity) hemoglobin se adhik hoti hai, isliye ye peShi ki kaam karte samay oxygen ko aasaani se kheench leta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki myoglobin ke paas ek hi heme samooh hota hai tatha wo chaar oxygen ke bajaye ek hi anu bandh karta hai, isliye ushe oxygen chhodne ke liye bahut kam pO2 chahiye; isi gun se vyayam ke dauran peShiyon ko oxygen milti rehti hai. Iske ulat hemoglobin khoon mein oxygen ek jagah se doosri jagah dhota hai, isliye uski affinity myoglobin se kam hoti hai. Exam point: skeletal muscle mein maujood myoglobin ki oxygen-affinity hemoglobin se adhik hoti hai - isi karan wo vyayam ke samay peShiyon ko oxygen deta rehta hai.

qe: A chronic respiratory disorder characterized by permanent alveolar wall destruction and loss of elasticity, resulting in 'Barrel Chest', is:
qh: एल्वियोली की दीवारों के नष्ट होने से फेफड़ों में हवा फंसी रहने और 'बैरल चेस्ट' बनने वाली बीमारी कौन सी है?
e: Emphysema (COPD ka ek mukhya roop) wo lambi avadhi ki bimari hai jismein alveoli ki deewaarein dheere-dheere nasht ho jaati hain tatha unki elasticity (khinchav) chali jaati hai, isliye phere mein khaali hawa ki thailiyan bani rehti hain tatha chhati badhkar 'barrel chest' jaisi dikhne lagti hai. Iska karan mukhya roop se tambaku ka dhuan hota hai, jo alveoli ki deewar par bane elastin ko todta hai - isliye saans chhodna mushkil ho jaata hai tatha rogi ko hoth se saans lene (pursed-lip breathing) ki aadat pad jaati hai. Iske ulat asthma mein bronchi sikudte hain par alveoli nasht nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke sahi jod nahi. Exam point: alveoli ki deewar ka nasht hona tatha elasticity ka jaana emphysema (COPD) hai - isi karan chhati barrel aakaar ki ho jaati hai.

qe: Where is the primary involuntary Respiratory Rhythm Generator located in the human brainstem?
qh: मानव मस्तिष्क में मूल श्वसन लय केंद्र (Respiratory Rhythm Center) कहाँ स्थित होता है?
e: Shvasan ki gati ka apne aap chalne wala mukhya kendra manushya ke mastishk (brain) ke bhaag medulla oblongata mein hota hai; yahin se har saans ke liye snayu-kaaryakram (respiratory rhythm) paida hote hain, isliye ise 'respiratory rhythm generator' kehte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki medulla mein maujood neural samooh (jaise pre-Botzinger complex) apne aap chakra banaate hain tatha CO2 tatha pH ke badlav par apni gati badal lete hain - isi karan hum soote hue bhi saans lete rehte hain. Iske ulat cerebellum santulan ka tatha cerebrum sochne ka kaam karta hai, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke nahi hain. Exam point: shvasan ki rhythm paida karne wala mukhya kendra medulla oblongata mein hota hai, jahan se saans ka automatic chalan chalta hai.

qe: Which serous membranous layer is in direct, inseparable contact with the outer parenchymal surface of the human lungs?
qh: फेफड़ों की बाहरी सतह से सीधे चिपकी रहने वाली प्लूरा झिल्ली की परत कौन सी है?
e: Visceral pleura wo patli jhilli hai jo phere ki bahari satah (parenchymal surface) par seedha tatha bagair alag huye chipki hoti hai, isliye phere ke jhurridar aakaar ke saath ye bhi har mod par chipki rehti hai. Isi karan phere ke khulne-sikudne par ye jhilli bhi uske saath chalti hai tatha uske bahari hisse ko chot se bachaati hai; iske ulat parietal pleura chhati ki antari deewar se jadi hoti hai tatha dono ke beech pleural cavity hoti hai. Isi antar ke karan dono jhilliyon ke beech sarv (fluid) ki patli parat banti hai jo saans ke samay gharsh nahi hone deti. Exam point: phere ki bahari satah se seedha chipki hui jhilli visceral pleura hoti hai - yahi phere ke saath hi modti-mudti hai.

qe: What is the biological function of pulmonary surfactant secreted by alveolar Type II pneumocytes?
qh: टाइप-II न्यूमोसाइट्स द्वारा स्रावित पल्मोनरी सरफेक्टेंट का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
o: Reduces alveolar surface tension, preventing alveolar collapse during expiration
e: Alveoli ki antari satah par Type II pneumocytes dwara chhota (surfactant) padarth chhoda jaata hai, jiska kaam alveoli ki antari taral parat ki tanav (surface tension) ghatana hota hai; isse alveoli chhotti thailiyan aasaani se khulti rehti hain tatha saans chhodne ke samay chipak kar band nahi hoti. Iska karan yahi hai ki bina surfactant ke patli taral parat ki tanav ke karan alveoli baith jaati tatha har saans par unhe kholne mein bahut urja lagti; isi karan premature shishuon mein IRDS hoti hai. Iske ulat iska kaam oxygen ko dhona nahi, balki alveoli ko kholna hai. Exam point: alveolar Type II pneumocytes ka surfactant prisht-tanav kam karta hai tatha expiry (saans chhodne) samay alveoli ko chipakne (collapse) se bachaata hai.

qe: In an unmedicated, healthy human, which chemical blood variable is the most potent physiological trigger to stimulate breathing?
qh: सामान्य स्थिति में सांस लेने की दर को तेज करने वाला सबसे शक्तिशाली रासायनिक कारक कौन सा है?
o: Elevated arterial pCO2 (and consequent drop in CSF/blood pH)
e: Swasan ko sabse prabal roop se uksaane wala rasayanik sanket khoon mein carbon dioxide ka dabav (arterial pCO2) badhna tatha uske kaaran pH ka girna hota hai; ye badlav medulla ke kemoreseptor tatha aayan (carotid body) ke zariye shvasan-kendra ko saans tez karne ka aadesh dete hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki CO2 paani ke saath milkar carbonic acid banata hai, jisse pH girta hai tatha sharer ka sabse sanvedansheel (sensitive) niyantran yahi ho jaata hai; oxygen ki kami tatha anya sanket adhiktam mole mein utna prabal nahi hote. Isi karan rogi ki saans ki gati dwar CO2 nikaalna hi ushmagati ki saaramsha hai. Exam point: shvasan ka sabse prabal rasayanik kaaran khoon mein badha hua pCO2 (aur usse girta pH) hota hai - CO2 ke nikalne se sharer ka pH santulit rehta hai.

qe: What is the functional volume of the 'Functional Residual Capacity' (FRC) of human lungs?
qh: सामान्य सांस बाहर निकालने के बाद फेफड़ों में बची रहने वाली हवा की मात्रा (FRC) किनका योग है?
o: ERV + RV (Expiratory Reserve Volume + Residual Volume)
e: Functional Residual Capacity (FRC) phere mein uske svabhavik aaram (passive) stithi mein bachi hui hawa ka aayatan hota hai tatha ise do hisson ke jod se nikaala jaata hai - Expiratory Reserve Volume (ERV) tatha Residual Volume (RV). Iska karan yahi hai ki saadharan saans chhodne ke baad bhi phere mein kuchh hawa bachi rehti hai (ERV), jise poori tarah nikaalna sambhav nahi hota tatha thodi matara phere mein hamesha reh jaati hai (RV), kyunki phere chipak kar band ho jaate. Isliye FRC dono ka jod hota hai, isliye yahan ERV + RV hi sahi jod hai; TLC talhat se upar tak ki poora hai tatha IC phere ki kshati (capacity) batata hai. Exam point: Functional Residual Capacity (FRC) = ERV + RV hota hai - yani saadharan nishvas ke baad phere mein bachi hawa ka kul aayatan.

qe: What is the measured resting partial pressure of Oxygen ($pO_2$) in systemic deoxygenated venous blood?
qh: अशुद्ध (ऑक्सीजन रहित) शिरापरक रक्त में ऑक्सीजन का आंशिक दाब ($pO_2$) कितना होता है?
e: Deoxygenated (oxygen kam wale) khoon mein oxygen ka dabav (pO2) lagbhag 40 mmHg hota hai; yahi rakta phere se vapas hokar kaali mehran (vena cava) tatha dil ke dahine hisse se hote hue phere tak phir se oxygenation ke liye jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ootak oxygen ka upyog kar lete hain, isliye rakt-keshaon tatha kapilar mein pO2 girta hai tatha phere ki artariyon mein 95-100 mmHg reh jaata hai; isi antar (40 tatha 100) se phere mein gas ka sahi bahav banta hai. Isliye yahan 40 mmHg hi sahi jod hai, 100 ya 160 mmHg oxygenation ke baad ke aankde hain. Exam point: deoxygenated blood mein pO2 lagbhag 40 mmHg hota hai (oxygenated mein lagbhag 95-100 mmHg), isi antar se phere mein gas ka bahav hota hai.

qe: What clinical term describes subjective air hunger or difficult, labored, uncomfortable breathing?
qh: सांस लेने में भारी कठिनाई या दम फूलने की स्थिति को चिकित्सीय भाषा में क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Dyspnea wo aisi rogna (symptom) hai jismein rogi ko saans phoolne ka ya 'hawa ki bhookh' (air hunger) jaisa anubhav hota hai - saans lena takleefbhara tatha kathore (laboured) lagta hai, chahe saans ki gati saadharan bhi ho. Iska karan yahi hai ki mastishk ko is baat ka sanket milta hai ki ootak ko utni oxygen nahi mil rahi jitni unhe chahiye, isliye ye phere, dil ya khoon ki bimari (jaise pneumonia, anemia, heart failure) ka pehla lakshan hota hai. Iske ulat apnea (saans rukna) tatha tachypnea (saans ki gati tez hona) alag naam hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: dyspnea saans phoolne tatha hawa ki bhookh wala subahv (subjective) anubhav hai - ye phere ya dil ki bimari ka pehla lakshan hota hai.

qe: Which of the following organisms executes respiration primarily by Cutaneous Gas Diffusion across a moist glandular cuticle?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा जीव अपनी नम त्वचा (Cutaneous Respiration) से सांस लेता है?
e: Prithvi-kachua (earthworm) tatha anya narm-shareer jeev jinki jild patli tatha nam (moist glandular cuticle) hoti hai, wo apni jild ke zariye hi oxygen sokh kar tatha CO2 bahar chhod kar shvasan karte hain - ise jild-shvasan (cutaneous gas diffusion) kehte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki unki jild ko taral se nam rehna padta hai, kyunki oxygen pehle taral (moist) parat mein ghulta hai, phir khoon tak pahunchta hai; isliye sookhi mitti ya dhoop mein ye jeev mar jaate hain. Iske ulat phere wale jeev (jaise manushya) tatha keede apna apna alag tantra istemal karte hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: prithvi-kachua (earthworm) ki jild nam hone ke karan woo jild dwara hi gas ka aadan-pradan (cutaneous respiration) karta hai.

qe: What anatomical feature endows avian (bird) respiratory systems with continuous, unidirectional airflow during both inhalation and exhalation?
qh: पक्षियों के श्वसन तंत्र में वह कौन सी विशिष्ट संरचना है जो उन्हें उड़ते समय अत्यधिक कुशल श्वसन प्रदान करती है?
o: Extensive pulmonary Air Sacs providing continuous unidirectional flow
e: Pakshiyon (birds) ke phere ke saath hawa ke thailiyan (air sacs) juri hoti hain, jo hawa ko sambhaal kar rakhne ka kaam karti hain; in thailiyon tatha vishesh naali vyavastha ke karan saans lete tatha chhodte samay bhi hawa phere ke andar ek hi disha (unidirectional) mein behti rehti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki pakshiyon ki bronchioles tatha 'parabronchi' mein hawa ka do-padavi chalan hota hai, isliye unki gas-tabdeel tatha badgeel ki kshamata stanpaiyon (mammals) se adhik hoti hai - yahi unhe uchch ucchaai par uthne mein madad deta hai. Iske ulat saadharan phere wale jeevon mein hawa aane-jaane mein do disha mein chalti hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: pakshiyon ke phere ki saans dono ka desh mein ek hi disha mein chalti hai, isliye unki shvasan kshamata adhik hoti hai - iska aadhaar unke hawa-thaili (air sacs) hain.

qe: Why do victims of acute Carbon Monoxide (CO) poisoning exhibit an anomalous cherry-red skin color rather than cyanosis?
qh: कार्बन मोनोऑक्साइड विषाक्तता में त्वचा नीली पड़ने के बजाय चेरी जैसी लाल क्यों दिखाई देती है?
o: Carboxyhemoglobin complex is a brilliant cherry-red pigment
e: Carbon monoxide (CO) khoon ki haemoglobin se jud kar carboxyhaemoglobin banata hai, jiska rang chamakdar 'cherry red' (laal) hota hai; isi karan CO ke rogion ki jild tatha hoth neele (cyanotic) na hokar gulaabi-laal dikhte hain, chahe unke ootak ko oxygen nahi pahunch rahi. Iska karan yahi hai ki CO ka haemoglobin se bandhan (lagbhag 200-250 guna) adhik mazboot hota hai, isliye oxygen ki jagah le leta hai tatha rogi ko 'cherry red' rang a jata hai - yahi is vibhinnate ka preqt (sign) hai. Iske ulat cyanosis oxygen ki kami wali other bimaari mein hota hai, isliye CO ke rogion mein wo nahi dikhta. Exam point: CO ke rogion ki jild gulaabi-laal (cherry red) dikhti hai, kyunki carboxyhaemoglobin ek chamakdar laal rang wala padarth hota hai - isi karan cyanosis nahi banta.

qe: What is the functional definition of 'Inspiratory Capacity' (IC)?
qh: अंतःश्वसन क्षमता (Inspiratory Capacity - IC) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: TV + IRV (Tidal Volume + Inspiratory Reserve Volume)
e: Inspiratory Capacity (IC) wo aayatan batati hai jitni hawa ek vyakti aaram se saans lene ke baad poore bal se kheench (inspire) sakta hai; iska sutra TV (Tidal Volume) + IRV (Inspiratory Reserve Volume) hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki saadharan saans mein jo hawa aati hai (TV) uske upar vyakti zabardasti jo extra hawa le sakta hai (IRV), dono ka jod hi IC banta hai; isliye IC phere ki kshamata jaanne ke liye spirometry mein maapa jaata hai. Iske ulat FRC tatha TLC ko ERV, RV jaisi anay raashiyon ke sath ginte hain, isliye wo sutra is prashn ke sahi jod nahi. Exam point: Inspiratory Capacity (IC) = TV + IRV hota hai - yani aaram se saans lene ke baad poore bal se li jaane wali hawa ka aayatan.

qe: To which specific chemical moiety on the hemoglobin molecule does Carbon Dioxide bind to form Carbamino-hemoglobin?
qh: कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड हीमोग्लोबिन के किस भाग से जुड़कर कार्बाअमीनो-हीमोग्लोबिन बनाती है?
o: Free terminal amino groups (-NH2) of the globin polypeptide chains
e: Carbon dioxide (CO2) khoon mein mukhya roop se teen tarah se chalti hai - bikarbonal aayan (HCO3-) ke roop mein, paani mein ghul kar carbonic acid ke roop mein, tatha protein se judkar; hemoglobin ke saath judne wala roop 'carbamino-haemoglobin' kehta hai tatha ye hemoglobin ki globin shrankhalon ke ant wale amino samooh (-NH2) se judta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki CO2 ek amino samooh ke nitrogen se seedha judta hai (CO2 + Hb-NH2 se Hb-NH-COOH), isliye ise 'karbamino' bandhan kehte hain; yahi roop CO2 ko phere se ootak tak le jaane ka ek ahem saadhan hai. Iske ulat CO2 heme ke iron (jahan oxygen judta hai) se nahi, balki globin ke amino samooh se judta hai. Exam point: CO2 hemoglobin ki globin shrankhala ke ant wale amino samooh (-NH2) se judta hai tatha carbamino-haemoglobin banata hai.

qe: What clinical term defines the temporary, transient cessation of spontaneous breathing?
qh: सांस का कुछ समय के लिए अस्थायी रूप से रुक जाना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Apnea wo sthiti hai jismein saans kuchh samay ke liye ruk jaati hai - yani hawa ka aana-jaana asaadharan roop se band ho jaata hai, chahe wo kuchh second ka ho ya lamba. Iska karan mastishk ke shvasan-kendra ka asthir hona, neend mein shvasan ka rukna (sleep apnea), dabav ya dawa ka asar ho sakta hai; isliye ise alag naam diya gaya hai, kyunki lambi apnea mein oxygen gir jaati hai tatha jaan ka khatra ho sakta hai. Iske ulat dyspnea (saans phoolna) tatha tachypnea (saans tez hona) alag sthiti hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: apnea ka matlab saans ka asaadharan roop se thodi der ke liye ruk jaana hai - ye neend ya mastishk ki takleef ka sanket ho sakta hai.

qe: Alveolar 'Dust Cells' that phagocytose inhaled particulate pollutants and pathogens within the lungs are:
qh: फेफड़ों के एल्वियोली में धूल कणों और बैक्टीरिया को खाने वाली 'डस्ट सेल्स' वास्तव में क्या होती हैं?
e: Alveoli ke bheetar pahunch kar dhool, sukshm jeev tatha anya kankadi (particulates) ko kha jaane (phagocytosis) wali badi koshikaayein 'alveolar macrophages' hoti hain, jinhe 'dust cells' bhi kehte hain - yahi phere ki last raksha-rekha hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki inh koshikaon mein lacha (lysosome) wale bhaag hote hain jo sokhe hue padarth tatha jivanu ko pees dete hain; isi karan tambaku tatha pradushan wale vyakti ke phere mein ye koshikaayein kaali tatha adhik matara mein dikhti hain. Iske ulat Type II pneumocytes surfactant banate hain (wo bhojan (food) nahi khaate), isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke sahi jod nahi. Exam point: phere mein pahunchi dhool tatha jivanuon ko kha jaane wali koshikaayein alveolar macrophages (dust cells) hoti hain - yahi phere ki aakhri bachav-rekha hai.

qe: What is the typical physiological total capacity of fully inflated human adult male lungs (Total Lung Capacity - TLC)?
qh: एक वयस्क पुरुष के फेफड़ों की कुल क्षमता (Total Lung Capacity - TLC) लगभग कितनी होती है?
e: Vayask purush (fully inflated) ki kul phere-kshamata (Total Lung Capacity) lagbhag 5800 se 6000 millilitre hoti hai; ismein TV, IRV, ERV tatha RV sabhi aayatan jod liye jaate hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki saans lene ke saare hisson ka jod hi poora aayatan hota hai - saadharan saans (500 mL), bal-poorvak saans (3000 mL), bal-poorvak nishvas (1100 mL) tatha bachi hui hawa (1200 mL) milkar lagbhag 5.8 litre banti hai. Isi aankde se FRC tatha IC ka hissa nikaal kar phairoid (fibrosis) jaisi bimari ka andaza lagaya jaata hai. Iske ulat 1 litre ya 12 litre jaise aankde bahut kam ya bahut adhik hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: vayask purush ki Total Lung Capacity (TLC) lagbhag 5800-6000 millilitre (5.8-6 litre) hoti hai - yahi saari phere-kshamata ka jod hai.

qe: Which motor somatic nerve carries electrical impulses from cervical spinal roots C3-C5 to innervate the diaphragm?
qh: मस्तिष्क और रीढ़ से डायफ्राम को संकुचित करने का संकेत ले जाने वाली मुख्य तंत्रिका कौन सी है?
e: Vaksheen (diaphragm) ko chalane wali snayu phrenic nerve hoti hai, jo gale ke vaksheeya hisse (cervical spinal roots) C3, C4 tatha C5 se nikalti hai - isi liye ise 'C3, C4, C5 keeps the diaphragm alive' jaisa smaran (mnemonic) kehte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye snayu vaksheen ki peShiyon tak seedha pahunchti hai, isliye iske kshati se vaksheen ka chalan ruk jaata hai tatha saans lena kathin ho jaata hai; isi karan gardan ki chot (high spinal injury) bahut khatarnaak hoti hai. Iske ulat vagus nerve antari angon ka tatha intercostal nerves pasliyon ki peShiyon ka kaam karte hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: vaksheen ko chalane wali snayu phrenic nerve hoti hai, jo C3-C5 (gale ke vaksheeya hisse) se nikalti hai - isi karan is chot ka asar saans lene par padta hai.

qe: What physical event occurs when the thoracic wall is punctured, admitting atmospheric air into the intrapleural space (Pneumothorax)?
qh: छाती में छेद होने पर प्लूरल गुहा में हवा भर जाने (Pneumothorax) से क्या परिणाम होता है?
o: Negative intrapleural pressure is lost, causing elastic recoil to collapse the lung
e: Pneumothorax mein chhati ki satah chhid jaane ya phaTne ke karan intrapleural space mein hawa aa jaati hai; isse dono jhilliyon ke beech ka rin dabav (negative pressure) khatm ho jaata hai tatha phere apni elasticity (khinchav) ke karan sikudkar baith (collapse) jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki saadharan stithi mein intrapleural dabav bahari vaayu-mandal se kam hota hai, isliye phere chhati ki deewar se chipka rehta hai; dabav barabar hote hi phere apne aap se bahar ki or khinchta hai (elastic recoil). Isi karan ise hawa 'seedhi chhati ki jhilli ke bheetar' aane wali aapatsthiti maana jaata hai. Exam point: pneumothorax mein rin intrapleural dabav khatm hone se phere elastic recoil ke kaaran collapse ho jaata hai - yahi samasya ki mool wajah hai.

qe: The laryngeal prominence known as the 'Adam's Apple' is formed by the anterior fusion of which laryngeal cartilage plates?
qh: गले में एडम्स एप्पल (Adam's Apple) का निर्माण किस कार्टिलेज द्वारा होता है?
e: Kanth-nasika (larynx) ke aage wale hisse mein do bade upast (plates) aapas mein judkar ek ubhaar (prominence) banate hain, jo purushon mein saaf dikhta hai tatha jise 'Adam's apple' kehte hain; ye plates thyroid cartilage ki hoti hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki kishoravstha (puberty) mein is cartilage ka aakaar badh jaata hai tatha swar-tantu (vocal cords) lambe hone se aawaz bhaari ho jaati hai - isliye yahi upast ka judna ubhaar banata hai. Iske ulat cricoid tatha arytenoid cartilages chhote hote hain tatha aawaz ke niyantran se judte hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: purushon ke gale ka ubhaar (Adam's apple) thyroid cartilage ke aage wale plate judne se banta hai - yahi kishoravstha mein aawaz bhaari hone ka karan hai.

qe: In the Electron Transport Chain (ETC) of aerobic respiration, which chemical element functions as the 'Final Electron Acceptor'?
qh: इलेक्ट्रॉन परिवहन श्रृंखला (ETC) में इलेक्ट्रॉनों का अंतिम ग्राही (Final Electron Acceptor) कौन होता है?
e: Electron parivahan shrankhla (ETC) mein electron aakhir mein ek 'anthim griheeta' (final electron acceptor) par jaata hai, jo aadrash (aerobik) shvasan mein molecular oxygen (O2) hoti hai; oxygen electron tatha hydrogen leti hai tatha paani banati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki oxygen ki electron-affinity bahut adhik hoti hai tatha wo shrankhla ke ant mein sabse chhoti urja-wali jagah par baith kar ATP banane ka khel chalati hai; iske bina shrankhla ruk jaati tatha Krebs chakra bhi band ho jaata. Iske ulat CO2 antheem utpad hai, electron griheeta nahi, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: aerobic respiration ki electron transport chain (ETC) ka anthim electron griheeta molecular oxygen (O2) hoti hai - yahi paani banane ke saath ATP nirman karati hai.

qe: The enzymatic breakdown of fatty acids into 2-carbon Acetyl-CoA units to feed into the Krebs cycle is:
qh: ऊर्जा प्राप्त करने के लिए वसीय अम्लों (Fatty Acids) को एसिटिल-कोए में तोड़ने की प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
e: Beta-oxidation wo kriya hai jismein lambi shrankhla wale fatty acid ke anu do-do carbon ke tukdon (acetyl-CoA) mein tootte hain; yahi acetyl-CoA aage Krebs chakra mein jaata hai tatha urja (ATP) banata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki fatty acid ke beta (doosre) carbon par oxid hona hota hai, isliye har bar do carbon nikalta hai tatha shrankhla chhoti hoti jaati hai; isliye chathe tatha vrat (fasting) mein shareer apni chiknaai se yahi urja nikaalta hai. Iske ulat glycolysis glucose ke liye hota hai, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke sahi jod nahi. Exam point: fatty acid ka do-carbon ke acetyl-CoA mein tootna beta-oxidation kehlata hai - yahi Krebs chakra ko indhan deta hai.

qe: How many turns of the mitochondrial Krebs Cycle are executed for the complete catabolism of one single molecule of glucose?
qh: एक ग्लूकोज अणु के पूर्ण ऑक्सीकरण के लिए माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया में क्रैब्स चक्र को कितने चक्कर लगाने पड़ते हैं?
e: Ek glucose ka poora catabolism (tootna) hone par Krebs chakra do (2) baar chalta hai; iska karan yahi hai ki glycolysis se ek glucose se do pyruvate bante hain tatha har pyruvate se ek acetyl-CoA banta hai - isliye do acetyl-CoA Krebs chakra mein do chakra (turns) chalate hain. Isi ganit se do bar guanosine triphosphate (GTP), chhah NADH tatha do FADH2 bante hain, isliye poora ATP ka jod (lagbhag 36-38) nikalta hai; isliye '2 turns' hi sahi jod hai, 1 ya 4 nahi. Iske ulat ye keval gluconeogenesis mein ek hi chakra karta hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: ek glucose ke poore catabolism ke liye Krebs chakra do bar (2 turns) chalta hai, kyunki glucose se do acetyl-CoA bante hain.

qe: Which small peripheral hemoprotein functions as a mobile electron shuttle between Complex III and Complex IV on the inner mitochondrial membrane?
qh: माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया की आंतरिक झिल्ली पर कॉम्प्लेक्स III और IV के बीच इलेक्ट्रॉनों का स्थानांतरण करने वाला मोबाइल वाहक कौन सा है?
e: Mitochondria ki antari jhilli (inner membrane) par electron parivahan shrankhla ke complex III tatha complex IV ke beech ek chhota gholeel (soluble) protein electron ka dhulai (shuttle) karta hai, jiska naam cytochrome c hota hai; yahi electron ko ek complex se doosre tak pahunchata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki cytochrome c jhilli ki bahari satah par halka-sa juda hota hai tatha pani mein ghulne wala iron-samooh rakhta hai, isliye electron ka bahav rukta nahi; iske bahar (release) hone par koshika 'apoptosis' (swabhavik mrityu) ke raaste par chali jaati hai. Iske ulat NADH tatha FADH2 electron dene wale (donor) hain, griheeta nahi, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: complex III tatha IV ke beech electron dhulai karne wala protein cytochrome c hota hai - yahi jhilli par electron ka chalan banaaye rakhta hai.

qe: What physiological condition causes acute Nitrogen Narcosis ('Rapture of the Deep') in deep-sea divers using standard compressed air?
qh: गहरे समुद्र में हवा से गोता लगाने पर 'नाइट्रोजन नार्कोसिस' होने का मुख्य कारण क्या है?
o: High ambient hydrostatic pressure forces lipid-soluble Nitrogen to dissolve in neuronal membranes, acting like an anesthetic
e: Nitrogen narcosis ('rapture of the deep') tab hoti hai jab diver gehre paani mein saadharan compressed hawa par saans leta hai - adhik dabav ke karan nitrogen adhik matara mein ghul kar snayu-koshikaon (neuronal membranes) mein chala jaata hai tatha nasha (anesthetic) jaisa asar deta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki nitrogen lipid (chiknaai) mein ghulne wala gas hai tatha adhik dabav par uski gholeelta badhti hai, isliye diver ko nashe jaisa anubhav, nirnay lene mein galti tatha bekhudi si hoti hai; isliye gehre diving mein oxygen ko helium se dilute karte hain. Iske ulat ye oxygen ki kami (hypoxia) ya CO2 badhne se nahi, balki nitrogen ke ghulne se hoti hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: gehre paani mein nitrogen adhik dabav par ghul kar snayu-koshikaon par nashe jaisa asar deta hai - isi ko nitrogen narcosis kehte hain.

qe: What is the calculated 'Oxygen Debt' that occurs following exhaustive anaerobic sprint exercise?
qh: तीव्र दौड़ या व्यायाम के बाद शरीर द्वारा ली जाने वाली अतिरिक्त भारी सांसें (Oxygen Debt) क्या पूरी करती हैं?
o: Extra volume of oxygen required post-exercise to metabolize accumulated lactic acid and replenish ATP/creatine phosphate reserves
e: Tez daud (sprint) jaisi kriyaon mein peShiyon ko oxygen ke bina urja banaani padti hai tatha lactic acid jama ho jaata hai; daud ke baad shareer us lactic acid ko metaboil karke urja (ATP tatha creatine phosphate) ke bhaar ko phir se bharne ke liye extra oxygen leta hai - isi extra oxygen ki matara ko 'oxygen debt' kehte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki vyayam ke turant baad saans tez bani rehti hai, taaki jama hui lactic acid tatha ATP ki kami poori ho sake; isi karan daud ke baad bhi thodi der tak kampi (huffing) si rehti hai. Iske ulat ye keval vyayam ke dauran upyog ki gayi oxygen nahi, balki baad mein lene wali extra oxygen hai. Exam point: oxygen debt wo extra oxygen hai jo tez vyayam ke baad lactic acid ko hatane tatha ATP ke bhaar ko phir se bharne ke liye chahiye hoti hai.

qe: What is the P50 index on the Oxygen-Hemoglobin Dissociation Curve?
qh: ऑक्सीजन-हीमोग्लोबिन वक्र पर P50 मान क्या दर्शाता है?
o: The partial pressure of oxygen at which 50% of hemoglobin saturation is achieved (approx 26.6 mmHg)
e: P50 oxygen-hemoglobin vaikaryan (dissociation) vakr (curve) par wo bindu hai jahan haemoglobin ka 50 pratishat hissa oxygen se bhara hota hai; iska maan vyask mein lagbhag 26.6 mmHg hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki P50 curve ki jagah batata hai - yadi P50 badh jaaye to haemoglobin oxygen aasaani se chhod deta hai (jaise vyayam, garmi ya adhik CO2 mein) tatha yadi ye ghat jaaye to oxygen chipka rehta hai (jaise thandi stithi mein); isliye ye phere ke oxygen lene-chhodne ka saaf maap hai. Iske ulat ye kisi bhi rakt-kapilar ka dabav nahi, balki curve ka khaas bindu hai. Exam point: P50 wo dabav hai jahan haemoglobin 50% oxygen se bhar jaata hai - iska maan lagbhag 26.6 mmHg hota hai, jo oxygen-chhodne ki kshamata batata hai.

qe: Difficulty breathing that worsens acutely in a supine flat position and is relieved by propping upright with pillows is diagnosed as:
qh: सीधे लेटने पर सांस लेने में भारी तकलीफ होना जो उठकर बैठने पर कम हो जाती है (Orthopnea), किस बीमारी का लक्षण है?
o: Orthopnea (frequently indicating Congestive Heart Failure / Pulmonary Edema)
e: Orthopnea wo sthiti hai jismein rogi ko letne (supine) par saans phoolne ki samasya badh jaati hai, par takiya laga kar ya baith kar shaant ho jaati hai; ye aam taur par dil ki kaam-chhodne wali bimari (congestive heart failure) ya phere mein paani jama hone (pulmonary edema) ka sanket hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki letne par phere mein khoon adhik aane se phere ki bheetar ka taral faitt jaata hai tatha saans lene ki jagah ghat jaati hai; baithne par ye taral niche chala jaata hai tatha takleef kam hoti hai. Iske ulat dyspnea tatha apnea ke aankde saadharan sthiti ke hain, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke sahi jod nahi. Exam point: letne par badhne wali tatha takiya laga kar kam hone wali saans ki takleef orthopnea kehlati hai - ye heart failure ka aam sanket hai.

qe: The deep, rapid, unremitting hyperventilatory breathing pattern observed in patients compensating for metabolic Diabetic Ketoacidosis is:
qh: मधुमेह के रोगियों में एसिडोसिस को संतुलित करने के लिए होने वाली गहरी और तेज हांफने जैसी सांस क्या कहलाती है?
e: Kussmaul shvasan ek gahri, tez tatha lagataar chalti rehne wali shvasan ki reeti hai, jo mukhya roop se mangh (diabetic ketoacidosis) jaisi sthiti mein dikhti hai - jahan khoon mein acid (ketone aayan) bahut badh jaate hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki sharer us extra acid ko hataane ke liye CO2 ko tezi se bahar nikaalna chahta hai, isliye saans gahri tatha tez ho jaati hai; yahi is acido-sis ka pehla pehchaan wala lakshan hota hai. Iske ulat Cheyne-Stokes (badhti-ghatati shvasan) tatha orthopnea (letne par badhna) alag reetiyan hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: mangh ke ketoacidosis mein dikhne wali gahri tatha tez shvasan Kussmaul shvasan kehlati hai - ye sharer ka acid hataane ka upay hota hai.

qe: Which specific biochemical enzyme converts glucose into Ethyl Alcohol and CO2 during anaerobic yeast fermentation?
qh: किण्वन के दौरान यीस्ट में ग्लूकोज को एथिल अल्कोहल में बदलने वाला एंजाइम कॉम्प्लेक्स कौन सा है?
e: Yist (yeast) ke bheetar anaerobic stithi mein glucose ko ethanol tatha CO2 mein badalne wali kriya zymase enzyme ki sahayata se chalti hai; yahi enzyme yisht mein paaya jaata hai tatha yisht-ki-sharabi kriya (fermentation) ka mukhya kaaran banata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki karyogamic (fermentation) ke dauran pehle glucose tootta hai tatha phir zymase ke asar se ethanol tatha CO2 banti hai, isliye sharab tatha beer banaane mein yahi enzyme kaam aata hai; iske ulat manushya ki koshikaon mein lactic acid banta hai, ethanol nahi. Iske ulat invertase tatha anya enzyme pehle ke padav karate hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: yisht ke anaerobic fermentation mein glucose ko ethanol tatha CO2 mein badalne wala enzyme zymase hota hai - isi karan sharab banane mein yisht ka istemal hota hai.

qe: The conversion of an aromatic amine into an unstable aromatic diazonium salt at 0-5°C using NaNO2 and HCl is:
qh: एनिलीन को 0-5°C पर बेंजीन डायज़ोनियम क्लोराइड में बदलने की अभिक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
e: Kisi sugandh-padarth ke amine (aro-ma-tik amine) ko 0-5 degree C par NaNO2 tatha HCl ke saath kriya karaai jaaye to amine se ek asthir (unstable) diazonium salt (benzene diazonium chloride) banta hai - isi kriya ko diazotization kehte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki amine ke -NH2 samooh par nitrous acid (jo NaNO2 tatha HCl se banta hai) hamla karta hai tatha wahan -N2+ samooh lag jaata hai; thanda (0-5 degree C) rakhna zaroori hai, warna ye salt turant toot jaata hai. Isi diazonium salt se aage rang, dawa tatha Sandmeyer jaisi kriyaon se naye padarth banaaye jaate hain. Exam point: amine ko 0-5 degree C par NaNO2 tatha HCl ke saath diazonium salt mein badalne wali kriya diazotization kehlati hai - ise thanda rakhna zaroori hota hai.

qe: What synthetic azo dye coupling compound is used as a red histological stain and direct dye for cotton fabrics?
qh: सूती कपड़ों को सीधे रंगने के लिए प्रयुक्त होने वाला पहला सिंथेटिक एज़ो रंजक कौन सा है?
e: Congo red ek azo rang hai jo benzene diazonium salt tatha naphthionic acid ke jodne se banta hai; iska rang kapas tatha anya resh (fibre) par laal hota hai tatha jivan-vigyan (histology) mein ootak ke namuno ko rangne ke liye yahi istemal hota hai. Iska ek khaas gun yahi hai ki ye amyloid (ek vishesh protein) se jud kar chamakdar (birefringence) asar deta hai, isliye ise amyloidosis jaisi bimari ki janch mein bhi kam lete hain. Iske ulat ye ek azo dye hai, koi dawa ya gas nahi, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Congo red ek azo rang (dye) hai jo kapas rangne tatha ootak-jaanch (histological staining) mein istemal hota hai - yahi iska mukhya kaam hai.

qe: Which volatile aromatic compound is chemically utilized in forensic crime scenes because it chemiluminesces blue upon contact with blood?
qh: अपराध स्थल पर खून के सूक्ष्म निशानों की पहचान करने के लिए किस रसायन का उपयोग किया जाता है जो नीला चमकता है?
e: Luminol ek sugandh-vaahak (aromatic) padarth hai jise forensik vigyani apradh-sthal par istemal karte hain; khoon ke sampark mein aane par ye ek rasayanik kriya dwara neeli-bainguni roshni chhodta hai (chemiluminescence). Iska karan yahi hai ki khoon ki haem (iron) us kriya ke liye utprek (catalyst) ka kaam karti hai tatha hawa ki oxygen ki majoodgi mein urja nikalati hai - isliye saaf ki gayi khoon ki nishani bhi isse pakdi jaati hai, kyunki haem hatta nahi jaata. Iske ulat ye ek nishaan (marker) hai, dawa ya visphotak nahi, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: luminol ek aisa padarth hai jo khoon ke sampark mein aakar neeli roshni chhodta hai - isi karan forensik jaanch mein iska istemal hota hai.

qe: What is the chemical name and active analgesic compound formulated in commercial Paracetamol (Crocin / Tylenol)?
qh: पैरासिटामोल का रासायनिक नाम क्या है जो एक सुरक्षित ज्वरनाशक (Antipyretic) और दर्द निवारक है?
e: Paracetamol (Crocin ya Tylenol) mein mukhya kriya-sheel padarth 4-acetamidophenol (jise N-acetyl-para-aminophenol ya APAP bhi kehte hain) hota hai; ismein phenol chakra par ek acetamido samooh laga hota hai. Yahi badh (fever) utaarne (antipyretic) tatha dard kam karne (analgesic) ka kaam karta hai tatha isi liye ye sabse zyada bechi jaane wali aushadhi hai; iska asar mukhya roop se mastishk ke tapman tatha dard-sanket par hota hai. Iske ulat aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid) alag samooh wala padarth hai, isliye wo jod is prashn ka sahi jod nahi. Exam point: paracetamol mein mukhya padarth 4-acetamidophenol (APAP) hota hai, jo badh utaarne tatha dard kam karne ki dawa hai.

qe: Which halogenated compound is used in clinical setups as an antiseptic for dressing minor wounds, producing a characteristic odor?
qh: घावों पर रोगाणुरोधी के रूप में प्रयुक्त होने वाला पीले रंग का 'आयोडोफॉर्म' ($CHI_3$) किस कारण असरदार होता है?
e: Iodoform (CHI3) ek peela, tez gandh wala padarth hai jise jild ki chhoti chot (wounds) par jivanu-nashak (antiseptic) ke roop mein lagate hain; hawa tatha suraj ki roshni ke sampark mein ye dheere-dheere toot kar free iodine chhodta hai. Yahi free iodine jivanuon ke protein ko nasht karta hai tatha ghav ko saaf (disinfected) rakhta hai; isi tez gandh se purane zamaane mein hospital ki pehchaan bani thi. Iske ulat ye jale hue (burns) ya andar liye jaane wali dawa nahi, keval bahari antiseptic ke roop mein istemal hota hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: iodoform ek halke peela rang wala antiseptic hai jo phati (free) iodine chhod kar jivanuon ko maarta hai tatha iski tez gandh se pehchaan hoti hai.

qe: Which high-potency artificial non-caloric sweetener is approximately 2000 times sweeter than sucrose?
qh: चीनी की तुलना में लगभग 2000 गुना अधिक मीठा कृत्रिम स्वीटनर कौन सा है जिसकी मिठास नियंत्रित करना कठिन होता है?
e: Alitame ek atyant prabal (lagbhag 2000 guna mithas wala) kalpana-tmak (artificial) mithas-padarth hai jo sukroze (sugar) se kai sau guna meetha hota hai; ise bahut chhota aankda (milligram se bhi kam) istemal karta hai, isliye sharir mein calorie lagbhag nahi badhti. Iska karan yahi hai ki wo ascorbic acid (vitamin C) jaisa padarth tatha ek amino acid se banta hai, isliye ushe pachne (digest) hone ki zaroorat itni nahi padti; isi karan ye diet-drinks tatha mithaiyon mein kam calorie wala mithas deta hai. Iske ulat aspartame (lagbhag 200 guna) tatha saccharin alag aankde wale mithas-padarth hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: sukroze se lagbhag 2000 guna meetha hone wala non-caloric artificial sweetener alitame hota hai - isi karan bahut chhoti matara hi kaafi hoti hai.

qe: What is 'Equanil' prescribed as in clinical pharmacology?
qh: चिकित्सा में 'इक्वानिल' (Equanil) का उपयोग किस रूप में किया जाता है?
o: Tranquilizer (used for controlling anxiety, tension, and mild depression)
e: Equanil ek shaman (tranquilizer) dawa hai, jise chinta (anxiety), mansik tanav tatha halke avsaad (mild depression) ko kam karne ke liye diya jaata hai; yahi mastishk par asar karke man ko shaant rakhti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye mastishk ke kendraiya tantra (central nervous system) ko dheela kar deti hai, isliye chinta wale rogi ko thodi shanti milti hai tatha neend behtar hoti hai - par iske priya prabhav (side effects) hone ke karan ise doctor ki dekh-rekh mein hi liya jaata hai. Iske ulat antibiotic, dard-nashak ya bukhar utaarne wali dawa ke roop is prashn ke sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: Equanil ek shaman (tranquilizer) dawa hai, jo chinta tatha mansik tanav ko kam karne ke liye di jaati hai.

qe: Which food preservative prevents microbial spoilage in fruit jams, squashes, and carbonated beverages by releasing sulfur dioxide?
qh: फलों के रस और जैम को खराब होने से बचाने के लिए किस रासायनिक परिरक्षक का उपयोग किया जाता है जो $SO_2$ मुक्त करता है?
e: Sodium metabisulphite (Na2S2O5) ek khadiya-rok (preservative) hai jo phal-murabbe, sharbat (squash) tatha carbonated drinks mein jivanuon tatha fungus ko badhne nahi deta; ise pani mein ghulne par sulfur dioxide (SO2) gas chhodta hai, jo jivanuon ko maar deti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki SO2 ek prabal antimaaikrobik (antimicrobial) tatha anti-oxidant hai, isliye ye pine-yogya padarthon ko kai mahine tak saadhaaran (fresh) rakhta hai - isi karan rasayano ki list (label) par iska naam aata hai. Iske ulat common salt tatha sugar alag tareeke se rok (preservation) karte hain, isliye wo is prashn ke sahi jod nahi. Exam point: phal ke murabbe tatha sharbat ko kharab hone se bachaane ke liye sodium metabisulphite istemal hota hai, kyunki ye sulfur dioxide chhod kar jivanuon ko rokta hai.

qe: What synthetic estrogen derivative is formulated in oral contraceptive birth control pills ('Antifertility Drugs')?
qh: जन्म नियंत्रण की गोलियों (Oral Contraceptive Pills) में मुख्य रूप से कौन सा सिंथेटिक एस्ट्रोजन घटक होता है?
e: Antifertility (garbh-nirodhak) goliyon (oral contraceptive pills) mein novestrol (ethinylestradiol) jaisa sanshleshit (synthetic) estrogen ka roop hota hai; yahi pituitary ke harmone ko rok kar ankdan (ovulation) ruka deta hai, isliye garbh dhaaran nahi hota. Iska karan yahi hai ki sharer ko lagta hai ki usmein pehle se harmaun maujood hain, isliye ovary ande (ovum) banane ka sanket nahi paati - yahi goliyon ka mool siddhant hai, tatha inhe doctor ki salah se lena zaroori hai. Iske ulat antibiotic tatha dard-nashak dawa is kaam ke liye nahi hoti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: garbh-nirodhak goliyon mein novestrol (ethinylestradiol) jaisa sanshleshit estrogen hota hai - yahi ankdan rok kar garbh dhaaran nahi hone deta.

qe: Which active chemical compound formulated in Dettol provides its primary broad-spectrum antiseptic efficacy?
qh: घरेलू एंटीसेप्टिक 'डेटॉल' (Dettol) में मुख्य रोगाणुरोधी घटक कौन सा होता है?
e: Dettol ek jivanu-nashak (antiseptic) hai jiska mukhya kriya-sheel padarth chloroxylenol hota hai, jise terpineol tatha anya tel (oil) ke saath mila kar ghol banaya jaata hai - isi mishran se uski pehchaan wali gandh aati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki chloroxylenol jivanuon ki koshika-jhilli ko tod deta hai, isliye chhote ghav tatha jild ki safai mein ye prabhavi hai; iske ghol ko paani mein milakar safai tatha katre (cuts) ke liye lete hain. Iodine tatha hydrogen peroxide anya antiseptic hote hain, jo iske vikalp hain. Exam point: Dettol mein mukhya kriya-sheel antiseptic chloroxylenol hota hai - iske saath terpineol milkar uski khaas gandh banata hai.

qe: Why are linear alkylbenzene sulfonate detergents preferred over heavily branched alkylbenzene sulfonates in environmental engineering?
qh: सीधी श्रृंखला वाले एल्किल बेंजीन सल्फोनेट डिटर्जेंट पर्यावरण के लिए बेहतर क्यों माने जाते हैं?
o: They are readily Biodegradable by aquatic wastewater sewage bacteria
e: Linear alkylbenzene sulfonate (LABS) wale detergent (sabunkaari padarth) shunt (straight) shrankhla wale hote hain, isliye paani tatha mitti ke jivanu (bacteria) unhe aasaani se tod (biodegrade) lete hain - isi karan inke istemal ke baad nadiyon mein jhaag tatha pradushan kam rehta hai. Iske ulat purane shakha-daar (branched) detergent ke shrankhla mazboot tatha jaTil hote hain, isliye jivanu unhe tod nahi paate tatha wo jhaag bankar nadiyon mein lambe samay tak baithe rehte hain (jisse jal-pradushan hota hai). Isi karan aaj sanshodhan (law) ke zariye branched detergent par rok hai tatha LABS ka istemal hota hai. Exam point: shunt-shrankhla (linear) wale detergent jivanuon dwara aasaani se biodegrade ho jaate hain, isliye paryavaran ke liye behtar maane jaate hain.

qe: Which aromatic compound was historically formulated as the pioneer antimicrobial treatment for syphilis by Paul Ehrlich?
qh: पॉल एर्लिच द्वारा सिफलिस के उपचार के लिए खोजी गई पहली आर्सेनिक-आधारित दवा कौन सी थी?
e: Salvarsan (arsphenamine) ko Paul Ehrlich ne syphilis (ek yon-roga) ke ilaaj ke liye banaaya tha tatha yahi pehla aisa rasayanik padarth maana jaata hai jise jaan-boojh kar vishesh rog ke liye siphaarish (magic bullet) kiya gaya - isi karan ise rasayan-chikitsa (chemotherapy) ki shuruaat maana jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ismein arsenic hota hai jo syphilis ke jivanu (Treponema pallidum) ko maarta hai par rogi ko kam nuksan karta hai; isi se aage penicillin jaisi behtar dawaon ka raasta khula. Iske ulat aspirin, paracetamol tatha chloroxylenol alag samasyaon ke liye hain, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke sahi jod nahi. Exam point: syphilis ke ilaaj ka pehla sanshleshit rasayan (pioneer antimicrobial) Salvarsan tha, jo Paul Ehrlich ne arsenic ke aadhaar par banaya.

qe: Why is the synthetic dipeptide artificial sweetener 'Aspartame' strictly restricted to cold desserts and chilled carbonated sodas?
qh: कृत्रिम स्वीटनर 'एस्पार्टेम' का उपयोग गर्म बेकिंग खाद्य पदार्थों में क्यों नहीं किया जाता?
o: It tastes bitter in hot tea
It is thermolabile and decomposes at cooking/baking temperatures, losing its sweetness
e: Aspartame ek protein-jaisa (dipeptide) kalpana-tmak (artificial) sweetener hai jo do amino acid milkar banta hai; uchch tapman par uske bandhan toot jaate hain tatha wo mithas asar kho deta hai - isliye ise pakaane tatha baking ke liye nahi, keval thandi mithaiyan tatha chiled carbonated drinks ke liye istemal karte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki 100 degree C tatha usse adhik tapman par uske peptide bandhan tootte hain tatha wo teeta (bitter) ho jaata hai; isliye diet-drinks mein iska istemal sahi hai, par koki tatha seka hua khana banana galat hoga. Iske ulat saccharin tatha sucralose tapman-sahishnu (heat stable) hote hain, isliye wo yahan sahi vikalp nahi. Exam point: aspartame uchch tapman par toot jaata hai tatha mithas kho deta hai - isi karan wo keval thandi drinks tatha meethaiyon ke liye upyukt hai.

qe: Which mild, non-irritating mineral acid is safely used in ophthalmic solutions as an eyewash antiseptic?
qh: आँखों को धोने और आई-ड्रॉप्स में रोगाणुरोधी के रूप में किस हल्के अम्ल का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Ophthalmic (aankh) ke gholon tatha safai ke liye bahut halka tatha jild ko chubhta nahi hone wala aml boric acid (H3BO3) hota hai; iska halka ghol (lagbhag 2-4 pratishat) aankh dhoone tatha halke jivanu-nashak (antiseptic) ke roop mein lagta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye kamzor aml hai, isliye ankh ki narm jhilli ko jalata nahi tatha us par koi tez asar nahi karta, tabhi ye kajal tatha eye-drop mein mila jaata hai. Iske ulat HCl, HNO3 tatha H2SO4 prabal aml hain jo aankh ko turant nasht kar denge, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: aankh dhoone ke liye boric acid (H3BO3) ka halka ghol istemal hota hai, kyunki ye kamzor aml hone se aankh ki narm jhilli ko chubhta nahi.

qe: Why are amino acids characterized as forming dipolar 'Zwitterions' in aqueous solution?
qh: अमीनो एसिड जलीय घोल में 'ज़्विटर आयन' (Zwitterion) क्यों बनाते हैं?
o: The internal proton transfer from the -COOH group to the basic -NH2 group produces simultaneous positive and negative charges
e: Amino acid ke ek hi anu mein amli (acidic) -COOH samooh tatha ksheerajaliy (basic) -NH2 samooh dono hote hain; ghol (aqueous) mein -COOH apna proton -NH2 ko de deta hai, jisse ek hi anu mein dhan (+NH3) tatha rin (COO-) aavesh dono aa jaate hain - isi roop ko zwitterion kehte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki aise anu mein apna hi dhan tatha rin aavesh santulit rehta hai, isliye wo bijli ke kshetra mein kheenchta nahi hai tatha paani mein aasaani se ghulta hai; isi karan amino acid ka pH ek vishesh bindu (isoelectric point) par hota hai. Iske ulat ye keval do alag anuon ka judna nahi, balki ek hi anu ke andar proton ka sthanantaran hai. Exam point: amino acid ghol mein zwitterion banta hai, kyunki -COOH ka proton -NH2 par jaakar ek hi anu mein dhan tatha rin aavesh bana deta hai.

qe: Which protein structural building block is the ONLY naturally occurring amino acid that is optically INACTIVE (achiral)?
qh: सभी 20 मानक अमीनो अम्लों में से कौन सा एकमात्र ऐसा अमीनो अम्ल है जो प्रकाशिक रूप से निष्क्रिय (Achiral) होता है?
e: Glycine (H2N-CH2-COOH) ekmatr aisa svabhavik amino acid hai jiske alpha carbon par do hydrogen hote hain (par koi alag samooh nahi), isliye us anu ka aayna (mirror) pratibimb usi ke saath poori tarah mel jaata hai - yahi karan hai ki wo prakash-rasayanik (optically) inactive tatha achiral hota hai. Iska mahatva yahi hai ki baaki sabhi 19 svabhavik amino acid chiral hote hain tatha wo ek hi chakrakar (configuration) wale roop mein jeevon mein maujood rehte hain (L-roop), isliye protein ki sajaavat ek hi tarike se banti hai. Iske ulat alanine tatha valine mein alag samooh hone ke karan wo chiral tatha keval roshni ghumate hain. Exam point: glycine ek hi aisa svabhavik amino acid hai jo optically inactive (achiral) hai - uske alpha carbon par do hydrogen hone ke karan aayna pratibimb same hota hai.

qe: Which biochemical color reaction utilizes alkaline Copper Sulfate ($CuSO_4$) to confirm the presence of peptide bonds in proteins?
qh: प्रोटीन में पेप्टाइड बंधों की उपस्थिति की पहचान करने के लिए क्षारीय कॉपर सल्फेट के साथ बैंगनी रंग देने वाला परीक्षण कौन सा है?
e: Biuret pariksha mein protein ke ghol mein ksheerajaliya copper sulfate (CuSO4) milaya jaata hai; ismein peptide bond ke nitrogen tatha copper ke aaynon ke jud kar ek rang wala samooh (complex) banta hai tatha ghol bainguni (violet) ho jaata hai - isi se peptide bond ki pushti hoti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki do ya adhik peptide bond ek saath copper ko pakadne ke liye jagah banate hain, isliye ek amino acid (dipeptide) mein ye pariksha kam rang deti hai tatha protein mein saaf bainguni rang aata hai; isliye ise protein ki janch ke liye istemal karte hain. Iske ulat iodine pariksha starch ke liye tatha Fehling pariksha reducing sugar ke liye hoti hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: protein mein peptide bond ki pushti ke liye biuret pariksha ka istemal hota hai - ismein alkaline CuSO4 se bainguni rang banta hai.

qe: Why is sucrose categorized chemically as a 'Non-Reducing Sugar' unlike maltose or lactose?
qh: सुक्रोज (टेबल शुगर) को 'अनपचायक शर्करा' (Non-reducing Sugar) क्यों माना जाता है?
o: The reducing anomeric hemiacetal groups of both glucose (C1) and fructose (C2) are locked in the glycosidic bond
e: Sukroze (sucrose) do aayan - glucose tatha fructose ka mishran hota hai; in dono ke reducing samooh (glucose ka C1 tatha fructose ka C2) ek saath milkar glycosidic bandhan (linkage) mein bandh jaate hain, isliye unmein se koi bhi aayan free nahi bachta tatha wo doosre padarth ko rudhaan (reduce) nahi kar paate - isi karan sukroze 'non-reducing sugar' kehlata hai. Iske ulat maltose tatha lactose mein ek reducing (hemiacetal) samooh khula reh jaata hai, isliye wo Tollens ya Fehling abhikarmak se rudhaan karke rang dete hain; isi karan mithaiyon mein sukroze ka upyog zyada hota hai (aisa rang nahi badalta). Exam point: sukroze non-reducing sugar hai, kyunki uske glucose (C1) tatha fructose (C2) dono ke reducing samooh glycosidic bandhan mein bandh jaate hain.

qe: What is the primary chemical difference between the structure of starch (amylose/amylopectin) and structural cellulose?
qh: पाचन योग्य स्टार्च और अपाच्य सेलूलोज़ के बीच मुख्य रासायनिक संरचनात्मक अंतर क्या है?
o: Starch consists of alpha-D-glucose units, whereas Cellulose is composed of beta-D-glucose units joined by beta-1,4-glycosidic linkages
e: Starch tatha cellulose dono glucose ke bahulak (polymer) hain, par starch alpha-D-glucose ki ikaiyon se banta hai, jabki cellulose beta-D-glucose ki ikaiyon se banta hai; isi karan unke bandhan ka roop (alpha-1,4 tatha beta-1,4) alag hota hai tatha unke gun bhinn hote hain. Iska bada parinaam yahi hai ki manushya ke pachan-tantra ka enzyme (amylase) alpha-bandhan ko tod sakta hai, par beta-bandhan ko nahi - isliye manushya starch ko pacha sakta hai par cellulose ko nahi (go-jantu pachate hain kyunki unmein vishesh jivanu hote hain). Iske ulat dono mein keval shakh hai ya keval anu-bhaar ka antar wala jod sahi nahi, kyunki mool antar alpha tatha beta glucose ka hai. Exam point: starch alpha-D-glucose se tatha cellulose beta-D-glucose se banta hai - isi karan manushya starch ko pacha sakta hai par cellulose ko nahi.

qe: What specific biochemical event causes the permanent loss of biological activity during the thermal 'Denaturation' of proteins?
qh: प्रोटीन के तापीय विकृतीकरण (Denaturation) के दौरान उसकी जैविक सक्रियता क्यों समाप्त हो जाती है?
o: Disruption of secondary, tertiary, and quaternary hydrogen bonding and folding, causing the globular chain to uncoil into an inactive random tangle
Complete cleavage of all primary covalent peptide bonds
e: Protein ka uttapan (denaturation) tab hota hai jab uchch tapman, aml/kshar ya anya rasayan uske dvitiyak, tritiyak tatha chaturth-star (secondary, tertiary, quaternary) hydrogen bandhan tatha mudna (folding) ko tod dete hain; isse protein ki golij sajaavat khul kar bekaar (random) dhaage mein badal jaati hai tatha uski jaivik kriya khatm ho jaati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki protein ka kaam uski sajaavat par nirbhar karta hai, isliye sajaavat tootne par wo kaam nahi kar paata; jaise anda ubaalne par safed ho jaana, doodh ka phatna tatha bukhar mein jivanuon ka protein tootna - par mukhya (primary) aml-shrankhla tootti nahi. Iske ulat peptic bond ka tootna hydrolysis kehlata hai, denaturation nahi, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: protein ka thermal denaturation uski secondary, tertiary tatha quaternary sajaavat (folding) tod deta hai, jisse uski jaivik kriya khatm ho jaati hai.

qe: Which drug was the first effective 'Antibiotic' discovered by Alexander Fleming?
qh: अलेक्जेंडर फ्लेमिंग द्वारा खोजी गई पहली प्रभावी 'एंटीबायोटिक' दवा कौन सी थी?
e: Penicillin ko Alexander Fleming ne 1928 mein khoja tha tatha yahi pehli asli antibiotics maani jaati hai, kyunki ye ek fungus (Penicillium) se mili thi tatha jivanuon (bacteria) ki deewar tootte hue unhe maarti thi. Iska karan yahi hai ki usmein beta-lactam chakra hota hai, jo jivanuon ki koshika-deewar banne se rok deta hai; iske saath hi ye manushya ki koshikaon ko bahut kam nuksan karta hai, isliye ise injection ke zariye kai bimariyon mein diya jaata hai. Aspirin tatha paracetamol dard ke liye di jaati hain tatha jivanuon ko nahi maarti, isliye wo is prashn ke uttar nahi honge. Exam point: Alexander Fleming dwara khoji gayi duniya ki pehli asli antibiotic penicillin hai - yahi jivanuon ki koshika-deewar todti hai.

qe: What is 'Bithional' added to soaps for?
qh: साबुनों में 'बिथायोनॉल' (Bithional) किस उद्देश्य से मिलाया जाता है?
e: Bithional ek jivanu-nashak (antiseptic) padarth hai jise sabun mein milaya jaata hai, taaki nahaane ke saath hi jild par jivanuon tatha gandh (smell) paida karne wale jeevon ka nash ho jaaye. Iska karan yahi hai ki bithional tez jivanu-nashak tatha ek vishesh deodorizing asar deta hai, isliye aisi sabun ko 'medicated soap' kehte hain tatha yahi carbolic soap tatha laundry soapse alag hoti hai. Iske ulat ise rang dene tatha jhaag badhane ke liye nahi milate, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: sabun mein bithional jivanu-nashak gun (antiseptic) dene ke liye milaya jaata hai, isliye wo jild ki safai tatha gandh-roki ke liye upyukt hoti hai.

qe: Which type of 'Detergent' is used in hair conditioners and has germicidal properties?
qh: हेयर कंडीशनर में किस प्रकार के डिटर्जेंट का उपयोग किया जाता है जिसमें रोगाणुरोधी गुण होते हैं?
e: Cationic detergent wo sabunkaari padarth hote hain jinmein dhan aavesh (+ve) wala hissa (jivanu-nashak) hota hai tatha ye paani mein dhan aayan ke roop mein chalta hai; isi karan ye resh (fibre) par chipak jaate hain tatha santulit (conditioning) ka asar dete hain, isliye hair conditioner tatha anti-static padarthon mein istemal hote hain. Iska ek bada gun yahi hai ki ye jivanuon ko maar dete hain (germicidal) tatha bijli ke aavesh ko rok kar baal tatha kapde chipakne nahi dete; iske ulat anionic (jaise sodium lauryl sulfate) tatha non-ionic detergents zyada jhaag banate hain par conditioning asar kam dete hain. Exam point: hair conditioner tatha jivanu-nashak (germicidal) gun wale detergent cationic hote hain, kyunki unmein dhan aavesh wala hissa hota hai jo resh par chipak jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Aspirin' chemically?
qh: रासायनिक रूप से 'एस्पिरिन' (Aspirin) क्या है?
e: Aspirin ko 'Bayer's aspirin' ke naam se becha jaata hai tatha yahi duniya ki sabse charchit dawa hai; iska rasayanik roop acetylsalicylic acid hai tatha iske teen mukhya kaam hain - dard kam karna (analgesic), bukhar utaarna (antipyretic) tatha khoon ke bahte (clotting) ko rokna (antiplatelet asar). Iska karan yahi hai ki ye sharer mein prostaglandin banne se rokti hai, jo dard tatha sokh (swelling) ke liye zimmedar hota hai; isi antiplatelet gun ke karan heart attack ke rogion ko iski chhoti khurak roz di jaati hai. Iske ulat paracetamol antiplatelet asar nahi deti tatha penicillin antibiotic hai, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke sahi jod nahi. Exam point: aspirin ka rasayanik roop acetylsalicylic acid hai tatha wo dard-nashak, bukhar-nashak tatha antiplatelet teeno asar deti hai.

qe: Which class of drugs is used for the treatment of 'Stress' and mild or severe mental diseases?
qh: तनाव और मानसिक विकारों के इलाज के लिए दवाओं के किस वर्ग का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Tranquilizer aisi aushadhiyan hain jo mastishk par dheela karne wala asar daal kar chinta (tension), mansik bechaini tatha halke-se-bhaari avsaad (severe mental disease mein bhi) ke lakshan kam karti hain; jaise valium tatha equanil. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye mastishk ke rasayanik sandeshwahi (neurotransmitter) ke asar ko ghata deti hain, isliye rogi ko thodi shanti milti hai, neend behtar hoti hai tatha mansik tanav kam hota hai - par iski aadat (addiction) ho sakti hai, isliye ye doctor ki nigrani mein li jaati hai. Antibiotic jivanuon ko maarti hai tatha dard-nashak dawa dard kam karti hai; in dono ka kaam chinta ko shaant karna nahi hai. Exam point: tranqilizer dawa se chinta tatha mansik rog ke tanav mein aaram milta hai - yahi mastishk ko shaant karne wali dawa hai.

qe: What is 'Tincture of Iodine' used as?
qh: 'टिंचर आयोडीन' का उपयोग किस रूप में किया जाता है?
e: Iodine ka ethanol tatha paani wala patla ghol 'tincture of iodine' kehlata hai tatha ise jild ki choti chot, ghay tatha operation se pehle jivanu-mukt (antiseptic) karne ke liye lagaya jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki iodine jivanuon ke jaivik padarthon (protein) ko turant nasht karke unhe maar deta hai tatha ghav jaldi bharne mein madad karta hai; ethanol jald sookh jaata hai, isliye ghol tezi se asar karta hai. Ye andar lene wali dawa nahi hai tatha iska istemal keval bahari jivanu-nashak ke roop mein hota hai; isliye anya jod yahan galat honge. Exam point: tincture of iodine ka istemal bahari jivanu-nashak (antiseptic) ke roop mein hota hai - ise ghay tatha cut par lagaya jaata hai.

qe: Which 'Artificial Sweetener' is stable at cooking temperature and looks like sugar?
qh: कौन सा 'कृत्रिम स्वीटनर' पकाने के तापमान पर स्थिर रहता है और चीनी जैसा दिखता है?
e: Sucralose bhi ek artificial mithas-padarth hai, jise cheeni ke anuon se banaya jaata hai tatha jismein teen hydroxyl samoohon ki jagah chlorine lagta hai; isse wo bahut sthir ho jaata hai tatha pakaane (cooking) tatha baking ke tapman par bhi mithaas nahi khoti. Isi karan ye sugar jaisa safed dikhta hai tatha chai, mithai tatha baked saman mein bhi istemal ho sakta hai, jabki aspartame uchch tapman par kaam nahi karta; iske ulat ye shaareer mein pachta bhi nahi tatha calorie nahi deta. Exam point: sucralose pakaane ke tapman par bhi sthir rehta hai tatha dikhta sugar (sukroze) jaisa hai - isi karan ye baking wali mithaiyon mein istemal hota hai.

qe: What is 'Prontosil'?
qh: 'प्रोंटोसिल' (Prontosil) क्या है?
o: The first effective antibacterial sulfur drug
e: Prontosil wahi padarth tha jise 1930 ke dashak mein Gerhard Domagk ne khoja tatha yahi pehla asardar (effective) anti-bacterial sulfur wala drug maana jaata hai; ise mushkil bimariyon (jaise puerperal fever) mein istemal karte the tatha iske liye unhe Nobel puraskar mila. Iska karan yahi hai ki prontosil sharer ke andar tootkar sulfanilamide banata hai, jo jivanuon ki folic acid banane ki kriya ko rok deta hai, isliye jivanu badh nahi paate; yahi se sulfa-drugs ki poora parivar shuru hui. Penicillin fungus se mili antibiotic hai tatha aspirin dard-nashak; dono yahan galat saabit hote hain. Exam point: pehla asardar sulfur wala antibacterial drug prontosil tha - yahi sharer mein tootkar sulfanilamide banata hai tatha jivanuon ko rok deta hai.

qe: Which chemical is used as an 'Antiseptic' in the form of a 0.2% solution but as a 'Disinfectant' at 1%?
qh: किस रसायन का 0.2% घोल एंटीसेप्टिक और 1% घोल कीटाणुनाशक (Disinfectant) के रूप में कार्य करता है?
e: Phenol ko 'carbolic acid' bhi kehte hain tatha uski matara ke hisaab se uska istemal badal jaata hai - 0.2 pratishat ghol halke jivanu-nashak (antiseptic) ke roop mein jild par lagta hai, jabki 1 pratishat ya adhik ghol prabal jivanu-nashak (disinfectant) ke roop mein farsh, bartan tatha sandas (toilet) saaf karne ke liye istemal hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki adhik matara par phenol jivanuon ki koshika-jhilli tatha protein ko todta hai, isliye wo jeevon tatha anya ashudhiyon ko nasht kar deta hai; par adhik matara tatha lambe sampark se jild bhi jal sakti hai, isliye savdhani rakhni padti hai. Iske ulat iodine tatha bithional ke aankde alag hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: phenol ka 0.2% ghol antiseptic tatha 1% ghol disinfectant ke roop mein istemal hota hai - yahi matara ka antar hai.

qe: What are 'Antacids' used to treat?
qh: 'एंटासिड' (Antacids) का उपयोग किस स्थिति के उपचार के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Antacid wo aushadhiyan hoti hain jo pet (stomach) mein banta adhik aml (HCl) tatha uske karan hone wali jalan (acidity) ko kam karti hain; ye aam taur par kshaar (base) jaisi hoti hain jaise magnesium hydroxide, aluminium hydroxide ya sodium bicarbonate, jo aml se kriya karke ushe neutral kar deti hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki aisi dawa se aml ka matara kam hota hai tatha pet ki antari parat (mucosa) par jalan kam hoti hai, isliye rogi ko aaram milta hai; par adhik istemal se ulti tatha anya samasya ho sakti hai. Iske ulat antibiotic jivanuon ke liye tatha analgesic dard ke liye hoti hai, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: antacid dawaon ka istemal pet mein adhik aml (acidity) tatha jalan ko kam karne ke liye hota hai - yahi aml ko shaant karne wali dawa hai.

qe: Which 'Sweetener' is about 600 times as sweet as cane sugar but provides zero calories?
qh: कौन सा स्वीटनर गन्ने की चीनी से लगभग 600 गुना मीठा है और शून्य कैलोरी प्रदान करता है?
e: Sucralose ek calorie-rahit kalpana-tmak mithas-padarth hai jise pakaane par bhi uski mithaas bani rehti hai tatha jo sukroze se lagbhag 600 guna adhik meetha hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki uske anu mein chlorine hone se wo shaareer mein pachne se bach jaata hai, isliye uski urja (calorie) lagbhag shunya ke barabar hoti hai; isi gun se madhumeh (diabetes) tatha wazan ghataane wale aahar mein iska istemal hota hai. Aspartame tatha sorbitol ke meethapan ke aankde isse alag hote hain, isliye wo aankde yahan lagu nahi hote. Exam point: sukroze sukroze se lagbhag 600 guna meetha hone ke saath lagbhag zero calorie deta hai - isi liye ye diabetic aahar tatha diet-drinks mein istemal hota hai.

qe: What is 'Dettol' a mixture of?
qh: 'डेटॉल' (Dettol) मुख्य रूप से किन दो रसायनों का मिश्रण है?
e: Dettol jaisa jivanu-nashak mukhya roop se chloroxylenol tatha terpineol ka mishran hota hai, jise saabun tatha tel jaisa padarth milakar ghol banaya jaata hai; chloroxylenol jivanuon ko maarta hai tatha terpineol ushe paani mein ghulne tatha saaf karne mein madad karta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki chloroxylenol chiknaai mein ghulne wala (lipid-soluble) padarth hai, isliye jivanuon ki koshika-jhilli mein ghus kar ushe todta hai; isi gun se ye tatha paani ka ghol ghav dhoone tatha safai ke liye istemal hota hai. Iske ulat phenol tatha iodine alag antiseptic hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: Dettol chloroxylenol tatha terpineol ka mishran hota hai - chloroxylenol jivanuon ko maarta hai tatha terpineol ushe paani mein ghulaata hai.

qe: Which drug is used to control 'Allergies' like hay fever or skin rashes?
qh: एलर्जी, खुजली और छींकों को रोकने के लिए किस वर्ग की दवा का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Antihistamine dawaon ka istemal allergy (jaise hay fever, skin rashes tatha chhinkon) ke lakshan kam karne mein hota hai; allergy mein sharer histamine naam ka padarth chhodta hai, jo khoon ki naliyon ko failata hai tatha kharish tatha sujan paida karta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki antihistamine dawa histamine ke liye bane sthalon (receptors) par baith kar uske asar ko rok deti hai, isliye sujan, kharish tatha naak behna kam ho jaate hain; isliye ye saanp (anti-inflammatory) tatha allergy ke aam lakshan mein di jaati hai. Antibiotic tatha antacid anya samasyaon ke liye hain, isliye wo jod is prashn ka uttar nahi hain. Exam point: allergy ke lakshan kam karne wali dawa antihistamine hoti hai - yahi histamine ke asar ko rok kar sujan tatha kharish ko ghatati hai.

qe: What is 'Iodoform' ($CHI_3$) used for in medical practice?
qh: चिकित्सा में 'आयोडोफॉर्म' ($CHI_3$) का उपयोग किस रूप में किया जाता है?
e: CHI3 ka vyavharik naam iodoform hai, jo ek halke peele rang wala padarth hai tatha ghay par lagane wali patti (dressing) ka hissa hota hai; hawa tatha roshni ke sampark mein ye toot kar free iodine chhodta hai, jo jivanuon ko maarta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ismein iodine ki matara dheere-dheere chhut.ti rehti hai, isliye asar lamba chalda rehta hai tatha ghav ke bharne tak jivanuon ko badhne nahi deta; isi tez gandh ke karan patties (dressing) badalte samay iski pehchaan hoti hai. Ye andar lene ki dawa nahi hai, keval ghay ke bahari ilaaj ke liye kaam aata hai - isliye anya jod yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: iodoform (CHI3) ko ghav ke jivanu-nashak (antiseptic dressing) ke roop mein istemal karte hain, kyunki ye phati (free) iodine dheere-dheere chhodta hai tatha jivanuon ko maarta hai.

qe: Which 'Antibiotic' is broad-spectrum and used to treat Typhoid and Meningitis?
qh: टाइफाइड और मेनिन्जाइटिस के इलाज में प्रयुक्त ब्रॉड-स्पेक्ट्रम एंटीबायोटिक कौन सा है?
e: Chloramphenicol ka asar kai tarah ke jivanuon par hota hai (broad-spectrum), kyunki ye unka protein nirman rok deta hai; isi karan ise typhoid, meningitis tatha aankh ke kai samkraman (infections) mein istemal karte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye jivanuon ki 50S ribosome par baith kar unka protein nirman rukta hai, isliye jivanu badh nahi paate tatha unki matara ghat jaati hai; par iski side effects ki wajah se doctor ise savdhani se likhte hain. Penicillin tatha paracetamol alag samasyaon ke liye hain, isliye wo is prashn ka uttar nahi honge. Exam point: typhoid tatha meningitis ke ilaaj mein istemal hone wali broad-spectrum antibiotic chloramphenicol hai - yahi jivanuon ka protein nirman rok deti hai.

qe: What is 'Salvarsan' used to treat?
qh: 'साल्वरसन' (Salvarsan) का उपयोग किस बीमारी के इलाज के लिए किया गया था?
e: Salvarsan ko syphilis (phirangi roga) ke ilaaj ke liye istemal karte the tatha yahi is bimari ki pehli asardar rasayanik dawa maani jaati hai, jo Paul Ehrlich ne beeswin sadi ke shuruaat mein banaayi. Iska karan yahi hai ki usmein arsenic hota hai jo syphilis ke sukshm jivanu (Treponema pallidum) ko maarta hai; isi karan yahi 'magic bullet' (seedhi nishane wali dawa) ki soch ka pehla udaharan bana tatha aage rasayan-chikitsa (chemotherapy) ka raasta khula. Iske ulat iska istemal malaria, TB ya dard ke liye nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: salvarsan ka istemal syphilis (phirangi) ke ilaaj ke liye hota tha - yahi us rog ki pehli asardar rasayanik dawa maani jaati hai.

qe: Which of the following is an 'Anionic' detergent used in toothpastes?
qh: टूथपेस्ट और शैम्पू में झाग बनाने के लिए किस 'एनायनिक' डिटर्जेंट का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Anionic detergent wo hote hain jinmein rin (-ve) aavesh wala hissa paani ko chhodne wala (hydrophobic) hota hai tatha paani se judne wala hissa rin aayan ke roop mein chalta hai; sodium lauryl sulfate (SLS) aisa hi ek detergent hai jo toothpaste mein saaf karne (jhaag) tatha gholkar (surfactant) ka kaam karta hai.
