Iska karan yahi hai ki SLS tel tatha gandagi ko paani mein ghulne layak bana deta hai, isliye daant tatha muh saaf hote hain; isi gun ke karan ye shampoo tatha sabun mein bhi istemal hota hai. Iske ulat cationic detergent conditioner mein tatha non-ionic halke (gentle) cleaner mein istemal hote hain, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke sahi jod nahi. Exam point: toothpaste mein istemal hone wala anionic detergent sodium lauryl sulfate (SLS) hai - yahi jhaag tatha safai ka zariya banta hai.

qe: What is 'Saccharin' chemically?
qh: रासायनिक रूप से 'सैकरीन' (Saccharin) क्या है?
e: Saccharin ka rasayanik naam ortho-sulfobenzimide hota hai ye sabse purana kalpana-tmak mithas-padarth hai; iska meethapan cheeni se sau guna se bhi zyada hota hai tatha ye sharer ko urja lagbhag nahi deta. Iska karan yahi hai ki usmein benzene chakra ke saath ek sulfonamide wala chakra juda hota hai, jo meethai ka asar deta hai; purane samay mein ise 'sugar-rahit' rogiyon tatha diet-drinks mein istemal karte the, par aaj iske sambandh mein savdhani rakhi jaati hai. Iske ulat aspartame (peptide) tatha sucralose (chlorine wala) alag samooh hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: saccharin ka rasayanik naam ortho-sulfobenzimide hai - yahi sabse purana artificial mithas-padarth hai jo lagbhag calorie nahi deta.

qe: Which 'Vitamin' is present in 'Cod Liver Oil'?
qh: 'कॉड लिवर ऑयल' (मछली के तेल) में कौन से विटामिन प्रचुर मात्रा में होते हैं?
e: Cod liver oil (samudri machhli ka tel) mein vitamin A tatha vitamin D dono prachur matara mein hote hain; yahi karan hai ki purane zamaane mein bachcho ko ye tel pilaya jaata tha, taaki aankhon ki roshni tatha haddiyon ki badhotri sahi ho. Vitamin A dekha-ne (vision) tatha twacha (skin) ke liye zaroori hota hai, jabki vitamin D calcium ke avshoshan tatha haddiyon ki mazbooti ke liye; isliye dono ek hin saath milna is tel ko 'dvo-vitamin' ka srot banata hai. Iske ulat vitamin C nimbu-santre mein tatha vitamin K harre patton mein hota hai, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke sahi jod nahi. Exam point: cod liver oil mein vitamin A tatha vitamin D dono maujood hote hain - isi karan ye aankhon tatha haddiyon ke liye upyukt maana jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Morphine' classified as?
qh: 'मॉर्फिन' को किस प्रकार के दर्द निवारक के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
e: Morphine ko 'narcotic analgesic' ke roop mein vargeekrit (classify) kiya jaata hai, kyunki ye dard ko bahut prabhavi taur par kam karti hai tatha saath hi mastishk par nashe (narcosis) tatha nind jaisa asar bhi deti hai - yani ye dard-nashak' 'nashe wali gati' dono ka mishran hai. Iska kaam mastishk tatha reeda-haddi (spinal cord) ke dard-receptors par baith kar dard ke sandesh ko rokna hai, isliye gehre dard (cancer tatha major surgery) mein yahi kaam aati hai; par iski aadat (addiction) bahut jaldi ho jaati hai, isliye ise doctor ki nigrani mein hi diya jaata hai. Iske ulat aspirin tatha paracetamol saadharan (non-narcotic) dard-nashak hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: morphine ko narcotic analgesic kaha jaata hai, kyunki ye dard kam karne ke saath nashe tatha nind jaisa asar bhi deti hai (isliye ye aadat-karak hai).

qe: Which 'Dye' is used for coloring 'Butter' and 'Margarine'?
qh: मक्खन और मार्जरीन को रंगने के लिए किस रंजक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Butter tatha margarine ko peela rang dene ke liye pehle 'aniline yellow' jaisa rasayanik rang istemal hota tha, kyunki ye chiknaai mein ghul jaata hai tatha makkhan jaisa peela rang deta hai; par kai desh mein aise rang par rok lagne ke baad aaj-carotene (natural) rang ka upyog zyada hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki aise chiknaai-gholeel (oil-soluble) rang khane ke padarth mein milaane se rang barabar failta hai tatha ushe aakarshak banata hai, isliye 'butter yellow' jaisa naam pada. Iske ulat indigo (neela), alizarin (laal) tatha congo red alag rang hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: makkhan tatha margarine ko rangne ke liye aniline yellow jaisa oil-soluble rang istemal hota tha - aaj kai deshon mein carotene istemal hota hai.

qe: What is 'Furacine'?
qh: 'फ्यूरासिन' (Furacine) क्या है?
e: Furacine (nitrofurazone) ek peela rang wala jivanu-nashak marham (ointment) hai, jise jild ke ghay tatha jalne (burns) par lagaya jaata hai; ye jivanuon ke kai prakar par asar karke unhe badhne nahi deta. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye jivanuon ke andar ki kriyaon (enzyme) ko rok kar unhe maarta hai, isliye yahi jale hue bhaagon tatha bade ghay ke liye upyukt marham hai; ise patli parat mein lagakar patti bandhi jaati hai. Ye sirf bahari lagane wala marham hai; andar lene wali dawa ya dard-nashak se iska koi sambandh nahi. Exam point: furacine ek jivanu-nashak marham hai jo jale tatha ghay par lagaya jaata hai - yahi jivanuon ko badhne se rokta hai.

qe: Which gas is used as a 'General Anesthetic' in major surgeries?
qh: सर्जरी में सामान्य एनेस्थेटिक के रूप में किस गैस मिश्रण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Nitrous oxide (hansne wali gas) ko oxygen ke saath mila kar 'general anesthetic' (poori behoshi) ke liye major surgery mein istemal karte hain, kyunki ye dard tatha chetna dono ko halka karke rogi ko behosh kar deti hai par saans chalti rehti hai. Iska kaam mastishk ke dard tatha chetna wale hisson par dhunda (dull) asar daalna hai tatha oxygen ke saath milane se surakshit rehti hai, isliye surgeon ko kriya karne ka samay mil jaata hai; isi karan ise 'laughing gas' bhi kehte hain (kam matara mein yahi hasi paida karti hai). CO2, methane tatha nitrogen gases ko is kaam ke liye upyukt nahi maana jaata, isliye wo uttar nahi honge. Exam point: major surgery mein general anesthetic ke roop mein nitrous oxide ko oxygen ke saath mila kar istemal karte hain, kyunki ye dard tatha chetna dono ko dheela kar deta hai.

qe: What is 'Ranitidine' (Zantac) used for?
qh: 'रैनिटिडिन' का मुख्य चिकित्सीय उपयोग क्या है?
e: Ranitidine (Zantac) ek antacid hai jise H2-receptor antagonist kehte hain, kyunki ye pet ki deewar par histamine ke H2 reseptor par baith kar aml banane wali koshikaon ko rok deta hai; isi karan ye jalan (acidity) tatha peptic ulcer ke ilaaj mein diya jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki aml ka nikalna kam hone se pet ki antari parat ko aaram milta hai tatha ulcer bharne lagta hai; par iske (NDMA) sambandhit savdhani ke karan aaj iske sthan par anya dawa (jaise pantoprazole) zyada prachlit hain. Antibiotic jivanuon ke liye tatha dard-nashak dawa dard ke liye hoti hai; pet ki jalan ka ilaaj in dono se nahi hota. Exam point: ranitidine (Zantac) pet ki adhik acidity tatha peptic ulcer ke ilaaj ke liye istemal hoti hai - yahi H2-receptor par asar karke aml banna ghatati hai.

qe: What is 'Erythromycin'?
qh: 'एरिथ्रोमाइसिन' किस प्रकार की दवा है?
e: Erythromycin ek antibiotic hai jo jivanuon ko seedha maarti nahi, balki unka badhna (protein nirman) rok deti hai - isi karan ise 'bacteriostatic' kehte hain; yahi anter (difference) 'bactericidal' (jivanuon ko maarne wali) antibiotic se hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye jivanu ki 50S ribosome par baith kar protein banane ki kriya rukta hai, isliye naye jivanu nahi bante tatha sharer ki pratiraksha unhe khatam kar deti hai; isi karan ise gram-dhan jivanuon tatha kuchh anya samkraman mein diya jaata hai. Iske ulat penicillin jivanuon ki deewar todkar unhe maarti hai, isliye wo bacteriostatic nahi hai. Exam point: erythromycin ek bacteriostatic antibiotic hai - ye jivanuon ka protein nirman rok deti hai, unhe seedha maarti nahi.

qe: Which chemical is used as a 'Preservative' in processed meat to prevent botulism?
qh: प्रसंस्कृत मांस में बोटुलिज्म बैक्टीरिया को रोकने के लिए किस परिरक्षक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Processed meat (sausage tatha salami) mein jivanuon ko badhne se rokne ke liye sodium nitrite (NaNO2) milaya jaata hai; Clostridium botulinum naam ka jivanu bina hawa (anaerobic) vaale mahaul mein badhta hai tatha botulism naam ka ghatak rog paida karta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki nitrite us jivanu ke bij (spore) ko badhne nahi deta tatha meat ka rang bhi gulaabi-laal banaye rakhta hai; isliye ise 'curing' kehte hain - par adhik matara khane walon ke liye nuksandeh ho sakti hai, isliye iski matara tay hoti hai. Iske ulat sodium benzoate (juice) tatha metabisulphite (murabba) ke liye hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: processed meat mein botulism rokne ke liye sodium nitrite (NaNO2) milaya jaata hai - yahi jivanu ke bij ko badhne nahi deta.

qe: What is 'Alitame'?
qh: 'एलिटेम' (Alitame) क्या है?
o: A high-potency artificial sweetener (2000 times sweet)
e: Alitame ek bahut prabal kalpana-tmak (artificial) mithas-padarth hai, jiski mithaas cheeni (sukroze) se hazaron guna adhik hai tatha jo sharer ko urja (calorie) nahi deta; pakaane ke tapman par bhi ye sthir rehta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ismein amino acid ke saath ek vishesh (alanamide) hissa jura hota hai, isliye sharer mein pachne se bach jaata hai tatha chhoti matara hi mithaas deti hai; isi karan ise diet-drinks, mithai tatha dawaon ke khaas meetha karne mein istemal karte hain. Saccharin doosre samooh ka mithas-padarth hai, isliye wo yahan uttar nahi hoga. Exam point: alitame ek bahut prabal (lagbhag 2000 guna meetha) artificial sweetener hai - yahi aspartame se adhik tapman-sahishnu hota hai.

qe: Which 'Antiseptic' is found in the mouthwash 'Listerine'?
qh: 'लिस्ट्रिन' माउथवॉश में कौन सा प्राकृतिक एंटीसेप्टिक यौगिक होता है?
e: Listerine jaisi mouthwash mein thymol ek mukhya jivanu-nashak padarth hota hai, jo anna (phool ke tel) se nikalta hai tatha tez sugandh ke saath jivanuon ko maarta hai; iske saath eucalyptol, menthol tatha methyl salicylate bhi mila hote hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki thymol jivanuon ki jhilli todta hai tatha muh ki badbu ka karan bane jivanuon ko rokta hai, isliye daant tatha masudon ki safai ke baad muh meetha tatha taaza rehta hai. Iske ulat phenol tatha iodophor anya jivanu-nashak hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: Listerine mouthwash mein mukhya jivanu-nashak padarth thymol hota hai - yahi jivanuon ko maar kar muh ko saaf tatha taaza rakhta hai.

qe: What is 'Chloroquine' used to treat?
qh: 'क्लोरोक्वीन' का उपयोग किसके उपचार के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Chloroquine ek aam-malaria (malaria) ki dawa hai, jo Plasmodium naam ki sukshm-parjeevi (parasite) ko nasht karti hai; iski kriya ka aadhaar yahi hai ki laal koshikaon mein parjeevi ka haem (haemozoin) nirman rukta hai, isse parjeevi ko zehirila padarth jama ho jaate hain tatha wo nast ho jaati hai. Iska mahatva isliye hai ki malaria ke bukhar, bhanwar (shivering) tatha pasine ke daure isi se kam hote hain; par kai sthalon mein parjeevi dawa ke prati pratiridh ho gayi hai, isliye aaj iske saath anya dawa (jaise artemisinin) bhi di jaati hai. Iske ulat ye TB, dard ya cancer ke liye nahi hoti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: chloroquine ka istemal malaria ke ilaaj ke liye hota hai - yahi malarial parjeevi ke haem nirman ko rok kar ushe maar deti hai.

qe: Which chemical is used to give 'Red color' to Lipsticks?
qh: लिपस्टिक और सौंदर्य प्रसाधनों को लाल रंग देने के लिए किस प्राकृतिक डाई का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Lipstick tatha anya saundarya-padarth ko laal rang dene ke liye 'carmine' ka istemal hota hai, jo cochineal keede (dactylopius) se nikaala jaata hai - is be matlab unka rang aaj bhi praakritik hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki us rang (carminic acid) ka rang bahut chamakdar tatha sthir hota hai, isliye ye jild par asar nahi karta (astar) tatha lambe samay tak bana rehta hai; isi karan ye khane-pine (jaise sharbat) mein bhi istemal hota hai. Iske ulat indigo (neela) tatha alizarin (laal, par madder paudhe se milta hai) alag srot hain, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke sahi jod nahi. Exam point: lipstick tatha laal ragan (red color) dene ke liye carmine (cochineal keede se milne wala rang) istemal hota hai - yahi ek praakritik laal rang hai.

qe: What is 'Amoxicillin'?
qh: 'एमोक्सिसिलिन' किस वर्ग की दवा है?
e: Amoxicillin ek ardh-sanshleshit (semi-synthetic) penicillin hai, jise penicillin tatha ek khaas samooh ke milane se banaya jaata hai - iska matlab yahi hai ki iska mool dhanchaa praakritik penicillin se banaya gaya, par aage upe sanyojan se ushe behtar banaya gaya. Iska karan yahi hai ki ismein ek amino wala samooh jodne se ye pet ke aml mein sthir rehti hai tatha muh se dene par bhi asar karti hai; isi karan ise gale, kaan, dant tatha saans ki nali ke samkraman (infection) mein istemal karte hain. Iske ulat chloramphenicol tatha erythromycin alag parampariv ki antibiotics hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: amoxicillin ek semi-synthetic penicillin (antibiotic) hai - yahi penicillin ka behtar banaya gaya roop hai jo muh se dene par kaam karta hai.

qe: Which 'Sweetener' is used in 'Diet Cokes' but is unstable at high temperatures?
qh: डाइट कोल्ड ड्रिंक्स में प्रयुक्त कौन सा स्वीटनर खाना पकाने के तापमान पर अस्थिर होता है?
e: Diet coke tatha anya thandi drinks mein istemal hone wala aspartame ek peptide (do amino acid se bana) mithas-padarth hai, jo thande mahaul mein meetha lagta hai; garam hone par uske andar ke bandhan toot jaate hain tatha uska swaad teeta ho jaata hai, isliye pakaane wali chizon mein iska istemal nahi hota. Isi karan chai, khana tatha baking wali mithai mein ye upyukt nahi hai, jabki sucralose tatha saccharin garam par bhi asar dete hain. Iske ulat ye phenylketonuria (aik vishesh bimari) wale rogion ke liye harj (contraindicated) maana jaata hai, isliye savdhani rakhni chahiye. Exam point: diet coke jaisi thandi drinks mein istemal hone wala aspartame uchch tapman par sthir nahi rehta - isi liye ise keval thandi chizo mein istemal karte hain.

qe: What is 'Luminol' used for in forensic science (Crime scene investigation)?
qh: फोरेंसिक जांच में 'ल्यूमिनोल' (Luminol) का उपयोग किस लिए किया जाता है?
o: To detect trace amounts of blood
e: Luminol ek aisa padarth hai jise apradh-sthal (crime scene) par khoon ki khoji ke liye istemal karte hain, kyunki khoon ke sampark mein aane par ye neeli roshni chhodta hai (chemiluminescence) tatha raat bhar ke jame hue khoon ka nishaan bhi saaf dikha deta hai. Iska rahasya yahi hai ki khoon mein maujood haem (jismein iron hota hai) us kriya ko utprek (catalyst) ki tarah tez kar deti hai, isliye jin jagahon par khoon laga tha wahan neeli chamak uthti hai; saaf ki gayi jagah bhi isi karan pakdi jaati hai. Ye koi dawa ya visphotak nahi hai, balki jaanch (investigation) ka saadhan hai, isliye wo jod uttar nahi honge. Exam point: luminol ka istemal forensik vigyan mein khoon ki khoji (blood detection) ke liye hota hai - yahi khoon ke haem se kriya karke neeli roshni chhodta hai.

qe: Which class of drugs is used for the treatment of 'Hyper-acidity' and Peptic Ulcers?
qh: पेप्टिक अल्सर और अत्यधिक एसिडिटी के उपचार में किन दवाओं का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Peptic ulcer tatha adhik acidity ke ilaaj mein jivanuon ko rokne wali (antibiotic) dawa tatha aml ghatane wali dawa dono di jaati hain; ismein H2-blocker (ranitidine) ya proton-pump inhibitor (omeprazole) aml banane wali dawa hoti hai, tatha yadi Helicobacter pylori jivanu mile to amoxicillin jaisi antibiotic bhi di jaati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ulcer adhiktam mole mein us jivanu tatha adhik aml ke saath-saath hone se hota hai, isliye dono ka ilaaj zaroori hai; keval antacid se jalan kam hoti hai par ulcer bharne mein samay lagta hai. Iske ulat tranqilizer ya dard-nashak ulcer ka mukhya ilaaj nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: peptic ulcer tatha adhik acidity ka ilaaj H2-blocker tatha (jivanuon ke saath) antibiotic dwara hota hai - kyunki ismein jivanu tatha aml dono ka hissa hota hai.

qe: What is 'Streptomycin' primarily used for?
qh: 'स्ट्रेप्टोमाइसिन' एंटीबायोटिक मुख्य रूप से किस बीमारी के लिए ऐतिहासिक रूप से प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Streptomycin ek antibiotic hai jo mukhya roop se tuberculosis (kshay) ke ilaaj ke liye istemal hota hai, khaas taur par jab anya dawa asar na kar rahi ho ya TB ke ghatak roop mein; ye jivanuon ke protein banane ko rokta hai tatha unhe maarta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye Mycobacterium tuberculosis jivanu par saaf asar karta hai tatha ise injection ke zariye diya jaata hai; isi karan DOTS wale standard ilaaj (isoniazid, rifampicin, ethambutol ke saath) mein iska vishesh sthan to hota hai. Iske ulat ye malaria, typhoid ya dard ke liye nahi, khaas taur par TB ke liye jaani jaati hai. Exam point: streptomycin ka mukhya istemal tuberculosis (TB) ke ilaaj mein hota hai - yahi TB ke jivanu ka protein nirman rok kar unhe maarti hai.

qe: Which 'Artificial Dye' is used to color blue jeans?
qh: ब्लू जींस को रंगने के लिए मुख्य रूप से किस सिंथेटिक डाई का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Indigo (neela rang) ko jeans tatha denim kapdon ko neela karne ke liye istemal karte hain; praakritik indigo pehle indigo paudhe (Indigofera) se milta tha, par aaj sanshleshit (synthetic) indigo bazaar mein prachlit hai, kyunki wo sasta tatha shuddh hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki indigo kapde ke resh se mazbooti se jud jaata hai par ghisne par dheere-dheere halka hota jaata hai, isi se jeans ko fashion wala 'faded' (puraana) look milta hai; isliye denim udyog mein yahi rang sabse zyada istemal hota hai. Iske ulat carmine laal rang ke liye tatha alizarin laal rang ke liye hota hai, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke sahi jod nahi. Exam point: jeans tatha denim ko neela karne ke liye indigo (synthetic) rang ka istemal hota hai - yahi ghisne par halka hota jaata hai tatha faded look deta hai.

qe: What is 'Valium'?
qh: 'वेलियम' (Valium) दवा किस वर्ग से संबंधित है?
e: Valium (diazepam) bhi shaman (tranquilizer) varg ki dawa hai, jise mansik bechaini tatha ghabraahat kam karne ke liye diya jaata hai; ye mastishk mein GABA naam ke rasayan ke asar ko badha deti hai. Iska asar man ko shaant karne tatha neend laane wala hota hai, isliye mansik rogion ke ilaaj mein iska istemal hota hai; par ise lambe samay tak lene se aadat ho jaati hai, isliye doctor ki nigrani zaroori hai. Aspirin tatha paracetamol dard ke liye tatha antibiotic jivanuon ke liye hoti hai; mansik tanav ka ilaaj in se nahi hota. Exam point: valium bhi tranquilizer (shaman) dawa hai - mansik ghabraahat tatha bechaini mein iska istemal hota hai.

qe: Which 'Metal' is present in the antiseptic 'Mercurochrome'?
qh: 'मरक्यूरोक्रोम' एंटीसेप्टिक में कौन सी धातु उपस्थित होती है?
e: Mercurochrome (merbromin) ek laal rang wala jivanu-nashak hai jismein mukhya dhaatu 'paara' (mercury) hota hai; isi karan kai deshon mein ise rok diya gaya hai ya savdhani se istemal karte hain, kyunki paara sharir ke liye haanikarak hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki paara jivanuon ke protein ke -SH samooh se judta hai tatha unhe nasht kar deta hai, isliye ye ghav dhoone par jivanu mar jaate hain; par paara jild ke zariye sharir mein ja sakta hai. Iske ulat iodine, boric acid tatha chloroxylenol paara-rahit antiseptic hain, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke sahi jod nahi. Exam point: mercurochrome jaisa antiseptic 'paara' (mercury) dhaatu par bana hota hai - isi karan paara ki zehriLata ke kaaran aaj iska istemal seemit hai.

qe: What is 'Bayer's Aspirin' chemically identical to?
qh: बायर कंपनी की 'एस्पिरिन' रासायनिक रूप से किसके समान है?
e: Bayer's aspirin tatha samanya aspirin rasayanik roop se ek hi padarth (acetylsalicylic acid) hote hain; dono mein koi rasayanik antar nahi hota, keval bazaar ka naam tatha brand alag hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki Bayer ne aspirin ko sabse pehle becha tha, isliye uske naam ke saath 'Bayer' jud gaya, par uski sanrachna wahi acetylsalicylic acid rehti hai; isi karan ilaaj ka asar tatha khurak ka hisaab bhi same rehta hai. Iske ulat paracetamol tatha ibuprofen alag rasayanik padarth hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: Bayer's aspirin ka rasayanik roop samanya aspirin jaisa hi acetylsalicylic acid hota hai - dono mein rasayanik ko koi antar nahi hota.

qe: Which class of drugs is used to 'Prevent Pregnancy' (Oral Contraceptives)?
qh: गर्भधारण रोकने के लिए प्रयुक्त ओरल पिल्स किस वर्ग की दवाएं हैं?
e: Antifertility (garbh-nirodhak) dawaon mein hormone (estrogen-progestin ka mishran) hota hai, jo mastishk ke pituitary ko aadesh deta hai ki ankdan (ovulation) ruk jaaye; isliye ise 'oral contraceptive pills' kehte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki jab sharer mein pehle se hormone mil jaate hain, to mastishk ko lagta hai ki ankdan ho chuka hai tatha wo ovary ko ande (ovum) banane ka sanket nahi deta; isi karan garbh dhaaran nahi hota. Iske ulat antibiotic tatha dard-nashak dawaon se ye kaam nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: garbh rokne wali goliyon (oral contraceptives) mein antifertility hormone (estrogen-progestin) hote hain, jo ankdan rok kar garbh dhaaran nahi hone dete.

qe: What is 'Ciprofloxacin' used for?
qh: 'सिप्रोफ्लोक्सासिन' का प्राथमिक उपयोग क्या है?
e: Ciprofloxacin ek aisa antibiotic hai jo gram-dhan tatha gram-rin dono jivanuon par asar karta hai; ye unki DNA ki naqal (replication) rukta hai, isliye ise typhoid, mutra-marg (urinary tract) ke samkraman, aanto ke samkraman tatha anya kai jivanu-janit bimariyon mein istemal karte hain. Iske liye jivanuon ka ek khaas enzyme (DNA gyrase) nishana banta hai, jisse unki DNA ki copy ban nahi paati tatha jivanu badh nahi paate; bade logon mein tendon ki samasya aa sakti hai, isliye ise savdhani se diya jaata hai. Iske ulat paracetamol dard-nashak tatha chloroquine malaria ke liye hai, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: ciprofloxacin ek broad-spectrum antibiotic hai jo jivanu ka DNA ghumna (replication) rok kar unhe maarta hai - isi liye ye typhoid tatha mutra-marg ke samkraman mein istemal hoti hai.

qe: Which chemical is used as a 'Sweetener' in diabetic foods?
qh: मधुमेह रोगियों के खाद्य पदार्थों में प्रयुक्त चीनी का विकल्प क्या है?
e: Sorbitol tatha xylitol mithas wale alcohol (polyols) hain jo madhumeh (diabetes) tatha diet wale aahar mein mithaas dene ke liye istemal hote hain, kyunki unhe pachne mein insulin ki zaroorat kam padti hai tatha wo sugar ki tulna mein khoon ki shakkar (glucose) ko tez nahi badhaate. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye sugar-alcohol hote hain jinka sharer mein avshoshan dheere-dheere hota hai; iske saath hi ye daant sadne (cavity) se bhi bachaate hain tatha sugar-free mithai, chewing gum tatha toothpaste mein istemal hote hain. Iske ulat sucralose tatha aspartame ke calorie lagbhag shunya hote hain par wo mithas-alcohol nahi, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: madhumeh wale aahar tatha sugar-free padarthon mein istemal hone wale mithas-padarth sorbitol tatha xylitol hote hain - ye sugar-alcohol hain jinka asar mithas wala par halka hota hai.

qe: What is 'Novocaine' used for?
qh: 'नोवोकेन' (Novocaine) का मुख्य उपयोग क्या है?
e: Novocaine (procaine) ek sthanik (local) behoshi ki dawa hai, jise operation ke samay ek khaas bhaag (jaise dant ya jild ka hissa) sunn (senseless) karne ke liye istemal karte hain; rogi ko poori behoshi nahi aati, keval us bhaag ka dard tatha sparsh mehsoos nahi hota. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye snayu (nerve) ki jhilli mein ghus kar dard ke sandesh ko poora nahi hone deti, isliye dant nikaalne tatha tike (stitches) lagane mein bhi rogi ko dard nahi hota; yahi karan iska asar kuchh ghanton tak rehta hai. Iske ulat nitrous oxide poori behoshi (general anaesthesia) ke liye hota hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: novocaine ek local anesthetic hai, jo ek khaas bhaag ko dard-rahit (behosh) karne ke liye istemal hota hai - poori behoshi nahi deta.

qe: Which 'Dye' is obtained from the roots of the Madder plant?
qh: मजीठ (Madder) के पौधे की जड़ों से कौन सा लाल रंजक प्राप्त होता है?
e: Alizarin ek laal rang hai jo pehle 'madder' paudhe ki jad se nikaala jaata tha; sanshleshit roop mein unniswin sadi se ye bazaar mein aaya tatha kapde rangne (tatha painting ke rang) mein bahut istemal hua. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye resh (fibre) tatha vastu se mazbooti se jud jaata hai, isliye iska rang dhone par bhi jaldi nahi utarta; isliye ye ek 'mordant dye' ke roop mein jaana jaata hai, jise dhaatu ke lavan (jaise alum) ke saath lagaya jaata hai. Iske ulat indigo neela rang tatha carmine keede se aane wala laal rang hai, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke sahi jod nahi. Exam point: madder paudhe ki jad se milne wala laal rang alizarin hota hai - yahi aaj sanshleshit roop mein bhi banaya jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Soframycin'?
qh: 'सोफ्रामिसिन' क्या है?
e: Soframycin (framycetin) ek jivanu-nashak tatha antibiotic marham hai, jise jild ke ghay, jale hue sthal tatha aankh-kaan ke samkraman mein bahari roop se istemal karte hain; ye jivanuon ke kai prakar par asar kar deta hai. Iska asar keval lagane ki jagah par hota hai, isliye ghay par patli parat lagakar patti bandh di jaati hai tatha ghav jaldi bhar jaata hai. Ye andar lene wali antibiotic ya dard-nashak nahi hai, isliye wo jod yahan uttar nahi honge. Exam point: soframycin ek jivanu-nashak (antiseptic/antibiotic) marham hai jo jild ke ghay tatha jalne par lagaya jaata hai - yahi jivanuon ko rok kar ghav bharne mein madad karta hai.

qe: Which gas is evolved when 'Soap' reacts with 'Vinegar'?
qh: जब साबुन की सिरके (एसिटिक एसिड) के साथ अभिक्रिया होती है तो कौन सी गैस निकलती है?
e: Sabun tatha vinegar (sirka) ko milaane par koi gas nahi banti, kyunki dono milkar ek aisa padarth (sodium acetate tatha paani) banate hain jismein koi bubbly gas chhut.ne ka kaam nahi hota; jhaag (foam) dikh sakti hai, par wo nikalne wali gas nahi hoti. Iska karan yahi hai ki gas tatha acid ke milne par CO2 tabhi nikalta hai jab barykarbonate (jaise baking soda) ho; yahan vine kar kamzor aml hone ke karan ye kriya poori nahi hoti, isliye 'no gas' hi sahi jod hai. Iske ulat oxygen, hydrogen tatha CO2 banne wale vikalp galat hain, kyunki ye kriya unhe nahi deti. Exam point: sabun tatha vinegar milaane par koi gas nahi banti - gas keval tab banti hai jab acid kisi carbonate (jaise baking soda) se milta hai, isliye yahan 'no gas' hi sahi hai.

qe: Which chemical is used as a 'Preservative' in fruit juices and pickles to prevent the growth of yeast and mold?
qh: फलों के रस और सॉस में फफूंद रोकने के लिए सबसे आम परिरक्षक कौन सा है?
e: Fruit juice tatha achar mein khaand (yeast) tatha fungus badhne se rokne ke liye sodium benzoate (C6H5COONa) milaya jaata hai; ye ek khadiya-rok (preservative) hai jo paidavur (padarth) ko lambe samay tak kharab hone nahi deta. Ye jivanuon ki kriya rok deta hai, isliye padarth kharab hone se bach jaata hai; iski matara sarkari niyam ke hisaab se tay hoti hai, kyunki bahut adhik matara sehhat ke liye haanikarak ho sakti hai. Iske ulat sodium nitrite (meat) tatha sodium metabisulphite (murabba) alag padarthon ke liye hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: fruit juice tatha achar ko kharab hone se bachane ke liye sodium benzoate istemal hota hai - yahi yeast tatha fungus ko badhne nahi deta.

qe: What is 'BHA' (Butylated Hydroxyanisole) used for in the food industry?
qh: खाद्य उद्योग में बीएचए (BHA) का उपयोग किस रूप में किया जाता है?
e: BHA (butylated hydroxyanisole) ek anti-oxidant hai jo khane ke tel tatha ghee jaisi chiknaai wale padarthon mein milaya jaata hai, taaki wo hawa ki oxygen se kriya karke kharab (rancid) na ho jaayein; isse unki gandh tatha swaad kharab hone se bachte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki BHA khud oxygen se pehle kriya kar leta hai, isliye tel tatha ghee ke anu oxid hone se bach jaate hain; isi tarah BHT tatha vitamin E (tocopherol) bhi yahi kaam karte hain. Iske ulat sodium benzoate tatha metabisulphite jivanuon ke badhne ko rokte hain, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke sahi jod nahi. Exam point: BHA (butylated hydroxyanisole) ko khane ke tel tatha ghee mein anti-oxidant ke roop mein milate hain, taaki wo oxid hokar kharab (rancid) na ho jaayein.

qe: Which compound is added to 'LPG' to give it a strong smell to detect leaks?
qh: एलपीजी में रिसाव की पहचान के लिए कौन सा गंधयुक्त यौगिक मिलाया जाता है?
e: LPG cylinder ki gas ko gandhheen hone ke karan usme jaan-boojh kar ethyl mercaptan naam ka padarth milaya jaata hai, taaki gas ke riste (leak) hone ka pata turant chal sake - iski gandh bahut tez tatha bhinn hoti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki LPG ki khud ki koi gandh nahi hoti, isliye bina gandh wale padarth ke ritne ka pata nahi chalta tatha aag ya visphot (explosion) ka khatra rehta hai; ethyl mercaptan ki thodi matara hi poore kamre mein gandh faila deti hai. Iske ulat methane, CO2 ya butane ki gandh is kaam ke liye sahi nahi, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: LPG mein ritne (leak) ka pata lagane ke liye ethyl mercaptan jaisa gandh wala padarth milaya jaata hai - yahi gas ke riste hue turant pata chalta hai.

qe: Which chemical is used as an 'Artificial Ripening' agent for mangoes?
qh: आमों को कृत्रिम रूप से पकाने के लिए किस रसायन का व्यावसायिक उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Aam tatha anya falon ko jaldi pila (ripen) karne ke liye bazaar mein calcium carbide (CaC2) ka istemal hota tha, kyunki paani ke sampark mein ye acetylene gas chhodta hai jo fal ke pilan ki kriya tez kar deta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki calcium carbide sasta tatha turant asar dene wala hota hai, isliye vyapari ushe fal ke paas rakh dete hain; par ismein arsenic tatha anya zehirile padarth mil sakte hain, isliye bharat mein khane ke falon ke liye iske istemal par rok hai. Iske ulat ethylene gas ko khadya-manya (food grade) maana jaata hai, isliye yahan 'calcium carbide' hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: aam jaisi falon ko jaldi pila karne ke liye calcium carbide ka istemal hota tha - par ismein zehirile padarth hone ke karan khadya-upyog par rok hai (ethylene gas surakshit hai).

qe: Which 'Vitamin' is destroyed if we wash peeled vegetables for a long time?
qh: छीली हुई सब्जियों को ज्यादा धोने पर कौन सा विटामिन बहकर नष्ट हो जाता है?
e: Water-soluble vitamins (jaise Vitamin C aur B-complex) paani me asani se dissolve hokar wash away ho jate hain.

qe: Which chemical is found in 'Paan Masala' that is linked to oral cancer?
qh: पान मसाला और सुपारी में कौन सा रासायनिक घटक ओरल सबम्यूकस फाइब्रोसिस से जुड़ा है?
e: Supari (Areca nut) me Arecoline alkaloid hota hai jo oral fibroblasts ko irritate karke mouth opening restrict karta hai aur cancer cause karta hai.

qe: What is 'MSG' (Monosodium Glutamate) used for in Chinese food?
qh: चाइनीज भोजन में एमएसजी (अजीनोमोटो) का उपयोग किस लिए किया जाता है?
e: Monosodium glutamate (Ajinomoto) tongue ke glutamate receptors ko stimulate karke savory 'Umami' taste badhata hai.

qe: Which 'Polysaccharide' is used to make biodegradable plastic?
qh: पर्यावरण के अनुकूल बायोडिग्रेडेबल प्लास्टिक बनाने में किस प्राकृतिक पॉलीसेकेराइड का उपयोग होता है?
e: Thermoplastic Starch (TPS) corn ya potato starch se banaya jata hai jo nature me soil microbes dwara aasani se decompose ho jata hai.

qe: Which 'Alcohol' is found in most hand sanitizers?
qh: हैंड सैनिटाइज़र में कीटाणुओं को मारने के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा अल्कोहल होता है?
e: Effective hand sanitizers me 60-70% Ethanol ya Isopropanol hota hai jo bacterial cell membranes ko dissolve aur proteins ko denature karta hai.

qe: Which reaction is used to convert 'Aniline' into 'Benzene Diazonium Chloride' at 0-5°C?
qh: एनीलिन को 0-5°C पर 'बेंजीन डायज़ोनियम क्लोराइड' में बदलने के लिए किस अभिक्रिया का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Aniline jab ice-cold NaNO2 aur HCl (nitrous acid) ke sath react karti hai to stable diazonium salt banati hai (Diazotization reaction).

qe: What is the primary use of 'Sulpha Drugs' in medicine?
qh: चिकित्सा में 'सल्फा दवाओं' का मुख्य उपयोग क्या है?
e: Sulpha drugs (jaise Sulfadiazine) bacteria me folic acid synthesis ko block karke unki growth rokti hain (antibacterial action).

qe: Which aromatic compound is used to make 'Azo Dyes' through coupling reactions?
qh: युग्मन अभिक्रियाओं (Coupling Reactions) द्वारा चमकीले एज़ो रंजक बनाने में क्या प्रयुक्त होता है?
e: Benzene Diazonium Chloride phenols ya aromatic amines ke sath couple karke highly colored azo compounds (-N=N-) banata hai.

qe: Which reaction converts 'Phenol' into 'Salicylic Acid' using $CO_2$ and $NaOH$?
qh: $CO_2$ और $NaOH$ का उपयोग करके 'फिनोल' को 'सैलिसिलिक एसिड' में कौन सी अभिक्रिया बदलती है?
e: Kolbe's synthesis me sodium phenoxide CO2 gas ke sath high pressure aur temperature par react karke Salicylic acid banata hai.

qe: What is 'Chloroxylenol' a main component of?
qh: 'क्लोरोक्सिलेनोल' (Chloroxylenol) किसका मुख्य एंटीसेप्टिक घटक है?
e: Chloroxylenol household disinfectant Dettol ka key active ingredient hai jo bacterial cell walls ko disrupt karta hai.

qe: What is 'Veronal' or 'Amytal' used as?
qh: 'वेरोनल' या 'एमिटल' का उपयोग चिकित्सा में किस रूप में किया जाता है?
e: Veronal aur Amytal barbiturate derivatives hain jo hypnotic aur sedative tranquilizers ki tarah neend laane aur anxiety kam karne me use hote hain.

qe: Which gas was used as a chemical weapon in World War I and is a toxic derivative of Chloroform?
qh: प्रथम विश्व युद्ध में रासायनिक हथियार के रूप में प्रयुक्त फॉसजीन ($COCl_2$) किसका ऑक्सीकरण उत्पाद है?
e: Chloroform sunlight aur air ki presence me slowly oxidize hokar deadly poisonous gas Phosgene (Carbonyl chloride, COCl2) bana deta hai.

qe: Which reaction is used to distinguish between Primary, Secondary, and Tertiary amines using Hinsberg's reagent?
qh: हिंसबर्ग अभिकर्मक का उपयोग करके प्राथमिक, द्वितीयक और तृतीयक अमीन के बीच अंतर किस परीक्षण द्वारा किया जाता है?
e: Hinsberg reagent (Benzenesulphonyl chloride, C6H5SO2Cl) 1°, 2° aur 3° amines ke sath alkali solubility ke aadhar par clear separation deta hai.

qe: What are 'Enantiomers'?
qh: 'एनैन्टीओमर' (Enantiomers) क्या होते हैं?
e: Aise optical isomers jo ek dusre ke non-superimposable mirror images hote hain aur plane polarized light ko opposite directions me ghumate hain.

qe: Which reagent is used in 'Carbylamine Reaction'?
qh: 'कार्बिलएमीन परीक्षण' में प्राथमिक अमीन के साथ किन अभिकर्मकों का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Primary amine ko Chloroform (CHCl3) aur alcoholic KOH ke sath heat karne par extremely foul-smelling isocyanide banta hai.

qe: What is the 'IUPAC name' of $CH_3CH_2NH_2$?
qh: $CH_3CH_2NH_2$ का IUPAC नाम क्या है?
e: Do carbon wali alkane chain me primary amino group hone se iska systematic IUPAC name Ethanamine hai.

qe: Which 'Aromatic' amine is a liquid at room temperature?
qh: कमरे के तापमान पर कौन सा एरोमैटिक अमीन तैलीय द्रव के रूप में पाया जाता है?
e: Aniline (C6H5NH2) room temperature par ek oily, colorless liquid hota hai jo atmospheric oxidation se brown color ka ho jata hai.

qe: Which 'Nitro' compound is used as an explosive under the name 'TNT'?
qh: विस्फोटक 'TNT' रासायनिक रूप से किस यौगिक का नाइट्रीकृत रूप है?
e: Toluene ko fuming HNO3 aur H2SO4 ke sath react karwane par 2,4,6-Trinitrotoluene (TNT) explosive banta hai.

qe: Which reagent is known as 'Tollen's Reagent'?
qh: 'टोलेन अभिकर्मक' (Tollen's Reagent) रासायनिक रूप से क्या है?
e: Ammoniacal silver nitrate solution [Ag(NH3)2]+ Tollen's reagent hota hai jo aldehydes ke sath silver mirror test deta hai.

qe: Which reaction is used to prepare 'Phenol' from Benzene Diazonium Chloride?
qh: बेंजीन डायज़ोनियम क्लोराइड से फिनोल बनाने के लिए क्या किया जाता है?
e: Benzene diazonium chloride ke aqueous solution ko warm karne par nitrogen gas nikal jaati hai aur pure Phenol banta hai.

qe: Which reagent is used for 'Acetylation' of amines?
qh: अमीन के एसिटिलीकरण (Acetylation) के लिए किस अभिकर्मक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Amines ko Acetyl chloride (CH3COCl) ya Acetic Anhydride ke sath base ki presence me react karwane par acetamide banta hai.

qe: Which 'Functional' group is present in Amides?
qh: एमाइड्स (Amides) में कौन सा क्रियात्मक समूह उपस्थित होता है?
e: Carboxylic acid derivatives jisme hydroxyl group -NH2 se replace hota hai, unka functional group -CONH2 hota hai.

qe: What is the common name of 'Benzene-1,2-diol'?
qh: 'बेंजीन-1,2-डाईऑल' का सामान्य नाम क्या है?
e: Benzene ring ki 1 aur 2 (ortho) positions par do -OH groups lage hone par use Catechol kehte hain (1,3 is Resorcinol, 1,4 is Quinol).

qe: What is the product formed when 'Ethanol' is oxidized by alkaline $KMnO_4$?
qh: क्षारीय $KMnO_4$ द्वारा एथेनॉल के तीव्र ऑक्सीकरण से क्या बनता है?
e: Alkaline KMnO4 ek powerful oxidizing agent hai jo primary alcohol ethanol ko direct Carboxylic acid (Ethanoic acid) me badal deta hai.

qe: Which test is used to detect the presence of the 'Phenolic' group?
qh: 'फिनोलिक' (-OH) समूह की पहचान के लिए कौन सा प्रयोगशाला परीक्षण किया जाता है?
e: Phenols neutral FeCl3 solution ke sath characteristic deep violet ya purple color ka coordination complex banate hain.

qe: What is the hybrid state of 'Oxygen' in Alcohols?
qh: अल्कोहल अणु में ऑक्सीजन परमाणु का संकरण (Hybridization) क्या होता है?
e: Alcohols (R-OH) me oxygen do single bonds aur do lone pairs of electrons rakhta hai, isliye iska hybridization sp3 hota hai.

qe: What is the product of 'Decarboxylation' of Sodium Acetate with Soda Lime?
qh: सोडा लाइम के साथ सोडियम एसीटेट को गर्म करने पर कौन सा हाइड्रोकार्बन प्राप्त होता है?
e: CH3COONa + NaOH (CaO) -> CH4 + Na2CO3; is reaction se ek carbon kam hokar pure Methane gas banti hai.

qe: Which compound is known as 'Carbolic Acid'?
qh: किस यौगिक को ऐतिहासिक रूप से 'कार्बोलिक एसिड' (Carbolic Acid) कहा जाता है?
e: Pure Phenol (C6H5OH) ko Joseph Lister ke samay se hospital antiseptic ke roop me Carbolic Acid kaha jata hai.

qe: Which property of 'Phenol' makes it more acidic than aliphatic Alcohols?
qh: फिनोल को एलिफैटिक अल्कोहल से अधिक अम्लीय कौन सा कारक बनाता है?
e: Phenol se H+ nikalne ke baad bana Phenoxide ion benzene ring par delocalize hokar resonance stabilized ho jata hai, jo alkoxide ion me sambhav nahi hai.

qe: Which chemical is known as 'Picric Acid'?
qh: रासायनिक रूप से 'पिक्रिक एसिड' क्या है?
e: Phenol ko concentrated HNO3 aur H2SO4 ke sath nitration karne par 2,4,6-Trinitrophenol banta hai jise Picric acid kehte hain.

qe: What is the common name of 'Ethanedial'?
qh: एथेनडायल (CHO-CHO) का सामान्य नाम क्या है?
e: CHO-CHO do carbon wala simplest dialdehyde hai jiska common name Glyoxal hai.

qe: What is 'Zwitterion' in amino acid chemistry?
qh: अमीनो एसिड के संदर्भ में 'ज्विटर आयन' (Zwitterion) क्या है?
o: Ion with both positive and negative charges
e: Internal proton transfer hone se carboxyl group -COO- aur amino group -NH3+ ban jata hai, jisse overall dipolar neutral ion (Zwitterion) banta hai.

qe: Which 'Amino Acid' is optically inactive because it lacks a chiral carbon?
qh: कौन सा एकमात्र प्राकृतिक अमीनो अम्ल है जो किरल (Chiral) कार्बन न होने के कारण प्रकाशिक रूप से निष्क्रिय होता है?
e: Glycine (H2N-CH2-COOH) ke alpha carbon par do hydrogen atoms hote hain, isliye isme asymmetric chiral center nahi hota aur ye achiral/optically inactive hai.

qe: What is the specific color test used to identify 'Peptide linkages' in proteins?
qh: प्रोटीन में पेप्टाइड बंधों (-CONH-) की पहचान के लिए कौन सा रासायनिक परीक्षण किया जाता है?
e: Biuret test me alkaline medium me dilute CuSO4 milane par peptide bonds coordination complex banakar violet/purple color dete hain.

qe: What is the repeating monomer unit of 'Cellulose'?
qh: सेलुलोज का मूल बहुलकक (Monomer) क्या है?
e: Cellulose Beta-D-glucose units ki unbranched linear chain hoti hai jo beta-1,4-glycosidic linkages se judi hoti hai.

qe: Why is 'Sucrose' categorized as a Non-reducing Sugar?
qh: सुक्रोज (टेबल शुगर) को अनपचायक शर्करा (Non-reducing Sugar) क्यों माना जाता है?
o: Its reducing anomeric groups of glucose and fructose are locked in the glycosidic bond
e: Sucrose me glucose ka C1 aldehyde aur fructose ka C2 ketone carbon aapas me glycosidic bond me bandhe hote hain, isliye koi free hemiacetal group nahi hota.

qe: What type of chemical linkage forms the repeating backbone of DNA and RNA strands?
qh: डीएनए और आरएनए की रीढ़ (Backbone) में न्यूक्लियोटाइड्स को आपस में कौन सा बंध जोड़ता है?
e: Ek nucleotide ka 3'-OH agle nucleotide ke 5'-phosphate ke sath judkar 3'-5' phosphodiester bond banata hai.

qe: What is 'Nylon 2-Nylon 6'?
qh: नायलॉन 2-नायलॉन 6 किस प्रकार का बहुलक है?
e: Glycine aur amino caproic acid ke copolymerization se banne wala Nylon 2-Nylon 6 ek eco-friendly biodegradable polyamide polymer hai.

qe: What is the product of 'Stephen's Reduction' of Nitriles ($R-CN$)?
qh: स्टीफन अभिक्रिया द्वारा नाइट्राइल ($R-CN$) के अपचयन से क्या बनता है?
e: Alkyl nitriles ko SnCl2 + HCl ke sath reduce karke aldimine hydrochloride banaya jata hai jiska hydrolysis karne par Aldehyde milta hai.

qe: What is the product formed when 'Sodium Propanoate' is heated with Soda Lime?
qh: सोडियम प्रोपेनोएट को सोडा लाइम के साथ गर्म करने पर कौन सा हाइड्रोकार्बन बनता है?
e: C2H5COONa + NaOH (CaO) -> C2H6 + Na2CO3; decarboxylation me chain se ek carbon nikal jata hai isliye propanoate se Ethane banta hai.
